4.61.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mahiṣāsure vinihate bhagavatyā mahāsuraiḥ ..
pūrvavairamanusmṛtya saṃgrāmā bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ .. 1 ..
4.61.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
महिषासुरे विनिहते भगवत्या महासुरैः ॥
पूर्ववैरमनुस्मृत्य संग्रामा बहवः कृताः ॥ 1 ॥
4.61.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When Mahiṣāsura had been slain by the Goddess, many battles were waged by the great asuras, / remembering their former enmity.

4.61.s:
nānārūpadharā devī avatīrya punaḥpunaḥ ..
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya nijaghne daityasattamān .. 2 ..
4.61.d:
नानारूपधरा देवी अवतीर्य पुनःपुनः ॥
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय निजघ्ने दैत्यसत्तमान् ॥ 2 ॥
4.61.m: Assuming various forms and descending again and again / in order to establish righteousness, the Goddess struck down the foremost Daityas.

4.61.s:
atha raktāsuro nāma mahiṣasya suto mahān ..
āsīttena tapastaptaṃ varṣāṇāṃ niyutāni ṣaṭ ..
tasmai dadau caturvaktro rājyaṃ trailokyamaṇḍale .. 3 ..
4.61.d:
अथ रक्तासुरो नाम महिषस्य सुतो महान् ॥
आसीत्तेन तपस्तप्तं वर्षाणां नियुतानि षट् ॥
तस्मै ददौ चतुर्वक्त्रो राज्यं त्रैलोक्यमण्डले ॥ 3 ॥
4.61.m: Then there was a great son of Mahiṣa named Raktāsura; / he performed austerities for six hundred thousand years. / The Four-Faced [Brahmā] granted him sovereignty over the circle of the three worlds.

4.61.s:
tena labdhaṃ vareṇātha melayitvā danoḥ sutān ..
prārabdhaṃ saha śakreṇa yuddhaṃ gatvā'marāvatīm .. 4 ..
4.61.d:
तेन लब्धं वरेणाथ मेलयित्वा दनोः सुतान् ॥
प्रारब्धं सह शक्रेण युद्धं गत्वाऽमरावतीम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.61.m: Having obtained [it] through that boon, he assembled the sons of Danu, / went to Amarāvatī, and initiated a battle with Śakra.

4.61.s:
taddṛṣṭvā dānavabalaṃ sannaddhātyuddhatadhvajam ..
yuyudhe dānavaiḥ sārddhaṃ suraiḥ śakrapurassaraiḥ .. 5 ..
4.61.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा दानवबलं सन्नद्धात्युद्धतध्वजम् ॥
युयुधे दानवैः सार्द्धं सुरैः शक्रपुरस्सरैः ॥ 5 ॥
4.61.m: Beholding that Dānava army, arrayed for battle with exceedingly raised banners, / the gods, led by Śakra, fought together with the Dānavas.

4.61.s:
tatra prāvartata nadī śoṇitaughataraṃgiṇī ..
khaḍgamatsyagadāgrāhavasunaṃdakakacchapā ..
vahaṃtī pitṛlokāya surāsurabhayānakā .. 6 ..
4.61.d:
तत्र प्रावर्तत नदी शोणितौघतरंगिणी ॥
खड्गमत्स्यगदाग्राहवसुनंदककच्छपा ॥
वहंती पितृलोकाय सुरासुरभयानका ॥ 6 ॥
4.61.m: There flowed a river rippling with floods of blood, / with swords as fish, maces as alligators, and Nandaka swords as turtles, / flowing toward the world of the ancestors, terrifying to gods and asuras.

4.61.s:
atha raktāsuro roṣādyuyudhe vibudhaiḥ saha ..
te hanyamānā vibudhā raktākṣeṇa mahāraṇe .. 7 ..
4.61.d:
अथ रक्तासुरो रोषाद्युयुधे विबुधैः सह ॥
ते हन्यमाना विबुधा रक्ताक्षेण महारणे ॥ 7 ॥
4.61.m: Then Raktāsura furiously fought with the gods; / those gods, being struck down in the great battle by the red-eyed one,

4.61.s:
bhraṣṭāḥ svargaṃ parityajya tyaktapraharaṇā drutam ..
karacchatrāṃ purīṃ prāptā yatrāste bhavavallabhā .. 8 ..
4.61.d:
भ्रष्टाः स्वर्गं परित्यज्य त्यक्तप्रहरणा द्रुतम् ॥
करच्छत्रां पुरीं प्राप्ता यत्रास्ते भववल्लभा ॥ 8 ॥
4.61.m: fled, abandoning heaven and quickly throwing down their weapons; / they reached the city Karacchatrā, where the beloved of Bhava resides,

4.61.s:
durgā cāmuṇḍayā sārdhaṃ navadurgāsamanvitā ..
ādyā tāvanmahālakṣmīrnaṃdā kṣemakarī tathā .. 9 ..
4.61.d:
दुर्गा चामुण्डया सार्धं नवदुर्गासमन्विता ॥
आद्या तावन्महालक्ष्मीर्नंदा क्षेमकरी तथा ॥ 9 ॥
4.61.m: Durgā, together with Cāmuṇḍā, accompanied by the nine Durgās: / first Mahālakṣmī, then Nandā, and Kṣemaṅkarī,

4.61.s:
śivadūtī mahāruṇḍā bhrāmarī rudramaṃgalā ..
revatī harasiddhistu navaitāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
etāsāṃ te stutiṃ cakrustridaśāḥ praṇatānanāḥ .. 4.61.10 ..
4.61.d:
शिवदूती महारुण्डा भ्रामरी रुद्रमंगला ॥
रेवती हरसिद्धिस्तु नवैताः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
एतासां ते स्तुतिं चक्रुस्त्रिदशाः प्रणताननाः ॥ 4.61.10 ॥
4.61.m: Śivadūtī, Mahāruṇḍā, Bhrāmarī, Rudramaṅgalā, / Revatī, and Harasiddhi—these nine are proclaimed. / With bowed heads, the thirty [gods] made a hymn of praise to them:

4.61.s:
amarapatimukuṭacumbitacaraṇāṃbujasakalabhuvanasukhajananī ..
jayati jagadīśavaṃditā sakalāmalaniṣkalā durgā .. 11 ..
4.61.d:
अमरपतिमुकुटचुम्बितचरणांबुजसकलभुवनसुखजननी ॥
जयति जगदीशवंदिता सकलामलनिष्कला दुर्गा ॥ 11 ॥
4.61.m: "Victorious is Durgā, whose lotus feet are kissed by the crown of the lord of the immortals, who produces happiness for all the worlds, / who is revered by the Lord of the Universe, complete, spotless, and without parts.

4.61.s:
vikṛtanakhadaśanabhūṣaṇarudhiravaśācchuritakṣatakhaḍgahastā ..
jayati naramuṃḍamuṃḍitapiśita surāhārakṛccaṇḍī .. 12 ..
4.61.d:
विकृतनखदशनभूषणरुधिरवशाच्छुरितक्षतखड्गहस्ता ॥
जयति नरमुंडमुंडितपिशित सुराहारकृच्चण्डी ॥ 12 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is Caṇḍī, whose ornaments are deformed claws and teeth, whose hand holds a sword wounded and smeared with blood and fat, / who is adorned with a garland of human heads and partakes of flesh and wine.

4.61.s:
pracchāditaśikhigaṇodbalavikaṭajaṭābaddhacandramaṇiśobhā ..
jayati digaṃbarabhūṣā siddhavaṭeśā mahālakṣmīḥ .. 13 ..
4.61.d:
प्रच्छादितशिखिगणोद्बलविकटजटाबद्धचन्द्रमणिशोभा ॥
जयति दिगंबरभूषा सिद्धवटेशा महालक्ष्मीः ॥ 13 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is Mahālakṣmī, adorned with space as her garments, the mistress of Siddhavaṭa, / whose beauty bears the moon-jewel bound in fierce, heavy matted hair covered with blazing fires.

4.61.s:
karakamalajanitaśobhā padmāsanabaddhapadmavadanā ca ..
jayati kamaṇḍaluhastā naṃdā devī natārtiharā .. 14 ..
4.61.d:
करकमलजनितशोभा पद्मासनबद्धपद्मवदना च ॥
जयति कमण्डलुहस्ता नंदा देवी नतार्तिहरा ॥ 14 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is goddess Nandā, who dispels the distress of the bowed, / whose beauty arises from the lotus in her hand, who sits in the lotus posture with a lotus-face, holding a water-pot in her hand.

4.61.s:
digvasanā vikṛtamukhā phetkāroddāma pūritadiśaughā ..
jayati vikarāladehā kṣemaṃkarī raudrabhāvasthā .. 15 ..
4.61.d:
दिग्वसना विकृतमुखा फेत्कारोद्दाम पूरितदिशौघा ॥
जयति विकरालदेहा क्षेमंकरी रौद्रभावस्था ॥ 15 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is Kṣemaṅkarī, clad in the directions, with a distorted face, filling the hosts of quarters with unrestrained howling, / of dreadful body, abiding in a furious mood.

4.61.s:
krośitabrahmāṃḍodarasuravaramukharahuṃkṛtaninādā ..
jayati madātimihastā śivadūtī prathamaśivaśaktiḥ .. 16 ..
4.61.d:
क्रोशितब्रह्मांडोदरसुरवरमुखरहुंकृतनिनादा ॥
जयति मदातिमिहस्ता शिवदूती प्रथमशिवशक्तिः ॥ 16 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is Śivadūtī, the primordial power of Śiva, holding […] in her hand, / who roars through the belly of the universe, noisy with the bellows of the foremost gods.

4.61.s:
muktāṭṭahāsabhairavaduḥsahataracakitasakaladikcakrā ..
jayati bhujagendramaṇiśobhitakarṇā mahātuṇḍā .. 17 ..
4.61.d:
मुक्ताट्टहासभैरवदुःसहतरचकितसकलदिक्चक्रा ॥
जयति भुजगेन्द्रमणिशोभितकर्णा महातुण्डा ॥ 17 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is Mahātuṇḍā, whose ears are adorned with the jewel of the king of serpents, / who frightens the entire circle of directions, unbearable and terrifying with her loose, loud laughter.

4.61.s:
paṭupaṭahamurajamardalajhallarijhaṅkāranartitāvayavā ..
jayati madhuvratarūpā daityaharī bhrāmarī devī .. 18 ..
4.61.d:
पटुपटहमुरजमर्दलझल्लरिझङ्कारनर्तितावयवा ॥
जयति मधुव्रतरूपा दैत्यहरी भ्रामरी देवी ॥ 18 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is goddess Bhrāmarī, having the form of a black bee, destroyer of Daityas, / whose limbs dance to the sound of loud paṭaha drums, murajas, mardalas, and jhallarīs.

4.61.s:
śāṃtā praśāṃtavadanā siṃhavarā dhyānayogata nniṣṭhā ..
jayati caturbhujadehā candrakalā candramaṇḍalā devī .. 19 ..
4.61.d:
शांता प्रशांतवदना सिंहवरा ध्यानयोगत न्निष्ठा ॥
जयति चतुर्भुजदेहा चन्द्रकला चन्द्रमण्डला देवी ॥ 19 ॥
4.61.m: Victorious is the tranquil goddess, with a serene countenance, seated on an excellent lion, intent upon the practice of meditation, / having a four-armed body, a crescent moon, and the lunar disc.

4.61.s:
pakṣapuṭacaṃcughātaiḥ saṃcūrṇitavividhaśatrusaṃghātā ..
jayati śitaśūlahastā bahurūpā revatī bhadrā ..4.61.20..
4.61.d:
पक्षपुटचंचुघातैः संचूर्णितविविधशत्रुसंघाता ॥
जयति शितशूलहस्ता बहुरूपा रेवती भद्रा ॥4.61.20॥
4.61.m: Victorious is auspicious Revatī of multiform shape, holding a sharp pike in her hand, / who crushes the hosts of various enemies with blows from her wings and beak.

4.61.s:
paryaṭati jagati haṣṭā pitṛvananilayeṣu yoginīsahitā..
jayati harasiddhināmnī harasiddhirvaṃditā siddhaiḥ ..21..
4.61.d:
पर्यटति जगति हष्टा पितृवननिलयेषु योगिनीसहिता॥
जयति हरसिद्धिनाम्नी हरसिद्धिर्वंदिता सिद्धैः ॥21॥
4.61.m: Rejoicing, she wanders through the world accompanied by yoginīs in the abodes of cremation grounds; / victorious is Harasiddhi, named Harasiddhi, praised by the Siddhas."

4.61.s:
iti navadurgāsaṃstavamanupamamāryābhirapararāṭ kṛtvā ..
idamūce saha devaistrāhyasmānsarvabhītibhyaḥ .. 22 ..
4.61.d:
इति नवदुर्गासंस्तवमनुपममार्याभिरपरराट् कृत्वा ॥
इदमूचे सह देवैस्त्राह्यस्मान्सर्वभीतिभ्यः ॥ 22 ॥
4.61.m: Having thus made this peerless praise of the nine Durgās with Āryā verses, the king [of the gods] / along with the gods spoke this: "Protect us from all terrors!"

4.61.s:
punaḥpunaḥ praṇamyocurbhavānīṃ siṃhavāhinīm ..
asmākaṃ bhayabhītānāṃ śaraṇye śaraṇaṃ bhava .. 23 ..
4.61.d:
पुनःपुनः प्रणम्योचुर्भवानीं सिंहवाहिनीम् ॥
अस्माकं भयभीतानां शरण्ये शरणं भव ॥ 23 ॥
4.61.m: Bowing again and again, they said to Bhavānī, who rides a lion: / "To us who are terrified with fear, O refuge, be our refuge!"

4.61.s:
devānāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā dattvā tebhyo'bhayaṃ tataḥ ..
siṃhārūḍhā vinirgatya durgābhiḥ sahitā purā .. 24 ..
4.61.d:
देवानां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा दत्त्वा तेभ्योऽभयं ततः ॥
सिंहारूढा विनिर्गत्य दुर्गाभिः सहिता पुरा ॥ 24 ॥
4.61.m: Hearing that speech of the gods and granting them fearlessness, / mounted upon her lion, she then went forth anciently accompanied by the Durgās.

4.61.s:
yuyudhe dānavaissārdhaṃ mahāsamaradurdinam ..
kumārī viṃśatibhujā ghanavidyullatopamā .. 25 ..
4.61.d:
युयुधे दानवैस्सार्धं महासमरदुर्दिनम् ॥
कुमारी विंशतिभुजा घनविद्युल्लतोपमा ॥ 25 ॥
4.61.m: She fought together with the Dānavas on a stormy day of great battle, / a maiden with twenty arms, resembling a streak of lightning in a cloud.

4.61.s:
te'pi tatrāsurāḥ prāptāḥ pracaṃḍā rudrarūpiṇaḥ ..
sarve labdhavarāḥ śūrāḥ sutaptatapasastathā .. 26 ..
4.61.d:
तेऽपि तत्रासुराः प्राप्ताः प्रचंडा रुद्ररूपिणः ॥
सर्वे लब्धवराः शूराः सुतप्ततपसस्तथा ॥ 26 ॥
4.61.m: Those asuras too arrived there, furious, of terrible forms like Rudra, / all having obtained boons, heroic, and having performed intense austerities.

4.61.s:
mahāgrāhaparākrāṃtā duṣṭamāyāvinaṣṭaye ..
abrāhmaṇyāddhṛdyamiṣā nāmataśca nijodyatāt .. 27 ..
4.61.d:
महाग्राहपराक्रांता दुष्टमायाविनष्टये ॥
अब्राह्मण्याद्धृद्यमिषा नामतश्च निजोद्यतात् ॥ 27 ॥
4.61.m: Possessed of the prowess of great monsters, for the destruction of wicked illusions, / [they marched forth,] designated by their own names [in battle]:

4.61.s:
indramārī asatkleśaḥ pralaṃbo narakaḥ sutaḥ ..
kuṣṭhaḥ pulomā śarabha śaṃbaro duṃdubhiḥ kharaḥ .. 28 ..
4.61.d:
इन्द्रमारी असत्क्लेशः प्रलंबो नरकः सुतः ॥
कुष्ठः पुलोमा शरभ शंबरो दुंदुभिः खरः ॥ 28 ॥
4.61.m: Indramārin, Asatkleśa, Pralamba, Naraka, Suta, / Kuṣṭha, Puloman, Śarabha, Śambara, Dundubhi, Khara,

4.61.s:
ilvalo namucirbhaumo vātāpi dhenukaḥ kaliḥ ..
māyāvṛtau balau bandhurmadhukaiṭabhakālajit .. 29 ..
4.61.d:
इल्वलो नमुचिर्भौमो वातापि धेनुकः कलिः ॥
मायावृतौ बलौ बन्धुर्मधुकैटभकालजित् ॥ 29 ॥
4.61.m: Ilvala, Namuci, Bhauma, Vātāpi, Dhenuka, Kali, / the two Balas wrapped in illusion, Bandhu, Madhu, Kaiṭabha, Kālajit,

4.61.s:
rahaḥ pauṃḍūādidaityendrāḥ prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ ..
phanagobhirjanāḥ sarve sannaddhāḥ svāgrato dhvajaḥ .. 4.61.30 ..
4.61.d:
रहः पौंडूआदिदैत्येन्द्राः प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
फनगोभिर्जनाः सर्वे सन्नद्धाः स्वाग्रतो ध्वजः ॥ 4.61.30 ॥
4.61.m: Rahas, Pauṇḍra, and other lords of the Daityas are proclaimed as foremost. / All the men were armed […], with banners in front of them.

4.61.s:
rūpato varṇitāścaiva dhvajāsteṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
pratyadṛśyaṃta rājendra jvalitā iva pāvakāḥ .. 31 ..
4.61.d:
रूपतो वर्णिताश्चैव ध्वजास्तेषां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
प्रत्यदृश्यंत राजेन्द्र ज्वलिता इव पावकाः ॥ 31 ॥
4.61.m: Their banners, described distinctively according to their form, / were seen, O lord of kings, blazing like fires:

4.61.s:
kāñcanāḥ kāñcanā pīḍāḥ kāñcanasragalaṃkṛtāḥ ..
patākā vividhairvālairucchritā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ .. 32 ..
4.61.d:
काञ्चनाः काञ्चना पीडाः काञ्चनस्रगलंकृताः ॥
पताका विविधैर्वालैरुच्छ्रिता लक्षणान्विताः ॥ 32 ॥
4.61.m: golden, adorned with golden chaplets, decorated with golden garlands, / their flags raised high with various tufts of hair and marked with symbols,

4.61.s:
nīlyaḥ pītāḥ sitā raktāḥ kṛṣṇāsrāḥ pañcavarṇakāḥ ..
tatra paṭṭapaṭīsautrāḥ kṛtabudbudakarburāḥ .. 33 ..
4.61.d:
नील्यः पीताः सिता रक्ताः कृष्णास्राः पञ्चवर्णकाः ॥
तत्र पट्टपटीसौत्राः कृतबुद्बुदकर्बुराः ॥ 33 ॥
4.61.m: blue, yellow, white, red, black, and five-colored; / there were banners made of silk, patterned with spots and variegated bubbles.

4.61.s: patākākāntiranalā nartakya iva śobhanāḥ .. 34 ..
4.61.d: पताकाकान्तिरनला नर्तक्य इव शोभनाः ॥ 34 ॥
4.61.m: The brilliant banners were like beautiful dancing girls.

4.61.s:
tato halahalārāvaṃ cakruste dānavottamāḥ ..
prāsphālayaṃta paṇavabherījharjharagomukhān ..
nyavādayaṃtānakānye śaṃkhāḍaṃbaraḍiṃḍimān .. 35 ..
4.61.d:
ततो हलहलारावं चक्रुस्ते दानवोत्तमाः ॥
प्रास्फालयंत पणवभेरीझर्झरगोमुखान् ॥
न्यवादयंतानकान्ये शंखाडंबरडिंडिमान् ॥ 35 ॥
4.61.m: Then those foremost Dānavas raised a loud shouting tumult; / they beat paṇavas, kettledrums, jharjharas, and gomukhas; / others sounded drums, conches, dundubhis, and ḍiṇḍimas.

4.61.s:
evaṃ te samayudhyaṃta bhavānīṃ daityadānavāḥ ..
samājaghnuḥ śaraiḥ śūlaiḥ parighaiḥ śaktitomaraiḥ ..
karṇakairīṣaṇaiḥ kuntaiḥ śataghnīkūṭamudgaraiḥ .. 36 ..
4.61.d:
एवं ते समयुध्यंत भवानीं दैत्यदानवाः ॥
समाजघ्नुः शरैः शूलैः परिघैः शक्तितोमरैः ॥
कर्णकैरीषणैः कुन्तैः शतघ्नीकूटमुद्गरैः ॥ 36 ॥
4.61.m: Thus those Daityas and Dānavas fought against Bhavānī; / they struck with arrows, spears, iron clubs, śaktis, and javelins, / with karṇakas, īṣaṇas, lances, śataghnīs, and kūṭamudgaras.

4.61.s:
āhatya mānaroṣeṇa jajvaluḥ samare'dhikam ..
siṃhārūḍhā drutaṃ devī raṇamadhye pradhāvitā .. 37 ..
4.61.d:
आहत्य मानरोषेण जज्वलुः समरेऽधिकम् ॥
सिंहारूढा द्रुतं देवी रणमध्ये प्रधाविता ॥ 37 ॥
4.61.m: Struck with pride and rage, they flared up exceedingly in the battle; / mounted on her lion, the Goddess swiftly rushed into the midst of the battle.

4.61.s:
ācchidyācchidya cihnāni dhvajānnānāvidhāṃstathā ..
balātkāreṇa daityānāmanāthasamare ruṣā .. 38 ..
4.61.d:
आच्छिद्याच्छिद्य चिह्नानि ध्वजान्नानाविधांस्तथा ॥
बलात्कारेण दैत्यानामनाथसमरे रुषा ॥ 38 ॥
4.61.m: Repeatedly tearing away the insignias and the diverse banners / of the Daityas by force in that helpless battle with fury,

4.61.s:
cihnakāni dadau tuṣṭā devebhyaḥ śīghracāriṇī ..
surairapi gṛhītāni jaya devīti vādibhiḥ ..39..
4.61.d:
चिह्नकानि ददौ तुष्टा देवेभ्यः शीघ्रचारिणी ॥
सुरैरपि गृहीतानि जय देवीति वादिभिः ॥39॥
4.61.m: moving swiftly, pleased, she gave the insignias to the gods; / they too were taken by the gods, who proclaimed, "Victory, O Goddess!"

4.61.s:
aṃbikā tu bhṛśaṃ tuṣṭā teṣāṃ cakre kṣaṇātkṣayam ..
kālarātrī dānavānāṃ mārīva nipapāta sā ..
jīvitāni ca jagrāha daityānāṃ devanaṃdinī ..4.61.40..
4.61.d:
अंबिका तु भृशं तुष्टा तेषां चक्रे क्षणात्क्षयम् ॥
कालरात्री दानवानां मारीव निपपात सा ॥
जीवितानि च जग्राह दैत्यानां देवनंदिनी ॥4.61.40॥
4.61.m: Ambikā, exceedingly pleased, brought about their destruction in an instant; / like the Night of Time, she descended upon the Dānavas like a plague, / and she, who brings joy to the gods, seized the lives of the Daityas.

4.61.s:
atha raktāsuraṃ kaṃṭhe gṛhītvāpātya bhūtale ..
devī jaghāna tīkṣṇena triśūlena bhṛśaṃ divi .. 41 ..
4.61.d:
अथ रक्तासुरं कंठे गृहीत्वापात्य भूतले ॥
देवी जघान तीक्ष्णेन त्रिशूलेन भृशं दिवि ॥ 41 ॥
4.61.m: Then, seizing Raktāsura by the throat and hurling him down to the surface of the earth, / the Goddess struck him fiercely in the sky with her sharp trident.

4.61.s:
sa bhinnahṛdayaḥ paścādbhūmau tatra prapothitaḥ ..
tathāpi devyā nihataḥ papāta ca mamāra ca .. 42 ..
4.61.d:
स भिन्नहृदयः पश्चाद्भूमौ तत्र प्रपोथितः ॥
तथापि देव्या निहतः पपात च ममार च ॥ 42 ॥
4.61.m: With his heart pierced, he was subsequently dashed down there upon the ground; / nonetheless, struck down by the Goddess, he fell and died.

4.61.s:
devāstānasurāñjitvā gatvā śatrupuraṃ jitam ..
dadṛśuste raṇaprāṃte laṃbamānānmahādhvajān..
yātrāṃ cakruḥ saṃprahṛṣṭā navamyāṃ dhvajacihnitām .. 43 ..
4.61.d:
देवास्तानसुराञ्जित्वा गत्वा शत्रुपुरं जितम् ॥
ददृशुस्ते रणप्रांते लंबमानान्महाध्वजान्॥
यात्रां चक्रुः संप्रहृष्टा नवम्यां ध्वजचिह्निताम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.61.m: Having conquered those Asuras and gone to the enemy city that was won, the gods / saw great banners hanging at the edge of the battlefield; / overjoyed, they held a procession marked with banners on the navamī.

4.61.s:
atodyāpīha bhūpālairjayalabdhīcchayādṛtaiḥ ..
upoṣyate narairbhaktairnārībhiścaiva pāṃḍava .. 44 ..
4.61.d:
अतोद्यापीह भूपालैर्जयलब्धीच्छयादृतैः ॥
उपोष्यते नरैर्भक्तैर्नारीभिश्चैव पांडव ॥ 44 ॥
4.61.m: Therefore, even today here [on earth], with the desire to obtain victory, / a fast is observed with devotion by kings, men, and women, O Pāṇḍava.

4.61.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kīdṛgvidhānaṃ tasyāstu navamyā brūhi me prabho ..
sarahasyaṃ samaṃtraṃ ca yena tuṣyati caṃḍikā .. 45 ..
4.61.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कीदृग्विधानं तस्यास्तु नवम्या ब्रूहि मे प्रभो ॥
सरहस्यं समंत्रं च येन तुष्यति चंडिका ॥ 45 ॥
4.61.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me, O Lord, what is the procedure for that navamī, / together with its secret and mantras, by which Caṇḍikā is pleased?

4.61.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pauṣasya śuklapakṣe yā navamī saṃpariśrutā ..
tasyāṃ snātvā śubhaiḥ puṣpairarcanīyā hareḥ svasā .. 46 ..
4.61.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पौषस्य शुक्लपक्षे या नवमी संपरिश्रुता ॥
तस्यां स्नात्वा शुभैः पुष्पैरर्चनीया हरेः स्वसा ॥ 46 ॥
4.61.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / On that celebrated navamī in the bright fortnight of Pauṣa, / having bathed, one should worship the sister of Hari with auspicious flowers.

4.61.s:
kumārī subhagā devī siṃhasyaṃndanagāminī ..
dhvajānnānāvidhānkṛtvā purastasyāśca pūjayet ..
mālatīkusumairddīpairgandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ .. 47 ..
4.61.d:
कुमारी सुभगा देवी सिंहस्यंन्दनगामिनी ॥
ध्वजान्नानाविधान्कृत्वा पुरस्तस्याश्च पूजयेत् ॥
मालतीकुसुमैर्द्दीपैर्गन्धधूपविलेपनैः ॥ 47 ॥
4.61.m: Having made diverse banners for the maiden, the fortunate Goddess who rides a lion-chariot, / one should worship before her / with jasmine flowers, lamps, perfumes, incenses, and ointments,

4.61.s:
balibhiḥ paśubhirmedhyaiḥ surāmāṃsāsṛgambaraiḥ ..
dadhicandanacūrṇaiśca bhagnaiścānagnipācitaiḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya brahmaṇopyathavā nanu .. 48 ..
4.61.d:
बलिभिः पशुभिर्मेध्यैः सुरामांसासृगम्बरैः ॥
दधिचन्दनचूर्णैश्च भग्नैश्चानग्निपाचितैः ॥
मंत्रेणानेन कौंतेय ब्रह्मणोप्यथवा ननु ॥ 48 ॥
4.61.m: with offerings, with pure sacrificial beasts, wine, meat, blood, and garments, / with curd, sandalwood powder, and uncooked grains, / with this mantra, O son of Kuntī, or indeed with [the mantra] of Brahmā:

4.61.s:
bhadrāṃ bhagavatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ viśvasya jagato hitām ..
saṃveśinīṃ saṃyamanīṃ grahanakṣatra mālinīm .. 49 ..
4.61.d:
भद्रां भगवतीं कृष्णां विश्वस्य जगतो हिताम् ॥
संवेशिनीं संयमनीं ग्रहनक्षत्र मालिनीम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.61.m: "The auspicious, blessed, dark lady, beneficent to the whole world, / who puts all to rest, who restrains all, garlanded with planets and lunar mansions,

4.61.s:
prapannohaṃ śivāṃ rātrī bhadre pāraya me vratam ..
sarvabhūtapiśācebhyaḥ sarvasatvasarīsṛpaiḥ ..
devebhyo mānuṣebhyaśca bhayebhyo rakṣa māṃ sadā .. 4.61.50 ..
4.61.d:
प्रपन्नोहं शिवां रात्री भद्रे पारय मे व्रतम् ॥
सर्वभूतपिशाचेभ्यः सर्वसत्वसरीसृपैः ॥
देवेभ्यो मानुषेभ्यश्च भयेभ्यो रक्ष मां सदा ॥ 4.61.50 ॥
4.61.m: to that auspicious night have I surrendered; O auspicious one, bring my votive observance to completion! / From all ghosts and piśācas, from all creatures and reptiles, / from gods and from humans, protect me always from all fears!"

4.61.s:
tataścāropayedrājā devīnāṃ bhavane tathā ..
bhojayeta kumārīṃ ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet .. 51 ..
4.61.d:
ततश्चारोपयेद्राजा देवीनां भवने तथा ॥
भोजयेत कुमारीं च प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥ 51 ॥
4.61.m: Then the king should raise [the banners] at the temple of the goddesses; / he should also feed a maiden, and bow down to seek her pardon.

4.61.s:
upavāsena kurvīta ekabhaktena vā punaḥ ..
bhaktyā bhūpālapañcāsya bhaktistasyā garīyasī .. 52 ..
4.61.d:
उपवासेन कुर्वीत एकभक्तेन वा पुनः ॥
भक्त्या भूपालपञ्चास्य भक्तिस्तस्या गरीयसी ॥ 52 ॥
4.61.m: He should perform [it] with fasting, or with a single meal, / with devotion, O lion among kings; devotion to her is the highest.

4.61.s:
evaṃ ye pūjayiṣyaṃti dhvajairbhagavatīṃ narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ durgā durgamārge coravyālāgni saṃkaṭe ..53..
4.61.d:
एवं ये पूजयिष्यंति ध्वजैर्भगवतीं नराः ॥
तेषां दुर्गा दुर्गमार्गे चोरव्यालाग्नि संकटे ॥53॥
4.61.m: Those men who worship the Blessed Lady with banners in this way, / for them Durgā, on a difficult path, in danger from thieves, venomous serpents, or fire,

4.61.s:
raṇe rājakule gehe yuddhamadhye jale sthite ..
rakṣāṃ karoti satataṃ bhavānī sarvamaṃgalā..54..
4.61.d:
रणे राजकुले गेहे युद्धमध्ये जले स्थिते ॥
रक्षां करोति सततं भवानी सर्वमंगला॥54॥
4.61.m: in battle, in the royal assembly, at home, in the midst of war, or when stranded in water, / Bhavānī, who is all-auspicious, ever provides protection.

4.61.s:
asyāṃ babhūva vijayo navamyāṃ pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
bhagavatyāstu tenaiṣā navamī satataṃ priyā .. 55 ..
4.61.d:
अस्यां बभूव विजयो नवम्यां पांडुनंदन ॥
भगवत्यास्तु तेनैषा नवमी सततं प्रिया ॥ 55 ॥
4.61.m: On this navamī the victory of the Blessed Lady occurred, O joy of Pāṇḍu; / therefore, this navamī is ever dear to her.

4.61.s:
dhanyā puṇyā pāpaharā sarvopadravanāśanī ..
anuṣṭheyā prayatnena sarvānkāmānabhīpsubhiḥ ..56..
4.61.d:
धन्या पुण्या पापहरा सर्वोपद्रवनाशनी ॥
अनुष्ठेया प्रयत्नेन सर्वान्कामानभीप्सुभिः ॥56॥
4.61.m: Auspicious, meritorious, dispelling sin, and destroying all afflictions, / it should be performed with effort by those who desire all objects of wish.

4.61.s:
devyarcanāhitamatirmanujo navamyāṃ hemasrajaṃ dhvajavaraṃ sa hi ropayedyaḥ ..
bhogānavāpya manasobhimatānprakāmaṃ dehaṃ vihāya samupaiti sa vīralokam .. 57 ..
ulkānavamīvratavarṇanam
4.61.d:
देव्यर्चनाहितमतिर्मनुजो नवम्यां हेमस्रजं ध्वजवरं स हि रोपयेद्यः ॥
भोगानवाप्य मनसोभिमतान्प्रकामं देहं विहाय समुपैति स वीरलोकम् ॥ 57 ॥
उल्कानवमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.61.m:
That man who, with a mind intent on worshipping the Goddess, raises on the navamī an excellent banner with a golden garland, / having abundantly attained the pleasures desired by his heart, on casting off his body, goes to the world of heroes.
Description of the Meteor Navamī Votive Observance

4.62.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. .
ulkākhyaṃ navamīṃ rājankathayāmi nibodha tām ..
yā kāśyapena kathitā tārakasyārtināśinī ..1..
4.62.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ।
उल्काख्यं नवमीं राजन्कथयामि निबोध ताम् ॥
या काश्यपेन कथिता तारकस्यार्तिनाशिनी ॥1॥
4.62.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / O King, I shall proclaim the navamī named Meteor; hear of it, / which was taught by Kaśyapa as destroying the distress of Tāraka.

4.62.s:
aśvayukchuklapakṣe yā navamī lokaviśrutā ..
nadyāṃ snātvā samabhyarcya pitṛdevīṃ yathāvidhi .. 2 ..
4.62.d:
अश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे या नवमी लोकविश्रुता ॥
नद्यां स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य पितृदेवीं यथाविधि ॥ 2 ॥
4.62.m: On the navamī world-renowned in the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja, / having bathed in a river and duly worshipped the ancestral goddess,
one should then worship the Goddess Cāmuṇḍā, dear to Bhairava, / with flowers, incenses, food offerings, meat, fish, and spirituous liquor.

4.62.s:
pūjayitvā stavaṃ kuryānmantreṇānena mānavaḥ ..
samāropyāñjaliṃ mūrdhni jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ .. 4 ..
4.62.d:
पूजयित्वा स्तवं कुर्यान्मन्त्रेणानेन मानवः ॥
समारोप्याञ्जलिं मूर्ध्नि जानुभ्यामवनीं गतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.62.m: Having worshipped her, a person should recite praise with this mantra, / placing folded hands upon the head, having fallen to the earth on both knees:

4.62.s:
mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālini ..
dravyamārogyavijayau dehi devi namo'stu te .. 5 ..
4.62.d:
महिषघ्नि महामाये चामुण्डे मुण्डमालिनि ॥
द्रव्यमारोग्यविजयौ देहि देवि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 5 ॥
4.62.m: "O slayer of Mahiṣa, O Mahāmāyā, O Cāmuṇḍā, O wearer of a garland of skulls, / grant wealth, health, and victory, O Goddess! Reverence to you!"
Then one should feed maidens, and having adorned [them] / with new blue bodices, garments, and ornaments, seek their pardon.

4.62.s:
sapta pañcāpyathaikāṃ vā cittavittānurūpataḥ ..
śraddhayā tuṣyate devī iti vīrānuśāsanam .. 7 ..
4.62.d:
सप्त पञ्चाप्यथैकां वा चित्तवित्तानुरूपतः ॥
श्रद्धया तुष्यते देवी इति वीरानुशासनम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.62.m: Seven, five, or even one, according to one's disposition and wealth; / the Goddess is pleased through faith: such is the ordinance of the heroes.

4.62.s:
abhyukṣya maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena śucismitaḥ ..
dattāsane copaviśetpātraṃ ca purato nyaset .. 8 ..
4.62.d:
अभ्युक्ष्य मण्डलं कृत्वा गोमयेन शुचिस्मितः ॥
दत्तासने चोपविशेत्पात्रं च पुरतो न्यसेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.62.m: Having sprinkled water and made a sacred diagram with cow dung, smiling brightly, / one should sit on a seat provided and place a vessel in front.

4.62.s:
tataḥ susiddhamannaṃ yattatsarvaṃ pariveṣayet ..
saghṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ cāpi sthāpayetpātrasa nnidhau .. 9 ..
4.62.d:
ततः सुसिद्धमन्नं यत्तत्सर्वं परिवेषयेत् ॥
सघृतं पायसं चापि स्थापयेत्पात्रस न्निधौ ॥ 9 ॥
4.62.m: Then one should serve all of the well-cooked food, / and also place milk-rice with clarified butter near the vessel.

4.62.s:
tṛṇāni ṣaṣṭimādāya cādāya dhamanīṃ tathā ..
prajvālayettatto bhojyaṃ yāvajjvalati pāvakaḥ .. 4.62.10 ..
4.62.d:
तृणानि षष्टिमादाय चादाय धमनीं तथा ॥
प्रज्वालयेत्तत्तो भोज्यं यावज्ज्वलति पावकः ॥ 4.62.10 ॥
4.62.m: Taking sixty blades of grass and also taking a reed, / one should kindle it, and then eat as long as the fire burns.

4.62.s:
praśāṃte bhojanaṃ tyaktvā samācamya prasannadhīḥ ..
cāmuṃḍāṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā gṛhakṛtyaparo bhavet .. 11 ..
4.62.d:
प्रशांते भोजनं त्यक्त्वा समाचम्य प्रसन्नधीः ॥
चामुंडां हृदये ध्यात्वा गृहकृत्यपरो भवेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.62.m: When it has subsided, one should cease eating, perform sipping, and with a serene mind, / meditating upon Cāmuṇḍā in one's heart, attend to one's household duties.

4.62.s:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret ..
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte bhoja yitvā kumārikāḥ .. 12 ..
4.62.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं मासिमासि समाचरेत् ॥
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते भोज यित्वा कुमारिकाः ॥ 12 ॥
4.62.m: By this procedure one should perform everything month after month; / then, at the end of the year, having fed maidens,

4.62.s:
vastrairābharaṇaiḥ pūjya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet..
suvarṇaṃ śaktito dadyādgāṃ ca viprāya śobhanām .. 13 ..
4.62.d:
वस्त्रैराभरणैः पूज्य प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत्॥
सुवर्णं शक्तितो दद्याद्गां च विप्राय शोभनाम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.62.m: and worshipped [them] with clothes and ornaments, one should bow down and seek pardon; / one should give gold according to one's capacity, and a fine cow to a Brahmin.

4.62.s:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha puruṣo navamīvratam ..
na tasya śatravo nārtiḥ sa rājā naṣṭataskaraḥ .. 14 ..
4.62.d:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ पुरुषो नवमीव्रतम् ॥
न तस्य शत्रवो नार्तिः स राजा नष्टतस्करः ॥ 14 ॥
4.62.m: The man who thus performs this navamī votive observance, O son of Pṛthā, / has no enemies and no distress; [if] a king, his thieves are vanished.

4.62.s:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācā no janayaṃti bhayaṃ gṛhe ..
samudyateṣu śastreṣu haṃtā tasya na vidyate .. 15 ..
4.62.d:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचा नो जनयंति भयं गृहे ॥
समुद्यतेषु शस्त्रेषु हंता तस्य न विद्यते ॥ 15 ॥
4.62.m: Ghosts, pretas, and piśācas do not produce fear in his house; / when weapons are raised, there is no slayer of him.

4.62.s:
taṃ rakṣati sadodyuktā sarvāsvāpatsu caṃḍikā ..
naro vā yadi vā nārī vratametatsamācaret ..
ulkāvatsa sapatnānāṃ jvalannāste sadā hṛdi .. 16 ..
4.62.d:
तं रक्षति सदोद्युक्ता सर्वास्वापत्सु चंडिका ॥
नरो वा यदि वा नारी व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥
उल्कावत्स सपत्नानां ज्वलन्नास्ते सदा हृदि ॥ 16 ॥
4.62.m: Ever alert, Caṇḍikā protects him in all misfortunes; / if a man or a woman should perform this votive observance, / he ever dwells blazing like a meteor in the hearts of his rivals.

4.62.s:
tāṃ śuṣkakoharamukhīṃ prakaṭorudaṃṣṭrāṃ kāpālinīṃ samavalaṃbitamuṇḍamālām ..
uktavrateṣu puruṣo navamīṣu caṇḍīṃ saṃpūjya kasya hṛdaye na ca śaṃ karoti.. 17 ..
daśāvatāracaritravratavarṇanam
4.62.d:
तां शुष्ककोहरमुखीं प्रकटोरुदंष्ट्रां कापालिनीं समवलंबितमुण्डमालाम् ॥
उक्तव्रतेषु पुरुषो नवमीषु चण्डीं संपूज्य कस्य हृदये न च शं करोति॥ 17 ॥
दशावतारचरित्रव्रतवर्णनम्
4.62.m:
Having worshipped that Caṇḍī whose face has hollow, withered cheeks, whose large fangs are exposed, who bears a skull-cup, and who has a hanging garland of severed heads, / on the navamīs during the prescribed votive observances, in whose heart does a man not produce dread?
Description of the Votive Observance on the Deeds of the Ten Avatāras

4.63.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pūrvaṃ kṛtayugasyādau bhṛgorbhāryā mahāsatī ..
divyārāmāśrame ramyā gṛhakāryaikatatparā .. 1 ..
4.63.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पूर्वं कृतयुगस्यादौ भृगोर्भार्या महासती ॥
दिव्यारामाश्रमे रम्या गृहकार्यैकतत्परा ॥ 1 ॥
4.63.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, at the beginning of the Kṛta age, the wife of Bhṛgu, a most virtuous woman, / charming in the hermitage of Divyārāma, was devoted solely to household duties.

4.63.s:
babhūva sā bhṛgornityaṃ hṛdayepsitakāriṇī ..
tasyāṃ munirmahātejā agnihotraṃ nidhāya ca .. 2 ..
4.63.d:
बभूव सा भृगोर्नित्यं हृदयेप्सितकारिणी ॥
तस्यां मुनिर्महातेजा अग्निहोत्रं निधाय च ॥ 2 ॥
4.63.m: She continually carried out what was desired in Bhṛgu's heart. / Having placed his agnihotra fire with her, the sage of great splendour,

4.63.s:
viṣṇostrāsāddānavānāṃ kulatrāṇasamākulam ..
muktvā yuddhasthitaṃ pārśve samarpya munipuṅgavaḥ .. 3 ..
4.63.d:
विष्णोस्त्रासाद्दानवानां कुलत्राणसमाकुलम् ॥
मुक्त्वा युद्धस्थितं पार्श्वे समर्प्य मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥ 3 ॥
4.63.m: troubled for the protection of the race of the Dānavas out of fear of Viṣṇu, / after leaving them standing by in battle and entrusting them [to her], the foremost of sages,

4.63.s:
dattvā nikṣepakaṃ sarvaṃ divyāyai sumahātapāḥ ...
jagāma himavatpārśve haraṃ toṣayituṃ rahaḥ .. 4 ..
4.63.d:
दत्त्वा निक्षेपकं सर्वं दिव्यायै सुमहातपाः ॥।
जगाम हिमवत्पार्श्वे हरं तोषयितुं रहः ॥ 4 ॥
4.63.m: having given over the whole deposit to Divyā, he of very great ascetic heat / went to the slope of Himavat in secret to propitiate Hara.

4.63.s:
saṃjīvanīkṛte nityaṃ kaṇairdhūmamadhomukhaḥ ..
papau dānavarājasya vijayāya purohitaḥ .. 5 ..
4.63.d:
संजीवनीकृते नित्यं कणैर्धूममधोमुखः ॥
पपौ दानवराजस्य विजयाय पुरोहितः ॥ 5 ॥
4.63.m: Hanging head downwards, he continually drank smoke with specks [of fire] for the sake of the Saṃjīvanī [lore], / for the victory of the Dānava king, as his family priest.

4.63.s:
ājagāma gate tasmingaruḍenāśrito hariḥ ..
abhyetya jalpanaṃ cakre cakraṇotkṛttakaṃdharam .. 6 ..
4.63.d:
आजगाम गते तस्मिन्गरुडेनाश्रितो हरिः ॥
अभ्येत्य जल्पनं चक्रे चक्रणोत्कृत्तकंधरम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.63.m: When he had gone, Hari, mounted upon Garuḍa, arrived. / Approaching, he cut off the necks with his discus [even as] talk was made.

4.63.s:
galadrudhirasaṃpannaṃ lohitārṇavavasaṃnibham ..
dṛṣṭvāsurabalaṃ sarvaṃ nihataṃ viṣṇunā tadā ..
divyā saṃśaptukāmābhūdviṣṇuṃ sāsrāvilekṣaṇā .. 7 ..
4.63.d:
गलद्रुधिरसंपन्नं लोहितार्णववसंनिभम् ॥
दृष्ट्वासुरबलं सर्वं निहतं विष्णुना तदा ॥
दिव्या संशप्तुकामाभूद्विष्णुं सास्राविलेक्षणा ॥ 7 ॥
4.63.m: Flowing with blood, resembling a red ocean, / seeing all the Asura army slain by Viṣṇu then, / Divyā, her eyes clouded with tears, wished to curse Viṣṇu.

4.63.s:
yāvannoccarate vācaṃ cakreṇa kṛttakaṃdharam ..
tāvannipātayāmāsa śirastasyāḥ sakuṇḍalam .. 8 ..
4.63.d:
यावन्नोच्चरते वाचं चक्रेण कृत्तकंधरम् ॥
तावन्निपातयामास शिरस्तस्याः सकुण्डलम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.63.m: Before she could utter a word, with his discus he severed her neck, / and struck down her head adorned with earrings.

4.63.s:
prāpya saṃjīvanīṃ vidyāṃ yāvadāyātyasau muniḥ ..
tāvatsa daityānnāpaśyatpaśyati sma nipātitam .. 9 ..
4.63.d:
प्राप्य संजीवनीं विद्यां यावदायात्यसौ मुनिः ॥
तावत्स दैत्यान्नापश्यत्पश्यति स्म निपातितम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.63.m: When that sage returned, having obtained the Saṃjīvanī lore, / he did not see the Daityas, [but] saw [her] struck down.

4.63.s:
roṣācchaśāpa ca hariṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ..
avaśyabhāvabhāvitvādviśvasya hitakāraṇāt .. 4.63.10 ..
4.63.d:
रोषाच्छशाप च हरिं भ्रुकुटीकुटिलाननः ॥
अवश्यभावभावित्वाद्विश्वस्य हितकारणात् ॥ 4.63.10 ॥
4.63.m: And in his wrath, his face twisted in a frown, he cursed Hari / because it was destined to happen and for the sake of the welfare of the universe:

4.63.s:
yasmāttvayā hatā daityā brahmaṇo matparigrahāḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣe loke daśa vārāngamiṣyasi .. 11 ..
4.63.d:
यस्मात्त्वया हता दैत्या ब्रह्मणो मत्परिग्रहाः ॥
तस्मात्त्वं मानुषे लोके दश वारान्गमिष्यसि ॥ 11 ॥
4.63.m: “Since you have slain the Daityas and a brahmin woman under my protection, / therefore you shall go ten times into the mortal world.”

4.63.s:
ato'rthaṃ mānuṣe loke rakṣārthaṃ ca mahīkṣitām..
avatāraṃ cakārāhaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ pṛthagvidham .. 12 .....
4.63.d:
अतोऽर्थं मानुषे लोके रक्षार्थं च महीक्षिताम्॥
अवतारं चकाराहं भूयोभूयः पृथग्विधम् ॥ 12 ॥॥।
4.63.m: For this reason, and for the protection of the rulers of the earth, in the mortal world / I made descent again and again in various forms.

4.63.s:
pūrvoktaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pārtha avatīrṇaṃ mahītale ..
māṃ narā ye'rcayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape .. 13 ..
4.63.d:
पूर्वोक्तैः कारणैः पार्थ अवतीर्णं महीतले ॥
मां नरा येऽर्चयिष्यंति तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे ॥ 13 ॥
4.63.m: Those men who will worship me, descended upon the surface of the earth / for the reasons declared previously, O son of Pṛthā, will have their dwelling in heaven.

4.63.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
vrataṃ daśāvatārākhyaṃ kṛṣṇa brūhi savistaram ..
samaṃtraṃ sarahasyaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 14 ..
4.63.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
व्रतं दशावताराख्यं कृष्ण ब्रूहि सविस्तरम् ॥
समंत्रं सरहस्यं च सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.63.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, tell in detail of the votive observance called the Ten Avatāras, / with its mantras and secrets, which destroys all sins.

4.63.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
proṣṭhapade site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ..
snātvā jalāśaye svacche pitṛdevāditarpaṇam.. 15 ..
4.63.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रोष्ठपदे सिते पक्षे दशम्यां नियतः शुचिः ॥
स्नात्वा जलाशये स्वच्छे पितृदेवादितर्पणम्॥ 15 ॥
4.63.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / In the month of Proṣṭhapada, in the bright fortnight, on the tenth [lunar day], restrained and pure, / having bathed in a clear body of water and made libations to the ancestors, gods, and others,

4.63.s:
kṛtvā kurukulaśreṣṭha gṛhamāgatya mānavaḥ ..
gṛhṇīyāddhānyacūrṇasya dvihastaprasṛti trayam .. 16 ..
4.63.d:
कृत्वा कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ गृहमागत्य मानवः ॥
गृह्णीयाद्धान्यचूर्णस्य द्विहस्तप्रसृति त्रयम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.63.m: having done [so], O best of Kuru's line, a man, having come home, / should take three double handfuls of grain flour.

4.63.s:
krameṇa pāvayettāṃ tu puṃsaṃjñaṃ ghṛtasaṃśritam ..
varṣe varṣe dine tasminyāvadvarṣāṇi vai daśa .. 17 ..
4.63.d:
क्रमेण पावयेत्तां तु पुंसंज्ञं घृतसंश्रितम् ॥
वर्षे वर्षे दिने तस्मिन्यावद्वर्षाणि वै दश ॥ 17 ॥
4.63.m: He should cook it in order, [an offering] called male, mixed with ghee, / year after year on that day, for ten years.

4.63.s:
prathame pūrikānvarṣe dvitīye ghṛtapūrakān ..
tṛtīye śuklakāsāraṃ caturthe modakāñchubhān .. 18 ..
4.63.d:
प्रथमे पूरिकान्वर्षे द्वितीये घृतपूरकान् ॥
तृतीये शुक्लकासारं चतुर्थे मोदकाञ्छुभान् ॥ 18 ॥
4.63.m: In the first year [he offers] pūrikās, in the second ghṛtapūrakas, / in the third white kāsāra, in the fourth auspicious modakas,

4.63.s:
sohālakānpañcame'bde ṣaṣṭhe'bde khaṇḍaveṣṭakān ..
saptame'bde kokarasānapūpāṃśca tathāṣṭame .. 19 ..
4.63.d:
सोहालकान्पञ्चमेऽब्दे षष्ठेऽब्दे खण्डवेष्टकान् ॥
सप्तमेऽब्दे कोकरसानपूपांश्च तथाष्टमे ॥ 19 ॥
4.63.m: in the fifth year sohālakas, in the sixth year khaṇḍaveṣṭakas, / in the seventh year kokarasas, and in the eighth apūpas,

4.63.s:
navame karṇaveṣṭāṃstu daśame khaṇḍakāñchubhān ..
daśa dhenūrdaśahare daśaviprāya dāpayet .. 4.63.20 ..
4.63.d:
नवमे कर्णवेष्टांस्तु दशमे खण्डकाञ्छुभान् ॥
दश धेनूर्दशहरे दशविप्राय दापयेत् ॥ 4.63.20 ॥
4.63.m: in the ninth karṇaveṣṭas, and in the tenth auspicious khaṇḍakas. / On Daśaharā he should give ten cows to ten brahmins.

4.63.s:
krameṇa bhakṣayitvā ca yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha ..
arddhārddhaṃ piṣṭayedevamarddhārddhaṃ vā dvijātaye ..
svata evārdhamaśnīyādgatvā ramye jalāśaye .. 21 ..
4.63.d:
क्रमेण भक्षयित्वा च यथोक्तं भरतर्षभ ॥
अर्द्धार्द्धं पिष्टयेदेवमर्द्धार्द्धं वा द्विजातये ॥
स्वत एवार्धमश्नीयाद्गत्वा रम्ये जलाशये ॥ 21 ॥
4.63.m: Having eaten in proper order as prescribed, O bull of the Bharatas, / he should give half the dough to the deity, or half to a twice-born, / and he should eat half himself, having gone to a charming body of water.

4.63.s:
daśāvatārānabhyarcya puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena medhāvī harimabhyukṣya vāriṇā .. 22 ..
4.63.d:
दशावतारानभ्यर्च्य पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ॥
मंत्रेणानेन मेधावी हरिमभ्युक्ष्य वारिणा ॥ 22 ॥
4.63.m: Having worshipped the ten avatāras with flowers, incense, and ointments, / the wise man, having sprinkled Hari with water by means of this mantra:

4.63.s:
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam ..
śrīrāmaṃ rāma kṛṣṇau ca buddhaṃ caiva sakalkinam .. 23 ..
4.63.d:
मत्स्यं कूर्मं वराहं च नरसिंहं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥
श्रीरामं राम कृष्णौ च बुद्धं चैव सकल्किनम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.63.m: “The Fish, the Tortoise, the Boar, the Man-Lion, Trivikrama, / Śrī Rāma, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, the Buddha, and Kalkin—

4.63.s:
gato'smi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ..
praṇato'smi jagannāthaṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu .. 24 ..
4.63.d:
गतोऽस्मि शरणं देवं हरिं नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥
प्रणतोऽस्मि जगन्नाथं स मे विष्णुः प्रसीदतु ॥ 24 ॥
4.63.m: I have gone for refuge to the god Hari, the lord Nārāyaṇa; / I am bowed down to the lord of the world; may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me.

4.63.s:
chinattu vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ bhaktyā jāto janardanaḥ ..
śvetadvīpaṃ nayasyasmānsamātmani nivedayet .. 25 ..
4.63.d:
छिनत्तु वैष्णवीं मायां भक्त्या जातो जनर्दनः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपं नयस्यस्मान्समात्मनि निवेदयेत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.63.m: May Janārdana, who is born through devotion, cut away the Vaiṣṇava Māyā; / lead us to Śvetadvīpa!”—he should dedicate [this] within himself.

4.63.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha vidhinānena suvrata ..
daśāvatāranāmākhyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 26 ..
4.63.d:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ विधिनानेन सुव्रत ॥
दशावतारनामाख्यं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 26 ॥
4.63.m: Hear the meritorious fruit, O son of Pṛthā, of him of good vows who performs / [the rite] named the Ten Avatāras in this manner according to the rule.

4.63.s:
śrūyate yāstvimālocya puruṣāṇāṃ daśā daśa ..
tāśchinatti na saṃdehaḥ śakrapraharaṇairhariḥ .. .. 27 ..
4.63.d:
श्रूयते यास्त्विमालोच्य पुरुषाणां दशा दश ॥
ताश्छिनत्ति न संदेहः शक्रप्रहरणैर्हरिः ॥ ॥ 27 ॥
4.63.m: Observing these ten states of men that are spoken of, / Hari cuts them down with Indra's weapons; of this there is no doubt.

4.63.s:
saṃsārasāgare ghore majjata tatra māṃ hariḥ ..
śvetadvīpaṃ nayatvāśu vratenānena toṣitaḥ .. 28 ..
4.63.d:
संसारसागरे घोरे मज्जत तत्र मां हरिः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपं नयत्वाशु व्रतेनानेन तोषितः ॥ 28 ॥
4.63.m: “Let Hari quickly lead me, sinking there in the terrible ocean of cyclic existence, / to Śvetadvīpa, pleased by this votive observance.”

4.63.s:
kiṃ tasya na bhavelloke yasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ ..
so'haṃ janārdano rājankālarūpī dharāsutaḥ ..
martyaloke svayaṃ pārtha bhūbhārottārakāraṇam .. 29 ..
4.63.d:
किं तस्य न भवेल्लोके यस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः ॥
सोऽहं जनार्दनो राजन्कालरूपी धरासुतः ॥
मर्त्यलोके स्वयं पार्थ भूभारोत्तारकारणम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.63.m: What would there not be in the world for him with whom Janārdana is pleased? / I, that Janārdana, O king, am the son of the earth who has the form of Time, / myself in the mortal world, O son of Pṛthā, the cause of lifting the earth’s burden.

4.63.s:
yā strī vratamidaṃ pārtha cariṣyati mayoditam ..
sā lakṣmyā'calayā yuktā bhartṛputrasamanvitā .. 4.63.30 ..
4.63.d:
या स्त्री व्रतमिदं पार्थ चरिष्यति मयोदितम् ॥
सा लक्ष्म्याऽचलया युक्ता भर्तृपुत्रसमन्विता ॥ 4.63.30 ॥
4.63.m: Whatever woman shall perform this votive observance spoken by me, O son of Pṛthā, / endowed with steadfast fortune, accompanied by husband and sons,

4.63.s:
martyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ..
viṣṇulokādrudralokaṃ tato yāti paraṃ padam .. 31 ..
4.63.d:
मर्त्यलोके चिरं स्थित्वा विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥
विष्णुलोकाद्रुद्रलोकं ततो याति परं पदम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.63.m: after staying long in the mortal world, she is exalted in the realm of Viṣṇu; / from Viṣṇu's realm [she goes] to Rudra's realm, and from there she goes to the supreme abode.

4.63.s:
ye pūjayaṃti puruṣāḥ puruṣottamasya matsyādikāṃstu daśamīṣu daśāvatārān ..
martyā daśasvapi daśāsu sukhaṃ vihṛtya te yāṃti yānamadhiruhya sureśalokān .. 32 .. ..
āśādaśamīvarṇanam
4.63.d:
ये पूजयंति पुरुषाः पुरुषोत्तमस्य मत्स्यादिकांस्तु दशमीषु दशावतारान् ॥
मर्त्या दशस्वपि दशासु सुखं विहृत्य ते यांति यानमधिरुह्य सुरेशलोकान् ॥ 32 ॥ ॥
आशादशमीवर्णनम्
4.63.m:
Those men who worship the ten avatāras of the Supreme Spirit, beginning with the Fish, on the tenth [lunar days], / having sported happily through all ten states of life, those mortals mount a celestial vehicle and go to the realms of the lord of the gods.
Description of the Āśādaśamī

4.64.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārtha pārthivavṛndānāṃ mukhapaṅkajasadrave ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahito vacmi tavāśādaśamīvratam .. .. 1..
4.64.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पार्थ पार्थिववृन्दानां मुखपङ्कजसद्रवे ॥
शृणुष्वावहितो वच्मि तवाशादशमीव्रतम् ॥ ॥ 1॥
4.64.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / O son of Pṛthā, a sweet essence to the lotus faces of hosts of kings, / listen attentively; I will tell you of the Āśādaśamī votive observance.

4.64.s:
nalanāmābhavatpūrvaṃ niṣadheṣu mahīpate ..
sa bhrātrā nirjito rājye puṣkareṇeti naḥ śrutam .. 2 ..
4.64.d:
नलनामाभवत्पूर्वं निषधेषु महीपते ॥
स भ्रात्रा निर्जितो राज्ये पुष्करेणेति नः श्रुतम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.64.m: Formerly among the Niṣadhas there was a king named Nala, O lord of the earth; / he was defeated in his kingdom by his brother Puṣkara, so it is heard by us.

4.64.s:
akṣairdyūtena rājendra niryayau bhāryayā saha ..
vanaṃ pratibhayaṃ śūnyaṃ jhillīkagaṇanāditam .. 3 ..
4.64.d:
अक्षैर्द्यूतेन राजेन्द्र निर्ययौ भार्यया सह ॥
वनं प्रतिभयं शून्यं झिल्लीकगणनादितम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.64.m: Defeated at dice, O lord of kings, he set out with his wife / for the fearful, deserted forest resounding with swarms of crickets.

4.64.s:
sa gatvā pratyahorātraṃ jalamātreṇa vartayan ..
dadarśa vanamadhyasthāñchakunīnkāṃcanacchavīn .. 4 ..
4.64.d:
स गत्वा प्रत्यहोरात्रं जलमात्रेण वर्तयन् ॥
ददर्श वनमध्यस्थाञ्छकुनीन्कांचनच्छवीन् ॥ 4 ॥
4.64.m: Having gone, subsisting day and night on water alone, / he saw birds of golden hue in the midst of the forest.

4.64.s:
grahītumicchaṃstānrājansamācchādya svavāsasā ..
khamāpetuḥ khagāstūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā vasanaṃ śubham ..5..
4.64.d:
ग्रहीतुमिच्छंस्तान्राजन्समाच्छाद्य स्ववाससा ॥
खमापेतुः खगास्तूर्णं गृहीत्वा वसनं शुभम् ॥5॥
4.64.m: Wishing to catch them, O king, having covered them with his own garment, / the birds quickly flew up into the sky, carrying off his fine garment.

4.64.s:
āsasāda samāḥ kāściddhṛtavāsāḥ suduḥkhitaḥ..
damayaṃtīṃ samāprāpya nidrayāpahṛtāṃ tadā ..
duḥkhādutsṛjya gatavānbhāgyataḥ prāgdhaneśvaram .. 5 ..
4.64.d:
आससाद समाः काश्चिद्धृतवासाः सुदुःखितः॥
दमयंतीं समाप्राप्य निद्रयापहृतां तदा ॥
दुःखादुत्सृज्य गतवान्भाग्यतः प्राग्धनेश्वरम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.64.m: Deeply sorrowful, with his garment taken, he endured some years; / having reached Damayantī who was then overcome with sleep, / he abandoned her out of grief and went away, through fate, toward Kuvera.

4.64.s:
gate tu naiṣadhe bhaimī prabuddhai vāñcitānanā..
apaśyaṃtī nalaṃ vīraṃ vīra bhīmasutā vane ..
itaścetaśca babhrāma hāheti rudatī muhuḥ .. 7 ..
4.64.d:
गते तु नैषधे भैमी प्रबुद्धै वाञ्चितानना॥
अपश्यंती नलं वीरं वीर भीमसुता वने ॥
इतश्चेतश्च बभ्राम हाहेति रुदती मुहुः ॥ 7 ॥
4.64.m: When the lord of the Niṣadhas had gone, the daughter of Bhīma awoke, her face dejected; / not seeing the heroic Nala in the forest, O hero, the daughter of Bhīma / wandered here and there, weeping repeatedly, crying “Alas! Alas!”

4.64.s:
duḥkhaśokasamākrāṃtā naladarśanalālasā ..
āsasāda dine kaiścitsā caidyapuramaṃjasā .. 8 ..
4.64.d:
दुःखशोकसमाक्रांता नलदर्शनलालसा ॥
आससाद दिने कैश्चित्सा चैद्यपुरमंजसा ॥ 8 ॥
4.64.m: Overcome with sorrow and grief, yearning for the sight of Nala, / she reached in a few days the city of the Cedis directly.

4.64.s:
unmattavatparivṛtā śiśubhiḥ kautukākulaiḥ ..
sā dṛṣṭā cedirājasya jananyā janaveṣṭitā ..9..
4.64.d:
उन्मत्तवत्परिवृता शिशुभिः कौतुकाकुलैः ॥
सा दृष्टा चेदिराजस्य जनन्या जनवेष्टिता ॥9॥
4.64.m: Surrounded like a madwoman by children overcome with curiosity, / encircled by the people, she was seen by the mother of the Cedi king.

4.64.s:
candralekheva patitā bhūmau bhāsitadiṅmukhā ..
āropya sā svabhavanaṃ pṛṣṭā kā tvaṃ varānane .. 4.64.10 ..
4.64.d:
चन्द्रलेखेव पतिता भूमौ भासितदिङ्मुखा ॥
आरोप्य सा स्वभवनं पृष्टा का त्वं वरानने ॥ 4.64.10 ॥
4.64.m: Like a crescent of the moon fallen upon the earth, illumining the directions, / she was brought up to her own palace and asked: “Who are you, fair-faced one?”

4.64.s:
uvāca bhaimī savrīḍaṃ sairaṃdhrīṃ māṃ nibodhatām ..
na dhāvayeyaṃ caraṇau nocchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayāmyaham .. 11 ..
4.64.d:
उवाच भैमी सव्रीडं सैरंध्रीं मां निबोधताम् ॥
न धावयेयं चरणौ नोच्छिष्टं भक्षयाम्यहम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.64.m: The daughter of Bhīma spoke with shame: “Know me to be a sairaṃdhrī. / I will not wash [another’s] feet, nor do I eat table scraps.

4.64.s:
yadi prārthayate kaściddaṃḍyaste sāṃprataṃ bhavet ..
pratijñayānayā devi tiṣṭheyaṃ tava veśmani ..
evamastvanavadyāṃgi rāja mātāpyuvāca tām .. 12 ..
4.64.d:
यदि प्रार्थयते कश्चिद्दंड्यस्ते सांप्रतं भवेत् ॥
प्रतिज्ञयानया देवि तिष्ठेयं तव वेश्मनि ॥
एवमस्त्वनवद्यांगि राज माताप्युवाच ताम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.64.m: If anyone solicits me, he must presently be punished by you. / On this promise, O queen, I would stay in your house.” / “So be it, O faultless-limbed one,” the king’s mother said to her.

4.64.s:
evaṃvidhā tadbhavane kaṃcitkālamaniṃditā ..
uvāsa vasanārddhena pravṛttāṃte kila dvijaḥ ..
ānayāmāsa mudito damayaṃtīṃ gṛhaṃ pituḥ .. 13 ..
4.64.d:
एवंविधा तद्भवने कंचित्कालमनिंदिता ॥
उवास वसनार्द्धेन प्रवृत्तांते किल द्विजः ॥
आनयामास मुदितो दमयंतीं गृहं पितुः ॥ 13 ॥
4.64.m: Being of such a disposition, she, blameless, for some time / lived in her palace wearing half a garment, until, upon learning the situation, a twice-born man / brought Damayantī with joy to her father’s house.

4.64.s:
mātrā pitrā samāyuktā sutairbhrātṛbhireva ca ..
damayaṃtī tathāpyāste duḥkhaṃ naiṣadhavarjitā .. 14 ..
4.64.d:
मात्रा पित्रा समायुक्ता सुतैर्भ्रातृभिरेव च ॥
दमयंती तथाप्यास्ते दुःखं नैषधवर्जिता ॥ 14 ॥
4.64.m: Reunited with her mother, her father, her sons, and her brothers, / Damayantī nevertheless remained in sorrow, bereft of the Naiṣadha.

4.64.s:
provāca vimanāhūya vrataṃ dānamathāpi vā ..
kathayadhvaṃ yathā me syādiṣṭena saha saṃgamaḥ .. 15 ..
4.64.d:
प्रोवाच विमनाहूय व्रतं दानमथापि वा ॥
कथयध्वं यथा मे स्यादिष्टेन सह संगमः ॥ 15 ॥
4.64.m: Depressed, she summoned [the priests] and said: “A votive observance or a gift, / declare to me, by which I might attain reunion with my beloved.”

4.64.s:
tatretihāsakuśalo vipraḥ provāca buddhimān ..
bhadre tvamāśādaśamīṃ kuruṣvepsitasiddhidām .. 16 ..
4.64.d:
तत्रेतिहासकुशलो विप्रः प्रोवाच बुद्धिमान् ॥
भद्रे त्वमाशादशमीं कुरुष्वेप्सितसिद्धिदाम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.64.m: Thereupon a wise brāhmaṇa, skilled in traditional history, spoke: / “O auspicious lady, perform the Āśādaśamī, which grants the attainment of desired ends.”

4.64.s:
cakāra sarvaṃ tanvaṃgī yatpurāṇavidā tadā ..
khyātamākhyānaviduṣā damanena purodhasā .. 17 ..
4.64.d:
चकार सर्वं तन्वंगी यत्पुराणविदा तदा ॥
ख्यातमाख्यानविदुषा दमनेन पुरोधसा ॥ 17 ॥
4.64.m: The slender-bodied lady performed everything that was then related / by the royal priest Damana, the knower of the Purāṇas and expert in ancient tales.

4.64.s:
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa damayaṃtyā narottama ..
saṃjātaḥ sukhado'tyarthaṃ bharttrā saha samāgamaḥ .. 18 ..
4.64.d:
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण दमयंत्या नरोत्तम ॥
संजातः सुखदोऽत्यर्थं भर्त्त्रा सह समागमः ॥ 18 ॥
4.64.m: By the power of this votive observance, O best of men, / for Damayantī an exceedingly joyous reunion with her husband took place.

4.64.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathamāśādaśamyeṣā govinda kriyate kadā ..
sarvametatsamācakṣva māṃ sarvajñosi yādava .. 19 ..
4.64.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कथमाशादशम्येषा गोविन्द क्रियते कदा ॥
सर्वमेतत्समाचक्ष्व मां सर्वज्ञोसि यादव ॥ 19 ॥
4.64.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How is this Āśādaśamī performed, Govinda, and when? / Tell me all of this; you are omniscient, O Yādava.

4.64.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rājyāśayā rājaputraḥ kṛṣyarthaṃ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ ..
bhāryārthaṃ tu vaṇikputraḥ putrārthe gurviṇī tathā .. 4.64.20 ..
4.64.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
राज्याशया राजपुत्रः कृष्यर्थं तु कृषीवलः ॥
भार्यार्थं तु वणिक्पुत्रः पुत्रार्थे गुर्विणी तथा ॥ 4.64.20 ॥
4.64.m: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / A prince desiring kingdom, a farmer for the sake of farming, / a merchant’s son for the sake of a wife, and likewise a pregnant woman for the sake of a son,

4.64.s:
dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhayai lokakanyā varārthinī ..
yaṣṭukāmo dvijavaro rogī rogāpanuttaye .. 21 ..
4.64.d:
धर्मार्थकामसंसिद्धयै लोककन्या वरार्थिनी ॥
यष्टुकामो द्विजवरो रोगी रोगापनुत्तये ॥ 21 ॥
4.64.m: an ordinary maiden seeking a bridegroom for the fulfillment of virtue, wealth, and pleasure, / an eminent twice-born wishing to sacrifice, a sick person for the removal of disease,

4.64.s:
cirapravāsite kāṃte kālena dhṛtipaṃḍitā ..
eteṣvanyeṣu kartavyamāśāvratamidaṃ sadā .. 22 ..
4.64.d:
चिरप्रवासिते कांते कालेन धृतिपंडिता ॥
एतेष्वन्येषु कर्तव्यमाशाव्रतमिदं सदा ॥ 22 ॥
4.64.m: and [a woman] wise in steadfastness when her beloved has long been abroad— / this Āśāvrata must always be performed in these and other circumstances.

4.64.s:
yadā yasya bhavedārtaṃ kāryate hi tadā vratam ..
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu snātvā saṃpūjya devatāḥ ..23..
4.64.d:
यदा यस्य भवेदार्तं कार्यते हि तदा व्रतम् ॥
शुक्लपक्षे दशम्यां तु स्नात्वा संपूज्य देवताः ॥23॥
4.64.m: Whenever someone has distress, then indeed the votive observance should be performed. / Having bathed on the tenth [lunar day] in the bright fortnight and worshipped the deities,

4.64.s:
naktaṃ tadāśāḥ saṃpūjyāḥ puṣpālaktakacandanaiḥ ..
gṛhāṅgaṇe lekhayitvā yavaiḥ piṣṭātakena vā ..
dattvā ghṛtāktaṃ naivedyaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ nivedayet ..24..
4.64.d:
नक्तं तदाशाः संपूज्याः पुष्पालक्तकचन्दनैः ॥
गृहाङ्गणे लेखयित्वा यवैः पिष्टातकेन वा ॥
दत्त्वा घृताक्तं नैवेद्यं पुनः कार्यं निवेदयेत् ॥24॥
4.64.m: the quarters are then to be worshipped at night with flowers, red lac, and sandalpaste, / having drawn them in the courtyard of the house with barley or with fragrant powder; / having offered a food-offering smeared with ghee, one should again submit one's purpose:

4.64.s:
āśāścāśāḥ sadā saṃtu vidyaṃtāṃ ca manorathāḥ..
bhavatīnāṃ prasādena sadā kalyāṇamastviti ..25..
4.64.d:
आशाश्चाशाः सदा संतु विद्यंतां च मनोरथाः॥
भवतीनां प्रसादेन सदा कल्याणमस्त्विति ॥25॥
4.64.m: “May the quarters always be full of hope, and may desires be realized! / By your grace, may there always be auspiciousness!”

4.64.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīta dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām..
anena kramayogena māsimāsi samācaret..26..
4.64.d:
एवं संपूज्य भुञ्जीत दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम्॥
अनेन क्रमयोगेन मासिमासि समाचरेत्॥26॥
4.64.m: Having thus worshipped, one should eat, having given a priestly fee to a brāhmaṇa. / In this orderly sequence, one should perform it month after month,

4.64.s:
yāvanmanorathaḥ pūrṇastataḥ paścātsamudyamāt ..
māsi pūrṇe ca ṣaṇmāse varṣe varṣadvaye gate..27..
4.64.d:
यावन्मनोरथः पूर्णस्ततः पश्चात्समुद्यमात् ॥
मासि पूर्णे च षण्मासे वर्षे वर्षद्वये गते॥27॥
4.64.m: until the desire is fulfilled; thereafter, from diligent effort, / when a month has completed, or six months, a year, or two years have passed,

4.64.s:
sauvarṇāḥ kārayedāśā raupyapiṣṭātakena vā..
jñātibaṃdhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ snātaḥ samyagalaṃkṛtaḥ ..28..
4.64.d:
सौवर्णाः कारयेदाशा रौप्यपिष्टातकेन वा॥
ज्ञातिबंधुजनैः सार्द्धं स्नातः सम्यगलंकृतः ॥28॥
4.64.m: one should cause [images of] the quarters to be made of gold, or of silver and fragrant powder. / Bathed and well adorned along with relatives and kin,

4.64.s:
pūjayenmaṃtrasaṃdarbhairebhirdhyātvā gṛhāṃgaṇe...
tava saṃnihitaḥ śakraḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ..
pūrvā candreṇa sahitā aindrīdigdevate namaḥ .. 29 ..
4.64.d:
पूजयेन्मंत्रसंदर्भैरेभिर्ध्यात्वा गृहांगणे॥।
तव संनिहितः शक्रः सुरासुरनमस्कृतः ॥
पूर्वा चन्द्रेण सहिता ऐन्द्रीदिग्देवते नमः ॥ 29 ॥
4.64.m: one should worship, meditating in the courtyard of the house with these compositions of mantras: / “Śakra, reverenced by gods and asuras, is present near you. / O Eastern, Aindrī, deity of the direction accompanied by the Moon, obeisance to you.

4.64.s:
agneḥ parigrahādārye tvamāgneyīti paṭhyase ..
tejomayī parā śaktirāgneyī varadā bhava .. 4.64.30 ..
4.64.d:
अग्नेः परिग्रहादार्ये त्वमाग्नेयीति पठ्यसे ॥
तेजोमयी परा शक्तिराग्नेयी वरदा भव ॥ 4.64.30 ॥
4.64.m: Because of being accepted by Agni, O noble lady, you are declared to be Āgneyī. / Embodied in splendor, supreme energy, Āgneyī, be a giver of boons!

4.64.s:
devarājaṃ samāsādya lokaḥ saṃyamayatyasau ..
tena saṃyamanī yāsi yāmye kāmapradā bhava .. 31 ..
4.64.d:
देवराजं समासाद्य लोकः संयमयत्यसौ ॥
तेन संयमनी यासि याम्ये कामप्रदा भव ॥ 31 ॥
4.64.m: Reaching the king of the gods, this world restrains itself; / therefore you who are Saṃyamanī in the south, be a granter of desires!

4.64.s:
khaḍgaṃsahātivikṛtā nairṛtistvamupābhṛtā ..
tena nairṛtanāmnītvaṃ kṛtavānmaghavā sadā .. 32 ..
4.64.d:
खड्गंसहातिविकृता नैरृतिस्त्वमुपाभृता ॥
तेन नैरृतनाम्नीत्वं कृतवान्मघवा सदा ॥ 32 ॥
4.64.m: Bearing a sword, exceedingly fierce, you are Nairṛtī, approached [with fear]; / therefore Maghavan has always made you bear the name Nairṛtā.

4.64.s:
tvayyāste bhavanādhāravaruṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ..
iṣṭakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ vāruṇiprabhavā bhava .. 33 ..
4.64.d:
त्वय्यास्ते भवनाधारवरुणो यादसां पतिः ॥
इष्टकामार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं वारुणिप्रभवा भव ॥ 33 ॥
4.64.m: In you dwells Varuṇa, the support of the world, the lord of aquatic creatures; / for the fulfillment of desired wishes, be auspicious, O Vāruṇī!

4.64.s:
adhiśritāsi yasmāttvaṃ vāyunā jagadāyunā..
vāyavye tvamataḥ śāntiṃ nityaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ .. 34 ..
4.64.d:
अधिश्रितासि यस्मात्त्वं वायुना जगदायुना॥
वायव्ये त्वमतः शान्तिं नित्यं यच्छ नमोनमः ॥ 34 ॥
4.64.m: Because you are inhabited by Vāyu, the life-breath of the world, / therefore, O Vāyavī, grant perpetual peace; salutations, salutations!

4.64.s:
kuberavāsataḥ saumyā prakhyātā tvamathottarā ..
aiśānī jagadīśena śaṃbhunā tvamalaṃkṛtā ..
atastvaṃ śivasānnidhyaṃ devi dehi śive namaḥ .. 35 ..
4.64.d:
कुबेरवासतः सौम्या प्रख्याता त्वमथोत्तरा ॥
ऐशानी जगदीशेन शंभुना त्वमलंकृता ॥
अतस्त्वं शिवसान्निध्यं देवि देहि शिवे नमः ॥ 35 ॥
4.64.m: From the dwelling of Kubera, you are renowned as the gentle Northern [quarter]. / O Aiśānī, you are adorned by Śambhu, the lord of the universe; / therefore, O goddess, grant the proximity of Śiva; O Śivā, obeisance to you!

4.64.s:
sarpāṣṭakakulena tvaṃ sevitāsi tathāpyadhaḥ ..
nāgāṃganābhiḥ sahitā hitā naḥ sarvadā bhava .. 36 ..
4.64.d:
सर्पाष्टककुलेन त्वं सेवितासि तथाप्यधः ॥
नागांगनाभिः सहिता हिता नः सर्वदा भव ॥ 36 ॥
4.64.m: You are served below also by the lineage of the eight serpents; / accompanied by nāga maidens, be always beneficial to us!

4.64.s:
saptalokaiḥ parigatā sarvadā tvaṃ śivā yataḥ ..
sanakādyaiḥ parivṛtā brāhmī jihmānapākuru .. 37 ..
4.64.d:
सप्तलोकैः परिगता सर्वदा त्वं शिवा यतः ॥
सनकाद्यैः परिवृता ब्राह्मी जिह्मानपाकुरु ॥ 37 ॥
4.64.m: Since you are encompassed by the seven worlds, always auspicious, / surrounded by Sanaka and the others, O Brāhmī, banish crookedness!

4.64.s:
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāstārāgrahāstathā ..
nakṣatramātaro ye ca bhūtapretavināyakāḥ ..
sarve mameṣṭasiddhyarthe bhavaṃtu praṇatāḥ sadā .. 38 ..
4.64.d:
नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि ग्रहास्ताराग्रहास्तथा ॥
नक्षत्रमातरो ये च भूतप्रेतविनायकाः ॥
सर्वे ममेष्टसिद्ध्यर्थे भवंतु प्रणताः सदा ॥ 38 ॥
4.64.m: And all the lunar mansions, the planets, and likewise the planetary stars, / and whichever are the mother-stars, ghosts, pretas, and vināyakas— / may all of them always be bowed down for the fulfillment of my desired end.”

4.64.s:
ebhirmaṃtraiḥ samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ ..
vāsobhirabhisaṃsthāpya phalāni vinivedayet.. 39 ..
4.64.d:
एभिर्मंत्रैः समभ्यर्च्य पुष्पधूपादिना ततः ॥
वासोभिरभिसंस्थाप्य फलानि विनिवेदयेत्॥ 39 ॥
4.64.m: Having thoroughly worshipped with these mantras using flowers, incense, and other articles, / then having covered them with garments, one should present fruits.

4.64.s:
tattūryadhvanighoṣeṇa gatimaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ..
nṛtyatībhirvarastrībhistāṃ rātrimativāhayet .. 4.64.40 ..
4.64.d:
तत्तूर्यध्वनिघोषेण गतिमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः ॥
नृत्यतीभिर्वरस्त्रीभिस्तां रात्रिमतिवाहयेत् ॥ 4.64.40 ॥
4.64.m: With the roar of the sound of those musical instruments, with the sounds of auspicious songs, / and with excellent women dancing, one should pass that night.

4.64.s:
kuṃkumakṣodatīvreṇa dānamānādibhiḥ sukham ..
prabhāte vedaviduṣe sarvaṃ tatpratipādayet .. 41 ..
4.64.d:
कुंकुमक्षोदतीव्रेण दानमानादिभिः सुखम् ॥
प्रभाते वेदविदुषे सर्वं तत्प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 41 ॥
4.64.m: Pleasantly, with the sharp fragrance of saffron powder, and with gifts, honors, and so forth, / at dawn one should bestow all that upon a knower of the Veda.

4.64.s:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ kṣamayanpraṇipatya ca ..
bhuñjīta mitrasahitaḥ suhṛdbaṃdhujanairapi .. 42 ..
4.64.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं क्षमयन्प्रणिपत्य च ॥
भुञ्जीत मित्रसहितः सुहृद्बंधुजनैरपि ॥ 42 ॥
4.64.m: According to this rule, begging pardon of all and bowing down, / one should eat along with friends, well-wishers, and relatives.

4.64.s:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha daśamīvratamādarāt ..
sa sarvakāmamāpnoti manasābhīpsitaṃ naraḥ .. 43 ..
4.64.d:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ दशमीव्रतमादरात् ॥
स सर्वकाममाप्नोति मनसाभीप्सितं नरः ॥ 43 ॥
4.64.m: Whoever performs the Daśamīvrata thus with devotion, O son of Pṛthā, / that person attains every wish desired by the mind.

4.64.s:
strībhirviśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ vratametadyudhiṣṭhira ..
laghucittā yato nāryaḥ sadā kāmaparāyaṇāḥ .. 44 ..
4.64.d:
स्त्रीभिर्विशेषतः कार्यं व्रतमेतद्युधिष्ठिर ॥
लघुचित्ता यतो नार्यः सदा कामपरायणाः ॥ 44 ॥
4.64.m: This votive observance is especially to be performed by women, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / because women are fickle-minded and always intent upon desires.

4.64.s:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
kathitaṃ te mahārāja mayā vratamanuttamam .. 45 ..
4.64.d:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥
कथितं ते महाराज मया व्रतमनुत्तमम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.64.m: Bestowing fortune, fame, and longevity, yielding the fruit of all desires, / this supreme votive observance has been related to you by me, O great king.

4.64.s:
ye mānavā manujapuṅgava kāmakāmāḥ saṃpūjayaṃti daśamīṣu sadā daśāśāḥ ..
teṣāṃ viśeṣanihitā hṛdaye prakāmamāśāḥ phalaṃtyalamalaṃ bahunoditena .. 46 ..
tārakadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.64.d:
ये मानवा मनुजपुङ्गव कामकामाः संपूजयंति दशमीषु सदा दशाशाः ॥
तेषां विशेषनिहिता हृदये प्रकाममाशाः फलंत्यलमलं बहुनोदितेन ॥ 46 ॥
तारकद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.64.m:
Those men desirous of their wishes, O bull among men, who always worship the ten directions on the tenth [lunar days], / the hopes especially placed within their hearts bear fruit in full measure; enough, enough of speaking at length!
Description of the Tārakadvādaśīvrata.

4.65.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ tvāgaskaraḥ pāpaḥ pṛthivīkṣayakārakaḥ ..
paripṛcchāmi govinda tvāṃ namaskṛtya pādayoḥ .. 1 ..
4.65.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अहं त्वागस्करः पापः पृथिवीक्षयकारकः ॥
परिपृच्छामि गोविन्द त्वां नमस्कृत्य पादयोः ॥ 1 ॥
4.65.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / I am a wrongdoer, a sinner, the cause of the destruction of the earth; / bowing at your feet, Govinda, I ask you:

4.65.s:
guhyādguhyataraṃ brūhi vrataṃ kiṃcidanuttamam..
tarāmi yena pāpaughaṃ bhīṣmadroṇavadhārṇavam .. 2 ..
4.65.d:
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं ब्रूहि व्रतं किंचिदनुत्तमम्॥
तरामि येन पापौघं भीष्मद्रोणवधार्णवम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.65.m: Speak of some supreme votive observance, more secret than the secret, / by which I may cross over the flood of sin, the ocean of slaying Bhīṣma and Droṇa.

4.65.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āsītpurottaro nāmnā vidarbhāyāṃ kuśadhvajaḥ ..
sāṃtaḥpurasuto yaśca cakre rājyamataṃdritaḥ .. 3 ..
4.65.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आसीत्पुरोत्तरो नाम्ना विदर्भायां कुशध्वजः ॥
सांतःपुरसुतो यश्च चक्रे राज्यमतंद्रितः ॥ 3 ॥
4.65.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / In the past, in Vidarbhā, there was an excellent [king] named Kuśadhvaja, / who, having an inner apartment and sons, ruled his kingdom without indolence.

4.65.s:
jaghāna tāpasaṃ so'tha pramādānmṛgayāṃ gataḥ ..
mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ daivamohitaḥ .. 4 ..
4.65.d:
जघान तापसं सोऽथ प्रमादान्मृगयां गतः ॥
मृगं मत्वा महारण्ये ब्राह्मणं दैवमोहितः ॥ 4 ॥
4.65.m: Then, having gone hunting, bewildered by fate, he struck down an ascetic / in the great forest, mistaking the brāhmaṇa for a deer.

4.65.s:
tena karmavipākena dehāṃte narakaṃ gataḥ ..
tatrāsau yātanā ghorā anubhūyātipīḍitaḥ .. 5 ..
4.65.d:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन देहांते नरकं गतः ॥
तत्रासौ यातना घोरा अनुभूयातिपीडितः ॥ 5 ॥
4.65.m: By that ripening of karma, he went to hell at the end of his body. / There, having experienced terrible torment, severely afflicted,

4.65.s:
tasmādihāgato martye raudro viṣadharo'bhavat..
adaśatso'pi rājendra brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe ruṣā .. 6 ..
4.65.d:
तस्मादिहागतो मर्त्ये रौद्रो विषधरोऽभवत्॥
अदशत्सोऽपि राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणं चरणे रुषा ॥ 6 ॥
4.65.m: he came here to the mortal realm from that [hell] and became a fierce venomous serpent. / O best of kings, he too bit a brāhmaṇa on the foot in rage.

4.65.s:
labdhvā saha ca paṃcatvaṃ jagāma dvijasaṃyutaḥ ..
vipannastu tataḥ siṃho dvitīye'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ .. 7 ..
4.65.d:
लब्ध्वा सह च पंचत्वं जगाम द्विजसंयुतः ॥
विपन्नस्तु ततः सिंहो द्वितीयेऽभूत्सुदारुणः ॥ 7 ॥
4.65.m: Meeting his dissolution together with the twice-born, he died; / and having perished, he then became an exceedingly fierce lion in his second [birth],

4.65.s:
vidāritamukho hiṃsro nānāsattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
jaghānāsau punaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ rājanyaṃ mṛgayā gatam .. 8 ..
4.65.d:
विदारितमुखो हिंस्रो नानासत्त्वभयंकरः ॥
जघानासौ पुनः श्रेष्ठं राजन्यं मृगया गतम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.65.m: with an open maw, violent, terrifying to various living beings. / He again killed an excellent kṣatriya who had gone hunting.

4.65.s:
tato'pi bahubhiḥ śastrai rājalokairnipātitaḥ ..
punarvyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye'pi bhavāṃtare .. 9 ..
4.65.d:
ततोऽपि बहुभिः शस्त्रै राजलोकैर्निपातितः ॥
पुनर्व्याघ्रो बभूवासौ तृतीयेऽपि भवांतरे ॥ 9 ॥
4.65.m: Then he too was brought down with many weapons by the king's men. / He became a tiger again in his third rebirth,

4.65.s:
tīkṣṇapādanakhāghātavyāpāditamṛgānvayaḥ ..
tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ nītaḥ kiñcidvanāṃtaram .. 4.65.10 ..
4.65.d:
तीक्ष्णपादनखाघातव्यापादितमृगान्वयः ॥
तेनापि वैश्यो निधनं नीतः किञ्चिद्वनांतरम् ॥ 4.65.10 ॥
4.65.m: destroying herds of deer with the blows of his sharp claws. / By him, too, a vaiśya was brought to his death deep in the forest.

4.65.s:
sa nītaḥ kṛmirāśitvaṃ lokaiḥ khātanipātanāt ..
saṃjātastu mahānṛkṣo nakharāhatajaṃturuk .. 11 ..
4.65.d:
स नीतः कृमिराशित्वं लोकैः खातनिपातनात् ॥
संजातस्तु महानृक्षो नखराहतजंतुरुक् ॥ 11 ॥
4.65.m: He was reduced to a heap of worms by people through being cast into a pit. / He was then born as a great bear, bringing pain to creatures struck by his claws.

4.65.s:
jaghāna bālaṃ caṇḍālādasau mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ..
pañcame makaro jātaḥ samudre' tibhayaṃkaraḥ .. 12 ..
4.65.d:
जघान बालं चण्डालादसौ मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् ॥
पञ्चमे मकरो जातः समुद्रे' तिभयंकरः ॥ 12 ॥
4.65.m: He killed a boy, [and] met his death at the hands of an outcaste. / In his fifth [birth] he was born as an exceedingly terrifying crocodile in the ocean.

4.65.s:
striyaṃ jaghāna taruṇīṃ snātukāmāmathāgatām ..
prabhāte śaṅkarasyāgre śaśāṅkagrahaṇe niśi .. 13 ..
4.65.d:
स्त्रियं जघान तरुणीं स्नातुकामामथागताम् ॥
प्रभाते शङ्करस्याग्रे शशाङ्कग्रहणे निशि ॥ 13 ॥
4.65.m: He killed a young woman who had come wishing to bathe / at dawn before Śaṅkara on the night of a lunar eclipse.

4.65.s:
tatrāpi baḍiśaṃ dattvā janaiḥ prāṇairviyojitaḥ ..
punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ .. 14 ..
4.65.d:
तत्रापि बडिशं दत्त्वा जनैः प्राणैर्वियोजितः ॥
पुनः षष्ठे भवे जातः पिशाचः पिशिताशनः ॥ 14 ॥
4.65.m: There, too, struck with a hook, he was deprived of his life by men. / Then in his sixth birth he was born as a flesh-eating piśāca,

4.65.s:
krūraśchidraparaḥ kṣudro naraprāṇaviyojakaḥ ..
so'vatīrṇo narasyāṃgaṃ karṣayāmāsa kasyacit .. 15 ..
4.65.d:
क्रूरश्छिद्रपरः क्षुद्रो नरप्राणवियोजकः ॥
सोऽवतीर्णो नरस्यांगं कर्षयामास कस्यचित् ॥ 15 ॥
4.65.m: cruel, intent on others' weaknesses, vile, taking human lives. / Having descended, he tormented the body of a certain man.

4.65.s:
maṃtreṇāhūya siddhena vātikena vyasuḥ kṛtaḥ ..
saptame sa punarjāto durnirīkṣyavapurbhṛśam.. 16 ..
4.65.d:
मंत्रेणाहूय सिद्धेन वातिकेन व्यसुः कृतः ॥
सप्तमे स पुनर्जातो दुर्निरीक्ष्यवपुर्भृशम्॥ 16 ॥
4.65.m: Summoned with an accomplished mantra, he was rendered lifeless by a sorcerer. / In his seventh [birth] he was born again with a body exceedingly hideous to behold,

4.65.s:
krūradaṃṣdraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ ..
digvāsā marubhūmīṣu vāśiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ ..17..
4.65.d:
क्रूरदंष्द्रः करालास्यो मांसशोणितभोजनः ॥
दिग्वासा मरुभूमीषु वाशिष्ठो ब्रह्मराक्षसः ॥17॥
4.65.m: with cruel fangs, a terrifying face, feeding on flesh and blood, / naked, roaming in desert lands, a brahmarākṣasa sprung from Vasiṣṭha's lineage.

4.65.s:
sa rāṣṭraṃ jarjaraṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ cakre viṣādiṣu ..
ākramya bhīmadāsena rājñā rākṣasaśatruṇā .. 18..
4.65.d:
स राष्ट्रं जर्जरं शून्यं सर्वं चक्रे विषादिषु ॥
आक्रम्य भीमदासेन राज्ञा राक्षसशत्रुणा ॥ 18॥
4.65.m: He made the entire realm shattered and desolate among the afflicted. / Assailed by King Bhīmadāsa, a foe of rākṣasas,

4.65.s:
samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ ..
bhūyo'bhavadvyāghrasamaḥ svajanmanyaṣṭame bhuvi ..19..
4.65.d:
समारोप्य धनुः संख्ये ब्रह्मास्त्रेण निपातितः ॥
भूयोऽभवद्व्याघ्रसमः स्वजन्मन्यष्टमे भुवि ॥19॥
4.65.m: who strung his bow in battle, he was brought down with the Brahmā weapon. / Again, he became like a tiger in his eighth birth on earth.

4.65.s:
vanecarāṇāṃ kruddhāṅgo brāhmaṇānnidhanaṃ gataḥ ..
tato hastī ca bhallūko mātaṃgena dhanuṣmatā .. 4.65.20 ..
4.65.d:
वनेचराणां क्रुद्धाङ्गो ब्राह्मणान्निधनं गतः ॥
ततो हस्ती च भल्लूको मातंगेन धनुष्मता ॥ 4.65.20 ॥
4.65.m: Enraged against forest-dwellers, he met his death from a brāhmaṇa. / Then an elephant, and [next] a bear [killed] by a hunter equipped with a bow.

4.65.s:
ekādaśe'pi pāñcālo bhavamadhye'pi bhīṣaṇaḥ ..
ūrdhvakeśoti raktākṣo jāto hrasvatanurdṛḍhaḥ .. 21 ..
4.65.d:
एकादशेऽपि पाञ्चालो भवमध्येऽपि भीषणः ॥
ऊर्ध्वकेशोति रक्ताक्षो जातो ह्रस्वतनुर्दृढः ॥ 21 ॥
4.65.m: In his eleventh [birth], terrifying even amidst existence, [he was born in] Pañcāla, / with bristling hair, intensely red eyes, a short and sturdy body,

4.65.s:
pāpo dharmadhvajo rakṣo devatojjhitamālyadhṛka ..
sa daṇḍapāśikenaiva vṛkṣāgre hyavalaṃbitaḥ .. 22 ..
4.65.d:
पापो धर्मध्वजो रक्षो देवतोज्झितमाल्यधृक ॥
स दण्डपाशिकेनैव वृक्षाग्रे ह्यवलंबितः ॥ 22 ॥
4.65.m: wicked, an ostentatiously pious rakṣas, wearing garlands cast off from deities. / He was indeed hanged from the top of a tree by the royal executioner.

4.65.s:
dvādaśe sa punarjātaḥ puṣkalakleśabhājanaḥ ..
bhakṣyalobhādbilagato vyādhena vinipātitaḥ .. 23 ..
4.65.d:
द्वादशे स पुनर्जातः पुष्कलक्लेशभाजनः ॥
भक्ष्यलोभाद्बिलगतो व्याधेन विनिपातितः ॥ 23 ॥
4.65.m: In his twelfth [birth] he was born again as an abode of abundant suffering; / entering a hole out of greed for food, he was slain by a hunter.

4.65.s:
tena cāsītkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tārakadvādaśīvratam ..
tasya prabhāvājāto'pi duṣṭayonau punaḥpunaḥ .. 24 ..
4.65.d:
तेन चासीत्कृतं पूर्वं तारकद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
तस्य प्रभावाजातोऽपि दुष्टयोनौ पुनःपुनः ॥ 24 ॥
4.65.m: And by him the tārakadvādaśī votive observance had been performed formerly. / By the power of that, even though he was born again and again in evil wombs,

4.65.s:
avāpa śīghraṃ paṃcatvaṃ saṃsārabhavasāgare ..
punarevābhavadrājā vidarbhāyāṃ sudhārmikaḥ .. 25 ..
4.65.d:
अवाप शीघ्रं पंचत्वं संसारभवसागरे ॥
पुनरेवाभवद्राजा विदर्भायां सुधार्मिकः ॥ 25 ॥
4.65.m: he quickly met dissolution in the ocean of transmigratory existence. / He then became an exceedingly righteous king again in Vidarbhā,

4.65.s:
bhūyaścopoṣitā tena tārakadvādaśī śubhā ..
dṛśyatāṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ jātojātaḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 26 ..
4.65.d:
भूयश्चोपोषिता तेन तारकद्वादशी शुभा ॥
दृश्यतां व्रतमाहात्म्यं जातोजातः पुनःपुनः ॥ 26 ॥
4.65.m: and the auspicious tārakadvādaśī was observed as a fast by him once more. / Behold the greatness of the votive observance! Though born again and again,

4.65.s:
vrataprabhāvādbhuvane bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam ..
prāpa viṣṇupure sthānaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 27 ..
4.65.d:
व्रतप्रभावाद्भुवने भुक्त्वा राज्यमकण्टकम् ॥
प्राप विष्णुपुरे स्थानं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.65.m: by the power of the votive observance, having enjoyed an unhindered kingdom in the world, / he attained an abode in the realm of Viṣṇu until the dissolution of all beings.

4.65.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kartavyaṃ puruṣottamaiḥ ..
strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena snānadānajapādikam .. 28 ..
4.65.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कथमेतद्व्रतं कृष्ण कर्तव्यं पुरुषोत्तमैः ॥
स्त्रीभिर्वा भर्तृवाक्येन स्नानदानजपादिकम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.65.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How should this votive observance, consisting of bathing, giving, recitation and so forth, / be performed by excellent men, O Kṛṣṇa, or by women at the command of their husbands?

4.65.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe gṛhītvā dvādaśīvratam ..
akṛtrime jale snānamaparāhṇe samācaret .. .. 29 ..
4.65.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे गृहीत्वा द्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
अकृत्रिमे जले स्नानमपराह्णे समाचरेत् ॥ ॥ 29 ॥
4.65.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / Having undertaken the dvādaśī votive observance in the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, / one should bathe in natural water in the afternoon.

4.65.s:
praṇamya bhāskarāyātha kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā ..
homaśca tāvatsthātavyo yāvadastamito raviḥ .. 4.65.30 ..
4.65.d:
प्रणम्य भास्करायाथ कृत्वा देवार्चनं तथा ॥
होमश्च तावत्स्थातव्यो यावदस्तमितो रविः ॥ 4.65.30 ॥
4.65.m: Having bowed to the sun and likewise performed the worship of the deities, / the oblation into fire should be maintained until the sun has set.

4.65.s:
tato bhuktvā phalaiḥ puṣpairgandhadhūpa vilepanaiḥ ..
sajalaṃ sākṣataṃ kṛtvā sahiraṇyaṃ śubhaiḥ phalaiḥ .. 31 ..
4.65.d:
ततो भुक्त्वा फलैः पुष्पैर्गन्धधूप विलेपनैः ॥
सजलं साक्षतं कृत्वा सहिरण्यं शुभैः फलैः ॥ 31 ॥
4.65.m: Then, having eaten, [providing] with fruits, flowers, incense, fragrant unguents and ointments, / making [the offering] with water, unbroken grains, gold and auspicious fruits,

4.65.s:
ramye tāmramaye pātre jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ ..
pūrvāmukhaḥ pradoṣāgre mūrdhni kṛtvārghyabhājanam .. 32 ..
4.65.d:
रम्ये ताम्रमये पात्रे जानुभ्यां धरणीं गतः ॥
पूर्वामुखः प्रदोषाग्रे मूर्ध्नि कृत्वार्घ्यभाजनम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.65.m: in a lovely copper vessel, having gone to the earth on his knees, / facing east at the beginning of the evening twilight, placing the vessel of arghya on his head,

4.65.s:
bhūmau tu maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena satārakam ..
caṃdanena samālikhya dhruvaṃ hi gaganonmukhaḥ .. 33 ..
4.65.d:
भूमौ तु मंडलं कृत्वा गोमयेन सतारकम् ॥
चंदनेन समालिख्य ध्रुवं हि गगनोन्मुखः ॥ 33 ॥
4.65.m: having made a diagram on the ground with cow dung together with the stars, / having drawn the Pole Star with sandalwood, looking up toward the sky,

4.65.s:
sahasraśīrṣāmaṃtreṇa bhūmau śaktyā śanaiḥ svayam ..
tārakāṇāṃ kuruśreṣṭha dadyādarghyamataṃdritaḥ ..34..
4.65.d:
सहस्रशीर्षामंत्रेण भूमौ शक्त्या शनैः स्वयम् ॥
तारकाणां कुरुश्रेष्ठ दद्यादर्घ्यमतंद्रितः ॥34॥
4.65.m: with the Sahasraśīrṣā mantra, slowly by himself according to his ability on the ground, / O best of the Kurus, he should unweariedly offer the arghya to the stars.

4.65.s:
paryukṣya dhūmamutkṣipya dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ..
krameṇa sarvaṃ nirvartya bhojyaṃ bhojyaṃ niśāgame ..35..
4.65.d:
पर्युक्ष्य धूममुत्क्षिप्य दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
क्रमेण सर्वं निर्वर्त्य भोज्यं भोज्यं निशागमे ॥35॥
4.65.m: Having sprinkled water, having offered incense, he should give a priestly gift to a brāhmaṇa. / Having carried out everything in order, he should take his food at the arrival of night:

4.65.s:
mārgaśīrṣe khaṃḍakhādyaṃ pauṣe sohālakaṃ tathā ..
tilataṃḍulakaṃ māghe guḍāpūpaṃ ca phālgune ..36..
4.65.d:
मार्गशीर्षे खंडखाद्यं पौषे सोहालकं तथा ॥
तिलतंडुलकं माघे गुडापूपं च फाल्गुने ॥36॥
4.65.m: candied sweets in Mārgaśīrṣa, and likewise sohālaka pastry in Pauṣa; / sesame and rice in Māgha, and jaggery-cakes in Phālguna;

4.65.s:
modakāṃścaitramāse tu vaiśākhe khaṃḍaveṣṭakam ..
jyeṣṭhe saktubhṛtaiḥ pātrairāṣāḍhe guḍapūrikaiḥ .. 37 ..
4.65.d:
मोदकांश्चैत्रमासे तु वैशाखे खंडवेष्टकम् ॥
ज्येष्ठे सक्तुभृतैः पात्रैराषाढे गुडपूरिकैः ॥ 37 ॥
4.65.m: sweetmeats (modakas) in the month of Caitra, candied sweet rolls in Vaiśākha; / vessels filled with roasted barley meal in Jyeṣṭha, and jaggery-filled puris in Āṣāḍha;

4.65.s:
śrāvaṇe madhuśīrṣeṇa nabhasye pāyasena ca ..
ghṛtaparṇaiścāśvayuje kāṃsāraiḥ kārttike kramān .. 38 ..
4.65.d:
श्रावणे मधुशीर्षेण नभस्ये पायसेन च ॥
घृतपर्णैश्चाश्वयुजे कांसारैः कार्त्तिके क्रमान् ॥ 38 ॥
4.65.m: with honey-sweets in Śrāvaṇa, and with milk-rice pudding in Nabhasya; / with ghee-leaf cakes in Āśvayuja, and kāṃsāra sweetmeats in Kārttika, in succession.

4.65.s:
ebhirdvādaśabhirvarṣairbhojayitvā dvijānsvayam ..
bhuñjīta bhaktyā rājendra paścāddevaṃ kṣamāpayet .. 39 ..
4.65.d:
एभिर्द्वादशभिर्वर्षैर्भोजयित्वा द्विजान्स्वयम् ॥
भुञ्जीत भक्त्या राजेन्द्र पश्चाद्देवं क्षमापयेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.65.m: Having himself fed twice-born men for these twelve years, / he should eat with devotion, O best of kings, and afterwards ask forgiveness of the deity.

4.65.s:
samāpte tu vrate kṛtvā rājataṃ tārakāgaṇam ..
dṛṣṭvā vā pūrvavidhinā pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet .. 4.65.40 ..
4.65.d:
समाप्ते तु व्रते कृत्वा राजतं तारकागणम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा वा पूर्वविधिना पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत् ॥ 4.65.40 ॥
4.65.m: When the votive observance is completed, having fashioned the cluster of stars in silver, / or having seen it, having worshipped according to the former rule, he should ask forgiveness.

4.65.s:
kumbhā dvādaśa dātavyāḥ sodakā modakāśritāḥ ..
brāhmaṇyāṃ paridhānaṃ ca padmarāgaḥ sakuṃcakaḥ .. 41 ..
4.65.d:
कुम्भा द्वादश दातव्याः सोदका मोदकाश्रिताः ॥
ब्राह्मण्यां परिधानं च पद्मरागः सकुंचकः ॥ 41 ॥
4.65.m: Twelve jars filled with water and accompanied by modakas should be given, / and a garment, along with a ruby and a bodice, to a brāhmaṇa's wife;

4.65.s:
brāhmaṇe valgulallāṭaṃ lakṣapuṣpopaśobhitam ..
cālakenopavītaṃ ca puṣpaṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet .. 42 ..
4.65.d:
ब्राह्मणे वल्गुलल्लाटं लक्षपुष्पोपशोभितम् ॥
चालकेनोपवीतं च पुष्पं दत्त्वा क्षमापयेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.65.m: and to a brāhmaṇa, a lovely turban adorned with a hundred thousand flowers, / a fine sieve, a sacred thread, and flowers, and having given [these], he should ask forgiveness.

4.65.s:
anena vidhinā rājanyaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ ..
nārī vā bharataśreṣṭha bhaktibhāvapuraḥsarā .. 43 ..
4.65.d:
अनेन विधिना राजन्यः करोति व्रतं नरः ॥
नारी वा भरतश्रेष्ठ भक्तिभावपुरःसरा ॥ 43 ॥
4.65.m: A man who performs the votive observance according to this rule, O king, / or a woman, O best of the Bharatas, preceded by a state of devotion,

4.65.s:
nakṣatralokaṃ vrajati vimānenārkavarcasā ..
apsarogaṇagandharvayakṣavidyādharāmaraiḥ .. 44 ..
4.65.d:
नक्षत्रलोकं व्रजति विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ॥
अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वयक्षविद्याधरामरैः ॥ 44 ॥
4.65.m: goes to the world of the stars by a celestial chariot as radiant as the sun, / [accompanied] by hosts of apsarases, gandharvas, yakṣas, vidyādharas, and gods.

4.65.s:
sahasrabharttā svarloke pūjyamāno divākaraiḥ..
vasetkalpāyutaṃ yāvatpunarviṣṇupuraṃ vrajet .. 45 ..
4.65.d:
सहस्रभर्त्ता स्वर्लोके पूज्यमानो दिवाकरैः॥
वसेत्कल्पायुतं यावत्पुनर्विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 45 ॥
4.65.m: Honoured by suns in the heavenly realm as a master of thousands, / he would dwell there for myriad kalpas, and then return to the realm of Viṣṇu.

4.65.s:
etadvrataṃ purā cīrṇaṃ śacyā rājñyā śriyomayā ..
sītayā damayaṃtyā ca rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā .. 46 ..
4.65.d:
एतद्व्रतं पुरा चीर्णं शच्या राज्ञ्या श्रियोमया ॥
सीतया दमयंत्या च रुक्मिण्या सत्यभामया ॥ 46 ॥
4.65.m: This votive observance was formerly undertaken by Śacī the queen, by Śrī, by Umā, / by Sītā, Damayantī, Rukmiṇī, and Satyabhāmā;

4.65.s:
menayā raṃbhayā svarge urvaśyā devadattayā ..
anyābhirapi nārībhiḥ puruṣaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 47 ..
4.65.d:
मेनया रंभया स्वर्गे उर्वश्या देवदत्तया ॥
अन्याभिरपि नारीभिः पुरुषैश्च पृथग्विधैः ॥ 47 ॥
4.65.m: by Menā, Rambhā in heaven, Urvaśī, and Devadattā; / and by other women too, and various men.

4.65.s: cīrṇametadvrataṃ pārtha sarvapāpabhayāpaham .. 48 ..
4.65.d: चीर्णमेतद्व्रतं पार्थ सर्वपापभयापहम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.65.m: This votive observance, removing all sins and fears, was practiced, O son of Pṛthā.

4.65.s:
janmāṃtareṣvapi kṛtāni haratyaghāni yā saṃdahatyaharahaḥ sukṛtopayogāt ..
sā dvādaśī jagati tārakanāmadheyā tannāsti yanna vidadhāti kṛtā manuṣyaiḥ .. 49 ..
araṇyadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.65.d:
जन्मांतरेष्वपि कृतानि हरत्यघानि या संदहत्यहरहः सुकृतोपयोगात् ॥
सा द्वादशी जगति तारकनामधेया तन्नास्ति यन्न विदधाति कृता मनुष्यैः ॥ 49 ॥
अरण्यद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.65.m:
That which removes sins committed even in other lifetimes, which burns them away day after day through the use of meritorious deeds— / that is the dvādaśī named Tārakā in this world; there is nothing it does not accomplish when performed by human beings.
Description of the Araṇyadvādaśī Votive Observance

4.66.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanbrūhi me samyagaraṇyadvādaśīvratam ..
saprāśanaṃ sopavāsaṃ sarahasyaṃ samantrakam .. 1 ..
4.66.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्ब्रूहि मे सम्यगरण्यद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
सप्राशनं सोपवासं सरहस्यं समन्त्रकम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.66.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, tell me properly about the votive observance of the Araṇyadvādaśī, / with its consumption [of food], its fast, its secret [instructions], and its mantras.

4.66.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kauṃteya yatpurā cīrṇaṃ sītayā vanasaṃsthayā ..
vrataṃ rāghavavākyena praśastaṃ doṣavarjitam .. 2 ..
4.66.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कौंतेय यत्पुरा चीर्णं सीतया वनसंस्थया ॥
व्रतं राघववाक्येन प्रशस्तं दोषवर्जितम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.66.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / O son of Kuntī, this votive observance, which was formerly undertaken by Sītā while living in the forest / at the instruction of Rāghava, is praised and free of faults.

4.66.s:
lopāmudrālaye sādhvyo munipatnyo bahuprajāḥ ..
bhojitāstarpitāḥ sarvairāhāraiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ .. 3 ..
4.66.d:
लोपामुद्रालये साध्व्यो मुनिपत्न्यो बहुप्रजाः ॥
भोजितास्तर्पिताः सर्वैराहारैः सर्वकामिकैः ॥ 3 ॥
4.66.m: In the hermitage of Lopāmudrā, virtuous wives of sages having many children / were fed and satisfied with all kinds of foods fulfilling all desires,

4.66.s:
padminīpatravistīrṇe sopadaṃśai ryathā navaiḥ ..
bhakṣyabhojyaistathā lehyaiścoṣyaiścāpi yadṛcchayā .. 4 ..
4.66.d:
पद्मिनीपत्रविस्तीर्णे सोपदंशै र्यथा नवैः ॥
भक्ष्यभोज्यैस्तथा लेह्यैश्चोष्यैश्चापि यदृच्छया ॥ 4 ॥
4.66.m: spread out upon lotus leaves, with fresh condiments, / with confectionery, staple foods, licked dishes, and sucked delicacies, as desired.

4.66.s:
tāmihaikamanāḥ pārthaḥ śṛṇuṣvāraṇyadvādaśīm ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ dinodaye .. 5 ..
4.66.d:
तामिहैकमनाः पार्थः शृणुष्वारण्यद्वादशीम् ॥
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे एकादश्यां दिनोदये ॥ 5 ॥
4.66.m: Hear about that Araṇyadvādaśī here with a single mind, O son of Pṛthā: / In the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the ekādaśī, at sunrise,

4.66.s:
snātvā naraḥ sopavāsaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ janārdane ..
gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpairdīpairjāgaraṇairniśām ..6..
4.66.d:
स्नात्वा नरः सोपवासः कृत्वा पूजां जनार्दने ॥
गंधपुष्पाक्षतैर्धूपैर्दीपैर्जागरणैर्निशाम् ॥6॥
4.66.m: a man should bathe, observe a fast, and perform worship to Janārdana / with perfumes, flowers, unhusked barley grains, incense, and lamps, passing the night in a vigil.

4.66.s:
nītvā prabhāte gatvā ca vane vedāṅgapāragān ..
bhojayitvā phalaprāyaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 7 ..
4.66.d:
नीत्वा प्रभाते गत्वा च वने वेदाङ्गपारगान् ॥
