भोजयित्वा फलप्रायं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥ 7 ॥
4.66.m: Having passed [the night], he should go into the forest at dawn, feed those who have mastered the Vedāṅgas / mostly with fruits, and then eat himself, restrained in speech.

4.66.s:
pañcagavyaṃ prāśayitvā pūrvamevātha taddine ..
varṣamekaṃ śubhaṃ pūrṇa pārayitvā yudhiṣṭhira..8..
4.66.d:
पञ्चगव्यं प्राशयित्वा पूर्वमेवाथ तद्दिने ॥
वर्षमेकं शुभं पूर्ण पारयित्वा युधिष्ठिर॥8॥
4.66.m: Having first consumed the five products of the cow on that day, / and having completed one full auspicious year [of the rite], O Yudhiṣṭhira,

4.66.s:
śrāvaṇe kārttike māghe caitre vātha samarcite ..
sopadaṃśaiḥ patraśākaistilaśaṣkulikādibhiḥ .. 9 ..
4.66.d:
श्रावणे कार्त्तिके माघे चैत्रे वाथ समर्चिते ॥
सोपदंशैः पत्रशाकैस्तिलशष्कुलिकादिभिः ॥ 9 ॥
4.66.m: in Śrāvaṇa, Kārttika, Māgha, or Caitra, when [the Lord] has been properly worshipped, / with condiments, leafy vegetables, sesame cakes, and the like,

4.66.s:
apūpaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiśca marīcaiḥ siṃhakesaraiḥ ..
dhūlīmukhai ramṛtaphalaiḥ svādukokarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 4.66.10 ..
4.66.d:
अपूपैः खण्डवेष्टैश्च मरीचैः सिंहकेसरैः ॥
धूलीमुखै रमृतफलैः स्वादुकोकरसैः शुभैः ॥ 4.66.10 ॥
4.66.m: with flatbreads, sugar-wrapped cakes, black pepper, lion-mane savouries, / dhūlīmukha pastries, amṛta fruits, and sweet, auspicious wild mango juices;

4.66.s:
śītalaistarpayedvidvānarkapuṣpaiḥ sumālakaiḥ ..
dadhikṣīrājyapāṇijyaiścāturjātakaraṃjitaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.66.d:
शीतलैस्तर्पयेद्विद्वानर्कपुष्पैः सुमालकैः ॥
दधिक्षीराज्यपाणिज्यैश्चातुर्जातकरंजितैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.66.m: cool [liquids], the wise man should gratify [them] with arka flowers, beautiful garlands, / curds, milk, ghee, palm-oil, and things coloured with the four aromatics;

4.66.s:
karpūranakha viddhaiśca madhuraiḥ panasottamaiḥ ..
bahuvṛkṣaṃ vanaṃ gatvā susvādusalilaṃ śivam ..12..
4.66.d:
कर्पूरनख विद्धैश्च मधुरैः पनसोत्तमैः ॥
बहुवृक्षं वनं गत्वा सुस्वादुसलिलं शिवम् ॥12॥
4.66.m: pierced with bits of camphor, and sweet, excellent jackfruits. / Having gone to a forest with many trees, sweet water, and auspicious surroundings,

4.66.s:
sukhāsanopaviṣṭāṃśca prāgudaṅmukhavacchucīn ..
bhojayeddaśa ca dvau vā munīnāraṇyavāsinaḥ .. 13 ..
4.66.d:
सुखासनोपविष्टांश्च प्रागुदङ्मुखवच्छुचीन् ॥
भोजयेद्दश च द्वौ वा मुनीनारण्यवासिनः ॥ 13 ॥
4.66.m: he should feed ten or twelve sages living in the forest, / seated on comfortable seats, pure, facing east or north:

4.66.s:
ekadaṃḍīstridaṃḍīśca gṛhasthāṃścāpi suvratān ..
brāhmaṇīrvividhāḥ sapta ekapatnīḥ pativratāḥ .. 14 ..
4.66.d:
एकदंडीस्त्रिदंडीश्च गृहस्थांश्चापि सुव्रतान् ॥
ब्राह्मणीर्विविधाः सप्त एकपत्नीः पतिव्रताः ॥ 14 ॥
4.66.m: single-staff ascetics, triple-staff ascetics, and householders of good vows; / and seven various Brahmin women, devoted to their single husband and loyal to their spouse,

4.66.s:
cārvaṃgyaścārcitāḥ snātāḥ sarvāvayamaśobhanāḥ ..
suvastrāḥ kukumāktāṅgāḥ sugaṃdhakusumāṃcitāḥ .. 15 ..
4.66.d:
चार्वंग्यश्चार्चिताः स्नाताः सर्वावयमशोभनाः ॥
सुवस्त्राः कुकुमाक्ताङ्गाः सुगंधकुसुमांचिताः ॥ 15 ॥
4.66.m: fair-limbed, worshipped, bathed, beautiful in every limb, / well-dressed, their bodies anointed with saffron, adorned with fragrant flowers.

4.66.s:
aṃgairvā bhojanīyāstāstāścādityasya devatāḥ ..
vāsudevajanārdanadāmodaramadhusūdanāḥ .. 16 ..
4.66.d:
अंगैर्वा भोजनीयास्तास्ताश्चादित्यस्य देवताः ॥
वासुदेवजनार्दनदामोदरमधुसूदनाः ॥ 16 ॥
4.66.m: Or they are to be fed with the limbs [of the rite], those deities of the sun: / Vāsudeva, Janārdana, Dāmodara, Madhusūdana,

4.66.s:
padmanābhakṛṣṇaviṣṇugovarddhanatrivikramāḥ ..
śrīdharaśca hṛṣīkeśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa ādivārāhāḥ .. 17 ..
4.66.d:
पद्मनाभकृष्णविष्णुगोवर्द्धनत्रिविक्रमाः ॥
श्रीधरश्च हृषीकेशः पुण्डरीकाक्ष आदिवाराहाः ॥ 17 ॥
4.66.m: Padmanābha, Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, Govardhana, Trivikrama, / Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa, Puṇḍarīkākṣa, and Ādivārāha.

4.66.s:
ebhirdvādaśabhirmantrairnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ ..
gaṃdhacandanasaṃvastraṃ dhūpaṃ dattvā pṛthakpṛthak .. 18 ..
4.66.d:
एभिर्द्वादशभिर्मन्त्रैर्नमस्कारांतयोजितैः ॥
गंधचन्दनसंवस्त्रं धूपं दत्त्वा पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 18 ॥
4.66.m: With these twelve mantras ending with 'namas', / having individually offered perfume, sandalwood, clothing, and incense,

4.66.s:
bhojayitvā śubhānnāni dadyāttābhyaḥ sudakṣiṇām ..
praṇamya prārthayedbhaktyā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti .. 19 ..
4.66.d:
भोजयित्वा शुभान्नानि दद्यात्ताभ्यः सुदक्षिणाम् ॥
प्रणम्य प्रार्थयेद्भक्त्या विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 19 ॥
4.66.m: and having fed them auspicious foods, he should give them a generous gift. / Having bowed, he should pray with devotion: 'May Viṣṇu be pleased with me.'

4.66.s:
tato bhuñjīta sahito bhṛtyaiḥ preṣyajanena ca ..
āgatābhyāgatairlokaiḥ suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibaṃdhubhiḥ .. .. 4.66.20 ..
4.66.d:
ततो भुञ्जीत सहितो भृत्यैः प्रेष्यजनेन च ॥
आगताभ्यागतैर्लोकैः सुहृत्संबंधिबंधुभिः ॥ ॥ 4.66.20 ॥
4.66.m: Then he should eat together with his servants and attendants, / with guests who have arrived or appeared, and with friends, in-laws, and kinsmen.

4.66.s:
evaṃ kauṃteya kurute yo'raṇyadvādaśīṃ naraḥ ..
sa dehāṃte vimānastho divyakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ ..
yāti jñātisamāyuktaḥ śvetadvīpaṃ hareḥ puram .. .. 21 ..
4.66.d:
एवं कौंतेय कुरुते योऽरण्यद्वादशीं नरः ॥
स देहांते विमानस्थो दिव्यकन्यासमावृतः ॥
याति ज्ञातिसमायुक्तः श्वेतद्वीपं हरेः पुरम् ॥ ॥ 21 ॥
4.66.m: A man who thus observes the Araṇyadvādaśī, O son of Kuntī, / at the end of his body, seated in a celestial chariot and surrounded by heavenly maidens, / goes together with his kinsmen to Śvetadvīpa, the abode of Hari,

4.66.s:
yatra lokāḥ pītavastrāḥ śyāmadehāścaturbhujāḥ ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacāruhastāḥ sakaustubhāḥ .. 22 ..
4.66.d:
यत्र लोकाः पीतवस्त्राः श्यामदेहाश्चतुर्भुजाः ॥
शंखचक्रगदापद्मचारुहस्ताः सकौस्तुभाः ॥ 22 ॥
4.66.m: where the people wear yellow garments, have dark bodies, four arms, / beautiful hands holding conch, discus, mace, and lotus, and possess the Kaustubha jewel;

4.66.s:
garuḍāsanāḥ sābharaṇā mukuṭotkaṭa kuṃḍalāḥ ..
nīlotpaloddāmapadmamālayālaṃkṛtorasaḥ ..23..
4.66.d:
गरुडासनाः साभरणा मुकुटोत्कट कुंडलाः ॥
नीलोत्पलोद्दामपद्ममालयालंकृतोरसः ॥23॥
4.66.m: they have Garuḍa as their mount, wear ornaments, towering diadems, and earrings, / and their chests are decorated with garlands of blue lotuses and blooming lotuses;

4.66.s:
lakṣmīdharā meghavarṇāḥ kūrparāṅgadabhūṣaṇāḥ ..
tiṣṭhaṃti viṣṇusāmānye yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. .. 24 ..
4.66.d:
लक्ष्मीधरा मेघवर्णाः कूर्पराङ्गदभूषणाः ॥
तिष्ठंति विष्णुसामान्ये यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ ॥ 24 ॥
4.66.m: they possess splendour, have the complexion of a cloud, and are adorned with armlets on their elbows. / They remain equal in status with Viṣṇu until the dissolution of all beings.

4.66.s:
tasmādetya mahātejāḥ pṛthivyāṃ nṛpapūjitāḥ ..
martyaloke kīrtimaṃtaḥ saṃbhavaṃti narottamāḥ .. 25 ..
4.66.d:
तस्मादेत्य महातेजाः पृथिव्यां नृपपूजिताः ॥
मर्त्यलोके कीर्तिमंतः संभवंति नरोत्तमाः ॥ 25 ॥
4.66.m: Returning from there, endowed with great splendour, worshipped by kings on earth, / they are born as the best of men, renowned in the mortal world.

4.66.s:
tato yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ mokṣamārgaṃ śivaṃ śubham ..
yatra gatvā na śocaṃti na saṃsāre bhramaṃti ca .. 26 ..
4.66.d:
ततो यांति परं स्थानं मोक्षमार्गं शिवं शुभम् ॥
यत्र गत्वा न शोचंति न संसारे भ्रमंति च ॥ 26 ॥
4.66.m: Then they go to the supreme abode, the auspicious and blessed path to liberation, / having gone to which they do not grieve nor wander in worldly existence.

4.66.s:
ye dvādaśīmupavasaṃti sitāmaraṇyanāmnīṃ vane dvijavarānatha bhojayaṃti ..
sādhvyaḥ striyaḥ sucaritābharaṇāśca tāsāṃ viṣṇuḥ prasādamupayāti dadāti mokṣam .. 27 .. ..
rohiṇīcandravratavarṇanam
4.66.d:
ये द्वादशीमुपवसंति सितामरण्यनाम्नीं वने द्विजवरानथ भोजयंति ॥
साध्व्यः स्त्रियः सुचरिताभरणाश्च तासां विष्णुः प्रसादमुपयाति ददाति मोक्षम् ॥ 27 ॥ ॥
रोहिणीचन्द्रव्रतवर्णनम्
4.66.m:
Those who fast on the bright dvādaśī named Araṇyā and feed the best of Brahmins in the forest, / and virtuous women adorned with good conduct—to them Viṣṇu grants his favour and bestows liberation.
Description of the Rohiṇīcandra Votive Observance

4.67.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ghanāvṛte vare deve varṣākāle hyupasthite ..
mayūrakekākulite dardurārāvapūrite .. 1 ..
4.67.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
घनावृते वरे देवे वर्षाकाले ह्युपस्थिते ॥
मयूरकेकाकुलिते दर्दुरारावपूरिते ॥ 1 ॥
4.67.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / When the sky is covered with clouds, the rainy season has arrived, / filled with the cries of peacocks, and resounding with the croaking of frogs,

4.67.s:
kulastriyaḥ prayacchaṃti kasyānnaṃ kā'tra devatā ..
kiṃ vrataṃ kṛṣṇa vikhyātamannaṃ kasyāṃ tithau bhavet .. 2 ..
4.67.d:
कुलस्त्रियः प्रयच्छंति कस्यान्नं काऽत्र देवता ॥
किं व्रतं कृष्ण विख्यातमन्नं कस्यां तिथौ भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥
4.67.m: to whom do women of good family give food? Who is the deity here? / What celebrated votive observance is this, O Kṛṣṇa, and on what lunar day should the food be given?

4.67.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pravṛtte śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe hyupasthite ..
ekādaśyāṃ śucirbhūtvā sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 3 ..
4.67.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रवृत्ते श्रावणे मासि कृष्णपक्षे ह्युपस्थिते ॥
एकादश्यां शुचिर्भूत्वा सर्वौषधिजलैः शुभैः ॥ 3 ॥
4.67.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When the month of Śrāvaṇa has commenced and the dark fortnight has arrived, / on the ekādaśī, having purified oneself with auspicious waters infused with all medicinal herbs,

4.67.s:
māṣacūrṇena rājendra kuryādiṃdurikāśanam ..
modakāṃśca tathā paṃca ghṛtapakvānsunirmalān .. 4 ..
4.67.d:
माषचूर्णेन राजेन्द्र कुर्यादिंदुरिकाशनम् ॥
मोदकांश्च तथा पंच घृतपक्वान्सुनिर्मलान् ॥ 4 ॥
4.67.m: O best of kings, one should make food of indurikās with black gram flour, / and likewise five very clean sweetmeat dumplings cooked in ghee,

4.67.s:
naramekaikamuddiśya tato gatvā jalāśayam ..
duṣṭayādovirahitaṃ satoyaṃ jalajairyutam .. 5 ..
4.67.d:
नरमेकैकमुद्दिश्य ततो गत्वा जलाशयम् ॥
दुष्टयादोविरहितं सतोयं जलजैर्युतम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.67.m: intended for each single person. Then, having gone to a body of water / that is free from vicious aquatic beasts, full of water, and filled with lotus flowers,

4.67.s:
tasyaiva puline ramye juṣṭānne gomayādinā ..
kṛtvā maṃḍalakaṃ vṛttaṃ piṣṭakādibhirarcitam .. 6 ..
4.67.d:
तस्यैव पुलिने रम्ये जुष्टान्ने गोमयादिना ॥
कृत्वा मंडलकं वृत्तं पिष्टकादिभिरर्चितम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.67.m: on the charming sandy bank of that very [water], having purified the ground with cow-dung and the like, / and having drawn a circular diagram decorated with ground rice paste and the like,

4.67.s:
carcitaṃ gaṃdhakusumairdhūpa dīpākṣatojjvalam ..
tatra caṃdraṃ likhedeva rohiṇyā sahitaṃ vibhum..
arcayecca sabhāryo vai mantreṇānena bhāvitaḥ ..7 ..
4.67.d:
चर्चितं गंधकुसुमैर्धूप दीपाक्षतोज्ज्वलम् ॥
तत्र चंद्रं लिखेदेव रोहिण्या सहितं विभुम्॥
अर्चयेच्च सभार्यो वै मन्त्रेणानेन भावितः ॥7 ॥
4.67.m: anointed with perfumes and flowers, radiant with incense, lamps, and unhusked barley grains, / one should draw the Moon, the all-pervading deity, along with Rohiṇī there; / and accompanied by one's wife, absorbed in contemplation, one should worship [him] with this mantra:

4.67.s:
somarāja namastubhyaṃ rohiṇyai te namonamaḥ ..
mahāsati mahādevi saṃpādaya mamepsitam .. 8 ..
4.67.d:
सोमराज नमस्तुभ्यं रोहिण्यै ते नमोनमः ॥
महासति महादेवि संपादय ममेप्सितम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.67.m: 'O king Soma, homage to you! Homage, homage to you, O Rohiṇī! / O great chaste lady, O great goddess, accomplish my desire!'

4.67.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya tasyāgre naivedyaṃ deyamarcitam ..
tatraiva brāhmaṇe dadyātsomo me prīyatā miti ..
prīyatāmiti me devī rohiṇī sahitapriyā .. 9 ..
4.67.d:
एवं संपूज्य तस्याग्रे नैवेद्यं देयमर्चितम् ॥
तत्रैव ब्राह्मणे दद्यात्सोमो मे प्रीयता मिति ॥
प्रीयतामिति मे देवी रोहिणी सहितप्रिया ॥ 9 ॥
4.67.m: Having thus worshipped, one should offer consecrated food offerings before him. / Right there, one should give to a brāhmaṇa, saying: "May Soma be pleased with me! / May the goddess Rohiṇī, together with her beloved, be pleased with me!"

4.67.s:
evamuccārya dattvā ca tatoṃ'tarjalamāviśet ..
kaṃṭhāṃtaṃ kaṭimātraṃ vā gulphāṃtaṃ vā jalā śaye .. 4.67.10 ..
4.67.d:
एवमुच्चार्य दत्त्वा च ततोंऽतर्जलमाविशेत् ॥
कंठांतं कटिमात्रं वा गुल्फांतं वा जला शये ॥ 4.67.10 ॥
4.67.m: Having uttered this and made the gift, he should then enter into the water / up to his neck, or up to his waist, or up to his ankles in the reservoir.

4.67.s:
dhyāyecca manasā somaṃ rohiṇīsahitaṃ tadā ..
yāvatsamastaṃ tadbhuktaṃ bhuktvā cāṃtastaṭe sthitaḥ .. 11 ..
4.67.d:
ध्यायेच्च मनसा सोमं रोहिणीसहितं तदा ॥
यावत्समस्तं तद्भुक्तं भुक्त्वा चांतस्तटे स्थितः ॥ 11 ॥
4.67.m: And he should then meditate in his mind upon Soma accompanied by Rohiṇī / while all that [gifted food] is eaten; and when [the brāhmaṇa] has eaten, he stands on the bank inside.

4.67.s:
niyamya vasatāṃ cānye tato viprāya bhojanam ..
dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ deyaṃ niścayaṃ vāci kalpayet ..
bhaktyā śaktyā yathācittaṃ yathāvittaṃ tathā tathā .. 12 ..
4.67.d:
नियम्य वसतां चान्ये ततो विप्राय भोजनम् ॥
दक्षिणासहितं देयं निश्चयं वाचि कल्पयेत् ॥
भक्त्या शक्त्या यथाचित्तं यथावित्तं तथा तथा ॥ 12 ॥
4.67.m: And having controlled [himself], while others reside [there], he should then give food accompanied by a sacrificial fee to a vipra; / he should formulate a resolve in words, / with devotion, according to his capacity, according to his disposition, and according to his wealth, in that manner.

4.67.s:
yaḥ karoti naro rājannārī vātha kumārikā ..
varṣevarṣe vidhānena pārthedaṃ rohiṇīvratam .. 13 ..
4.67.d:
यः करोति नरो राजन्नारी वाथ कुमारिका ॥
वर्षेवर्षे विधानेन पार्थेदं रोहिणीव्रतम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.67.m: Whatever man performs this, O king, or woman, or maiden, / year after year according to the injunction, O son of Pṛthā, this Rohiṇī-vrata,

4.67.s:
iha loke ciraṃ sthitvā dhanadhānyasamākule ..
gṛhāśrame śubhāṃ labdhvā putrapautrādisaṃtatim .. 14 ..
4.67.d:
इह लोके चिरं स्थित्वा धनधान्यसमाकुले ॥
गृहाश्रमे शुभां लब्ध्वा पुत्रपौत्रादिसंततिम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.67.m: having remained long in this world filled with wealth and grain, / having obtained an auspicious lineage of sons, grandsons, and so forth in the householder's stage of life,

4.67.s:
tataḥ sutīrthe maraṇaṃ tato brahmapuraṃ vrajet ..
tasmādviṣṇupuraṃ pārtha tato rudrapuraṃ śubham ..15..
4.67.d:
ततः सुतीर्थे मरणं ततो ब्रह्मपुरं व्रजेत् ॥
तस्माद्विष्णुपुरं पार्थ ततो रुद्रपुरं शुभम् ॥15॥
4.67.m: then dies at a sacred bathing-place and then goes to the realm of Brahmā. / From that [he goes] to the realm of Viṣṇu, O son of Pṛthā, and then to the auspicious realm of Rudra.

4.67.s:
khe rohiṇī śaśadharābhimatā hitā ca kiṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu narendra nivedayāmi ..
saṃpiṣṭamāṣaraciteṃdurikāśituṃ yadbhuktaṃ jale guḍaghṛtena phalaṃ tadetat ..16.. ..
aviyogavratavarṇanam
4.67.d:
खे रोहिणी शशधराभिमता हिता च किं कारणं शृणु नरेन्द्र निवेदयामि ॥
संपिष्टमाषरचितेंदुरिकाशितुं यद्भुक्तं जले गुडघृतेन फलं तदेतत् ॥16॥ ॥
अवियोगव्रतवर्णनम्
4.67.m:
Rohiṇī is beloved of the moon in the sky and beneficent. Hear the reason, O king of men; I shall tell [it]: / this is that fruit because of which a cold cake made of ground black gram with raw sugar and clarified butter was eaten in the water.
Description of the Aviyogavrata

4.68.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
aviyogavrataṃ brūhi mama yādavanaṃdana ..
vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛkca kiṃ puṇyaṃ kā'tra devatā .. 1 ..
4.68.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अवियोगव्रतं ब्रूहि मम यादवनंदन ॥
विधानं तस्य कीदृक्च किं पुण्यं काऽत्र देवता ॥ 1 ॥
4.68.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me, O delight of the Yādavas, of the Aviyogavrata; / what is its ritual injunction, what is the merit, and who is the deity here?

4.68.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena kathyamānaṃ yathākhilam ..
aviyogavrataṃ nāma vratānāmuttamottamam .. 2 ..
4.68.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पांडव यत्नेन कथ्यमानं यथाखिलम् ॥
अवियोगव्रतं नाम व्रतानामुत्तमोत्तमम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.68.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen with care, O Pāṇḍava, as it is told in its entirety: / the vrata named Aviyoga is the highest among excellent vratas.

4.68.s:
prauṣṭhapade śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthitaḥ ..
yastu śuklāṃbaradharaḥ snātvā pūrvaṃ jalāśaye .. 3 ..
4.68.d:
प्रौष्ठपदे शुक्लपक्षे द्वादश्यां प्रातरुत्थितः ॥
यस्तु शुक्लांबरधरः स्नात्वा पूर्वं जलाशये ॥ 3 ॥
4.68.m: Having risen in the morning on the twelfth [tithi] in the bright fortnight of Prauṣṭhapada, / one who wears white garments, having first bathed in a reservoir,

4.68.s:
hṛdye ramye saudhataṭe hariṃ likhyeta maṇḍale ..
godhūmacūrṇapiṣṭena lakṣmī tatpārśvavartinīm .. 4 ..
4.68.d:
हृद्ये रम्ये सौधतटे हरिं लिख्येत मण्डले ॥
गोधूमचूर्णपिष्टेन लक्ष्मी तत्पार्श्ववर्तिनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.68.m: on a delightful and charming plastered terrace, should draw Hari in a maṇḍala / with paste of wheat flour, and Lakṣmī standing at his side;

4.68.s:
tatraiva ca haraṃ gaurīṃ sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā saha ..
rājñīsahitaṃ ca raviṃ trailokyodyotakārakam .. 5 ..
4.68.d:
तत्रैव च हरं गौरीं सावित्रीं ब्रह्मणा सह ॥
राज्ञीसहितं च रविं त्रैलोक्योद्योतकारकम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.68.m: and right there, Hara and Gaurī, and Sāvitrī together with Brahmā, / and Ravi, the illuminator of the three worlds, accompanied by Rājñī.

4.68.s:
gaṃdhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpairnaivedyairarcayedyathāśaktyā ..
aviyogavratacārī maṃtreṇānena rājendra..6..
4.68.d:
गंधैः पुष्पैश्च धूपैर्नैवेद्यैरर्चयेद्यथाशक्त्या ॥
अवियोगव्रतचारी मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र॥6॥
4.68.m: He should worship them with perfumes, flowers, incenses, and food offerings according to his capacity, / one observing the Aviyogavrata, with this mantra, O king of kings:

4.68.s:
nārī vā puruṣo vā aviyogamatiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā ..
bhaktyā dhyānī maunī dāṃpatyaṃ pūjayeddevam .. 7 ..
4.68.d:
नारी वा पुरुषो वा अवियोगमतिं दृढां कृत्वा ॥
भक्त्या ध्यानी मौनी दांपत्यं पूजयेद्देवम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.68.m: Whether woman or man, having formed a firm intention of non-separation, / with devotion, contemplative, maintaining silence, one should worship the divine couple:

4.68.s:
sahasramūrddhā puruṣaḥ padmanābho janārdanaḥ ..
vyāso'pi kapilācāryo bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ..8..
4.68.d:
सहस्रमूर्द्धा पुरुषः पद्मनाभो जनार्दनः ॥
व्यासोऽपि कपिलाचार्यो भगवान्पुरुषोत्तमः ॥8॥
4.68.m: "The thousand-headed Person, Padmanābha, Janārdana, / Vyāsa, teacher Kapila, the venerable Puruṣottama,

4.68.s:
nārāyaṇo madhuliho viṣṇurdāmoharo hariḥ ..
mahāvarāho goviṃdaḥ keśavo garuḍadhvajaḥ .. 9 ..
4.68.d:
नारायणो मधुलिहो विष्णुर्दामोहरो हरिः ॥
महावराहो गोविंदः केशवो गरुडध्वजः ॥ 9 ॥
4.68.m: Nārāyaṇa, slayer of Madhu, Viṣṇu, Dāmodara, Hari, / Mahāvarāha, Govinda, Keśava, he whose banner is Garuḍa,

4.68.s:
śrīdharaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣo viśvarūpastrivikramaḥ ..
upendro vāmano rāmo vaikuṃṭho mādhavo dhruvaḥ .. 4.68.10 ..
4.68.d:
श्रीधरः पुंडरीकाक्षो विश्वरूपस्त्रिविक्रमः ॥
उपेन्द्रो वामनो रामो वैकुंठो माधवो ध्रुवः ॥ 4.68.10 ॥
4.68.m: Śrīdhara, the lotus-eyed one, Viśvarūpa, Trivikrama, / Upendra, Vāmana, Rāma, Vaikuṇṭha, Mādhava, Dhruva,

4.68.s:
vāsudevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sakarṣaṇo'cyutaḥ ..
aniruddho mahāyogī pradyumno naṃda eva ca .. 11 ..
4.68.d:
वासुदेवो हृषीकेशः कृष्णः सकर्षणोऽच्युतः ॥
अनिरुद्धो महायोगी प्रद्युम्नो नंद एव च ॥ 11 ॥
4.68.m: Vāsudeva, Hṛṣīkeśa, Kṛṣṇa, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Acyuta, / Aniruddha, the great yogin, Pradyumna, and Nanda—

4.68.s:
nityaṃ sa me śubhaḥ prītaḥ saśrīkaḥ keśaśūlinaḥ ..
umāpatinīlakaṃṭhaḥ sthāṇuḥ śaṃbhurbhagākṣihā .. .. 12 ..
4.68.d:
नित्यं स मे शुभः प्रीतः सश्रीकः केशशूलिनः ॥
उमापतिनीलकंठः स्थाणुः शंभुर्भगाक्षिहा ॥ ॥ 12 ॥
4.68.m: may he, auspicious, accompanied by Śrī, be ever pleased with me! / The trident-bearer having locks of hair, the lord of Umā, the blue-throated one, Sthāṇu, Śambhu, destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga,

4.68.s:
īśāno bhairavaḥ śūlī tryaṃbakastripurāṃtakaḥ ..
kapardīśo mahāliṃgī mahākālo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ..13..
4.68.d:
ईशानो भैरवः शूली त्र्यंबकस्त्रिपुरांतकः ॥
कपर्दीशो महालिंगी महाकालो वृषध्वजः ॥13॥
4.68.m: Īśāna, Bhairava, the trident-bearer, Tryambaka, destroyer of Tripura, / lord of the braided hair, Mahāliṅgin, Mahākāla, he whose banner is the bull,

4.68.s:
śivaḥ śarvo mahādevo rudro bhūtamaheśvaraḥ ..
mamāstu saha pārvatyā śaṃkaraḥ śaṃkaraściram .. 14 ..
4.68.d:
शिवः शर्वो महादेवो रुद्रो भूतमहेश्वरः ॥
ममास्तु सह पार्वत्या शंकरः शंकरश्चिरम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.68.m: Śiva, Śarva, Mahādeva, Rudra, great lord of spirits— / may Śaṅkara, the source of auspiciousness, be mine for a long time together with Pārvatī!

4.68.s:
brahmā śaṃbhuḥ prabhuḥ sraṣṭā puṣkarī prapitāmahaḥ ..
hiraṇyagarbho vedajñaḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ ..15 ..
4.68.d:
ब्रह्मा शंभुः प्रभुः स्रष्टा पुष्करी प्रपितामहः ॥
हिरण्यगर्भो वेदज्ञः परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिः ॥15 ॥
4.68.m: Brahmā, Śambhu, the sovereign, the creator, the lotus-dweller, the great-grandfather, / Hiraṇyagarbha, knower of the Vedas, Parameṣṭhin, Prajāpati,

4.68.s:
caturmukhaḥ sṛṣṭikartā svayaṃbhūḥ kamalāsanaḥ ..
virañciḥ padmayoniśca mamāstu varadaḥ sadā..16..
4.68.d:
चतुर्मुखः सृष्टिकर्ता स्वयंभूः कमलासनः ॥
विरञ्चिः पद्मयोनिश्च ममास्तु वरदः सदा॥16॥
4.68.m: four-faced, maker of creation, self-born, seated on a lotus, / Virañci, born from the lotus—may he always grant me boons!

4.68.s:
ādityo bhāskaro bhānuḥ sūryorkaḥ savitā raviḥ ..
mārtaṃḍo maṃḍalajyetiragniraśmirjaneśvaraḥ .. 17 ..
4.68.d:
आदित्यो भास्करो भानुः सूर्योर्कः सविता रविः ॥
मार्तंडो मंडलज्येतिरग्निरश्मिर्जनेश्वरः ॥ 17 ॥
4.68.m: Āditya, the light-maker, the shining one, Sūrya, Arka, Savitṛ, Ravi, / Mārtaṇḍa, light of the orb, of fiery rays, lord of mankind,

4.68.s:
prabhākaraḥ saptasaptistaraṇiḥ saraṇiḥ khagaḥ ..
divākaro dinakaraḥ sahasrāṃśurmarīcimān .. 18 ...
4.68.d:
प्रभाकरः सप्तसप्तिस्तरणिः सरणिः खगः ॥
दिवाकरो दिनकरः सहस्रांशुर्मरीचिमान् ॥ 18 ॥।
4.68.m: Prabhākara, he who has seven steeds, the swift mover, the path, traversing the sky, / the day-maker, the day-creator, of a thousand rays, radiant,

4.68.s:
padmaprabodhanaḥ pūṣā kiraṇī merubhūṣaṇaḥ ..
nikuṃbhoḥ varṇabho devaḥ suprīto'stu sadā mama ..19..
4.68.d:
पद्मप्रबोधनः पूषा किरणी मेरुभूषणः ॥
निकुंभोः वर्णभो देवः सुप्रीतोऽस्तु सदा मम ॥19॥
4.68.m: awakener of the lotus, Pūṣan, rayed one, ornament of Mount Meru, / Nikuṃbha, god of golden radiance—may he ever be well pleased with me!

4.68.s:
lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ saṃpadā padmā mā vibhūtirharipriyā ..
pārvatī lalitā gaurī umā śaṃkaravallabhā .. 4.68.20 ..
4.68.d:
लक्ष्मीः श्रीः संपदा पद्मा मा विभूतिर्हरिप्रिया ॥
पार्वती ललिता गौरी उमा शंकरवल्लभा ॥ 4.68.20 ॥
4.68.m: Lakṣmī, Śrī, wealth, Padmā, Mā, prosperity, beloved of Hari; / Pārvatī, Lalitā, Gaurī, Umā, beloved of Śaṅkara;

4.68.s:
gāyatrī prakṛtiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ sāvitrī vedhaso matā ..
rājñī bhānumatī saṃjñā nityabhā bhāskarapriyā. .. 21 ..
4.68.d:
गायत्री प्रकृतिः सृष्टिः सावित्री वेधसो मता ॥
राज्ञी भानुमती संज्ञा नित्यभा भास्करप्रिया॥। 21 ॥
4.68.m: Gāyatrī, Prakṛti, creation, Sāvitrī, esteemed by the creator; / Rājñī, Bhānumatī, Saṃjñā, perpetual light, beloved of the sun."

4.68.s:
iti padmanābhaśaṃkarapitāmahārkkādīnsapriyānpūjya ..
dattvādattvā dānaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma .. 22 ..
4.68.d:
इति पद्मनाभशंकरपितामहार्क्कादीन्सप्रियान्पूज्य ॥
दत्त्वादत्त्वा दानं भुक्त्वा चांते व्रजेद्वेश्म ॥ 22 ॥
4.68.m: Having thus worshipped Padmanābha, Śaṅkara, the Great-grandfather, the Sun, and the others, together with their beloveds, / and having repeatedly given gifts, and eaten at the end, one should go to one's dwelling.

4.68.s:
dvādaśyāṃ carati naro vratametadbhaktibhāvito loke ..
bhavati yaśodhanabhāgī saṃtatimānvigatasaṃtāpaḥ .. 23 ..
4.68.d:
द्वादश्यां चरति नरो व्रतमेतद्भक्तिभावितो लोके ॥
भवति यशोधनभागी संततिमान्विगतसंतापः ॥ 23 ॥
4.68.m: A person who observes this vrata with devotion on the twelfth [tithi] in the world / becomes an inheritor of fame and wealth, possessing offspring, and free from distress.

4.68.s:
hariharahiraṇyagarbhaprabhākarāṇāṃ krameṇa lokeṣu ..
bhuktvā bhogānvipulānatha yogī nirvṛto bhavati .. 24 ..
4.68.d:
हरिहरहिरण्यगर्भप्रभाकराणां क्रमेण लोकेषु ॥
भुक्त्वा भोगान्विपुलानथ योगी निर्वृतो भवति ॥ 24 ॥
4.68.m: Having enjoyed extensive pleasures in the realms of Hari, Hara, Hiraṇyagarbha, and Prabhākara in succession, / he then becomes a yogin and attains liberation.

4.68.s:
strīpuṃsoryadi yugmaṃ puruṣo vā yadi samācarati kaścit ..
nārī vā vratametaccīrtvā yātyālayaṃ viṣṇoḥ..25..
4.68.d:
स्त्रीपुंसोर्यदि युग्मं पुरुषो वा यदि समाचरति कश्चित् ॥
नारी वा व्रतमेतच्चीर्त्वा यात्यालयं विष्णोः॥25॥
4.68.m: If a pair of a woman and a man, or if any man performs it, / or a woman, having observed this vrata, goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.

4.68.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde hariharahiraṇyagarbhaprabhākarāṇāmaviyogavrataṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 68 .. ..
govatsadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.68.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे हरिहरहिरण्यगर्भप्रभाकराणामवियोगव्रतं नामाष्टषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 68 ॥ ॥
गोवत्सद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.68.m:
Thus ends the sixty-eighth chapter, named the Aviyogavrata of Hari, Hara, Hiraṇyagarbha, and Prabhākara, in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Govatsadvādaśīvrata

4.69.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
akṣauhiṇyo daśāṣṭau ca madrājyārthe kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
tena pāpena me citte jugupsātīva vartate .. 1 ..
4.69.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अक्षौहिण्यो दशाष्टौ च मद्राज्यार्थे क्षयं गताः ॥
तेन पापेन मे चित्ते जुगुप्सातीव वर्तते ॥ 1 ॥
4.69.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Eighteen akṣauhiṇīs perished for the sake of my kingdom; / through that sin, a very deep remorse exists in my heart.

4.69.s:
tatra brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyaśūdrādayo hatāḥ ..
bhīṣmadroṇakaliṃgādikarṇaśalyasuyodhanāḥ .. 2 ..
4.69.d:
तत्र ब्राह्मणराजन्यवैश्यशूद्रादयो हताः ॥
भीष्मद्रोणकलिंगादिकर्णशल्यसुयोधनाः ॥ 2 ॥
4.69.m: There brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and others were slain, / including Bhīṣma, Droṇa, the Kaliṅga leaders, Karṇa, Śalya, and Suyodhana.

4.69.s:
teṣāṃ vadhena yatpāpaṃ tanme marmāṇi kṛṃtati ..
pāpaprakṣālanaṃ kañciddharmaṃ brūhi jagatpate .. 3 ..
4.69.d:
तेषां वधेन यत्पापं तन्मे मर्माणि कृंतति ॥
पापप्रक्षालनं कञ्चिद्धर्मं ब्रूहि जगत्पते ॥ 3 ॥
4.69.m: The sin that arose from the slaughter of those cuts into my vital parts; / tell me of some religious duty for washing away sin, O Lord of the world!

4.69.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sumahatpuṇyajananaṃ govatsadvādaśīvratam ..
asti pārtha mahābāho pāṃḍavānāṃ dhuraṃdhara .. 4 .. ..
4.69.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सुमहत्पुण्यजननं गोवत्सद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
अस्ति पार्थ महाबाहो पांडवानां धुरंधर ॥ 4 ॥ ॥
4.69.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / There is the Govatsadvādaśīvrata, producing very great merit, / O son of Pṛthā, O mighty-armed one, foremost among the Pāṇḍavas!

4.69.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
keyaṃ godvādaśī nāma vidhānaṃ tatra kīdṛśam ..
kathameṣā samutpannā kasminkāle janārdana .. 5 ..
4.69.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
केयं गोद्वादशी नाम विधानं तत्र कीदृशम् ॥
कथमेषा समुत्पन्ना कस्मिन्काले जनार्दन ॥ 5 ॥
4.69.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is this that is called Godvādaśī, and what is its ritual injunction? / How did it originate, and at what time, O Janārdana?

4.69.s: etatsarvaṃ hare brūhi pāhi māṃ narakārṇavāt..6..
4.69.d: एतत्सर्वं हरे ब्रूहि पाहि मां नरकार्णवात्॥6॥
4.69.m: Tell me all this, O Hari; protect me from the ocean of hell!

4.69.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca..
purā kṛtayuge pārtha munikoṭiḥ samāgatā..
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ nāmavratadharā girau..7..
4.69.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच॥
पुरा कृतयुगे पार्थ मुनिकोटिः समागता॥
तपश्चचार विपुलं नामव्रतधरा गिरौ॥7॥
4.69.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, in the Kṛta age, O Pārtha, ten million sages assembled,
and, maintaining name-vows, performed immense ascetic penance on a mountain,

4.69.s:
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā daivadarśanakāṃkṣayā..
jaṃbūmārge mahāpuṇye nāmatīrthavibhūṣite..8..
4.69.d:
हर्षेण महताविष्टा दैवदर्शनकांक्षया॥
जंबूमार्गे महापुण्ये नामतीर्थविभूषिते॥8॥
4.69.m:
filled with great joy and longing for a vision of the Divine,
in the very holy Jambūmārga, adorned by pilgrimage sites famed by name,

4.69.s:
pāriyātre siddhapātre ramye taṃdulikāśrame..
ṭaṃṭāviriti vikhyāte uttame śikhare nṛpa .. 9 ..
4.69.d:
पारियात्रे सिद्धपात्रे रम्ये तंदुलिकाश्रमे॥
टंटाविरिति विख्याते उत्तमे शिखरे नृप ॥ 9 ॥
4.69.m:
on Pāriyātra, a vessel of perfected beings, in the delightful Taṇḍulikāśrama,
on the excellent peak known as Ṭaṇṭāvi, O king,

4.69.s:
tāpasāraṇyamatulaṃ divyakānanamaṃḍitam ..
vaśiṣṭhaśukrāṃgirasakratudakṣādibhirvṛtam .. 4.69.10 ..
4.69.d:
तापसारण्यमतुलं दिव्यकाननमंडितम् ॥
वशिष्ठशुक्रांगिरसक्रतुदक्षादिभिर्वृतम् ॥ 4.69.10 ॥
4.69.m:
an incomparable forest of ascetics, adorned with divine woodlands,
surrounded by Vasiṣṭha, Śukra, Aṅgiras, Kratu, Dakṣa, and others,

4.69.s:
valkalājinasaṃvīterbhṛgorāśramamaṃḍalam ..
nānāmṛgagaṇairjuṣṭaṃ śākhāmṛgagaṇairyutam ..11..
4.69.d:
वल्कलाजिनसंवीतेर्भृगोराश्रममंडलम् ॥
नानामृगगणैर्जुष्टं शाखामृगगणैर्युतम् ॥11॥
4.69.m:
the enclave of Bhṛgu’s hermitage, clad in bark garments and deerskins,
frequented by various herds of deer, filled with troops of monkeys,

4.69.s:
praśāṃtasiṃhahariṇaṃ sarvavastugatadrumam ..
gahanaṃ nirṛtaṃ ramyaṃ latāsaṃtānasaṃkulam .. 12 ..
4.69.d:
प्रशांतसिंहहरिणं सर्ववस्तुगतद्रुमम् ॥
गहनं निरृतं रम्यं लतासंतानसंकुलम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.69.m:
where lions and deer were at peace, whose trees yielded every desirable thing,
a dense, secure, delightful [place], thronged with clusters of creepers,

4.69.s:
siṃhavyāghragajairbhinnaṃ hariṇaiḥ śabaraiḥ śaśaiḥ ..
varāhairurubhiścitraiḥ samaṃtādupaśobhitam .. 13 ..
4.69.d:
सिंहव्याघ्रगजैर्भिन्नं हरिणैः शबरैः शशैः ॥
वराहैरुरुभिश्चित्रैः समंतादुपशोभितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.69.m:
diversified by lions, tigers, and elephants, and by deer, Śabaras, and hares,
adorned all around with great, multi-colored boars.

4.69.s:
tapasyatā tatra teṣāṃ munīnāṃ darśanārthinām ..
vyājaṃ cakre mahīnātha dvādaśārdhārdhalocanaḥ .. 14 ..
4.69.d:
तपस्यता तत्र तेषां मुनीनां दर्शनार्थिनाम् ॥
व्याजं चक्रे महीनाथ द्वादशार्धार्धलोचनः ॥ 14 ॥
4.69.m:
As those sages desiring a vision were performing asceticism there,
the three-eyed lord, O king of the earth, devised a disguise.

4.69.s:
babhūva brāhmaṇo vṛddho jarāpāṃḍuramūrddhajaḥ ..
ślathaccarmatanuḥ kubjo yaṣṭipāṇiḥ savepathuḥ ..
umāpi cakre gorūpaṃ śṛṇu tatpārtha yādṛśam .. 15 ..
4.69.d:
बभूव ब्राह्मणो वृद्धो जरापांडुरमूर्द्धजः ॥
श्लथच्चर्मतनुः कुब्जो यष्टिपाणिः सवेपथुः ॥
उमापि चक्रे गोरूपं शृणु तत्पार्थ यादृशम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.69.m:
He became an old brāhmaṇa, his hair grey with age,
his body having loose skin, hunchbacked, stick in hand, trembling.
Umā too took the form of a cow; hear, O Pārtha, what it was like.

4.69.s:
kṣīrodatoyasaṃbhūtā yāḥ purāmṛtamaṃthane ..
pañca gāvaḥ śubhāḥ pārtha pañcalokasya mātaraḥ .. 16 ..
4.69.d:
क्षीरोदतोयसंभूता याः पुरामृतमंथने ॥
पञ्च गावः शुभाः पार्थ पञ्चलोकस्य मातरः ॥ 16 ॥
4.69.m:
Born of the waters of the milk ocean formerly at the churning of the nectar,
five auspicious cows, O Pārtha, are the mothers of the five worlds:

4.69.s:
nandā subhadrā surabhī suśīlā bahulā iti ..
etā lokopakārāya devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca ..17..
4.69.d:
नन्दा सुभद्रा सुरभी सुशीला बहुला इति ॥
एता लोकोपकाराय देवानां तर्पणाय च ॥17॥
4.69.m:
Nandā, Subhadrā, Surabhī, Suśīlā, and Bahulā.
These [exist] for the benefit of the world and the satisfaction of the gods.

4.69.s:
jamadagnibhāradvājavaśiṣṭhāsitagautamāḥ ..
jagṛhuḥ kāmadāḥ pañca gāvo dattāḥ suraistataḥ .. 18 ..
4.69.d:
जमदग्निभारद्वाजवशिष्ठासितगौतमाः ॥
जगृहुः कामदाः पञ्च गावो दत्ताः सुरैस्ततः ॥ 18 ॥
4.69.m:
Jamadagni, Bhāradvāja, Vasiṣṭha, Asita, and Gautama
then received the five wish-granting cows given by the gods.

4.69.s:
gomayaṃ rocanā mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ gavām ..
ṣaḍaṃgāni pavitrāṇi saṃśuddhikaraṇāni ca .. 19 ..
4.69.d:
गोमयं रोचना मूत्रं क्षीरं दधि घृतं गवाम् ॥
षडंगानि पवित्राणि संशुद्धिकरणानि च ॥ 19 ॥
4.69.m:
Cow dung, rocanā, urine, milk, curds, and ghee from cows:
[these are] the six pure and purifying limbs.

4.69.s:
gomayādutthitaḥ śrīmānbilvavṛkṣaḥ śivapriyaḥ ..
tatrāste padmahastā śrīḥ śrīvṛkṣastena sa smṛtaḥ ..
bījānyutpalapadmānāṃ punarjātāni gomayāt .. 4.69.20 ..
4.69.d:
गोमयादुत्थितः श्रीमान्बिल्ववृक्षः शिवप्रियः ॥
तत्रास्ते पद्महस्ता श्रीः श्रीवृक्षस्तेन स स्मृतः ॥
बीजान्युत्पलपद्मानां पुनर्जातानि गोमयात् ॥ 4.69.20 ॥

4.69.s:
gorocanā ca māṃgalyā pavitrā sarvasādhikā ..
gomūtrādguggulurjātaḥ sugaṃdhiḥ priyadarśanaḥ ..
āhāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ śivasya ca viśeṣataḥ .. 21 ..
4.69.d:
गोरोचना च मांगल्या पवित्रा सर्वसाधिका ॥
गोमूत्राद्गुग्गुलुर्जातः सुगंधिः प्रियदर्शनः ॥
आहारः सर्वदेवानां शिवस्य च विशेषतः ॥ 21 ॥
4.69.m:
And cow-rocanā is auspicious, pure, and accomplishing everything.
From cow urine arose bdellium, fragrant and pleasant to behold,
the food of all the gods, and especially of Śiva.

4.69.s:
yadbījaṃ jagataḥ kiñcittajjñeyaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam ..
dadhuḥ sarvāṇi jātāni maṅgalānyarthasiddhaye ..
ghṛtādamṛtamutpannaṃ devānāṃ tṛptikāraṇam .. 22 ..
4.69.d:
यद्बीजं जगतः किञ्चित्तज्ज्ञेयं क्षीरसंभवम् ॥
दधुः सर्वाणि जातानि मङ्गलान्यर्थसिद्धये ॥
घृतादमृतमुत्पन्नं देवानां तृप्तिकारणम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.69.m:
Whatever seed of the world there is, that should be known as born of milk.
From curd all auspicious things were produced for the attainment of goals.
From ghee nectar was born, the cause of the gods’ satisfaction.

4.69.s:
brāhmaṇāścaiva gāvaśca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ..
ekatra mantrāstiṣṭhaṃti haviranyatra tiṣṭhati ..23..
4.69.d:
ब्राह्मणाश्चैव गावश्च कुलमेकं द्विधा कृतम् ॥
एकत्र मन्त्रास्तिष्ठंति हविरन्यत्र तिष्ठति ॥23॥
4.69.m:
Brāhmaṇas and cows are indeed one family divided into two:
in the one reside the mantras, in the other resides the sacrificial oblation.

4.69.s:
goṣu yajñāḥ pravartaṃte goṣu devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ..
goṣu vedāḥ samutkīrṇāḥ saṣa ḍaṃgapadakramāḥ .. 24 ..
4.69.d:
गोषु यज्ञाः प्रवर्तंते गोषु देवाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
गोषु वेदाः समुत्कीर्णाः सष डंगपदक्रमाः ॥ 24 ॥
4.69.m:
In cows the sacrifices proceed; in cows the gods are established;
in cows the Vedas are carved out, along with the six limbs, padas, and kramas.

4.69.s:
śṛṅgamūle gavāṃ nityaṃ brahmā viṣṇuśca saṃsthitau ..
śṛṅgāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca .. 25 ..
4.69.d:
शृङ्गमूले गवां नित्यं ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च संस्थितौ ॥
शृङ्गाग्रे सर्वतीर्थानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥ 25 ॥
4.69.m:
At the base of the cows' horns Brahmā and Viṣṇu ever reside;
at the tips of the horns are all the sacred places, stationary and moving.

4.69.s:
śivo madhye mahādevaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ..
salāṭe saṃsthitā gaurī nāsāvaṃśe ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ ..26..
4.69.d:
शिवो मध्ये महादेवः सर्वकारणकारणम् ॥
सलाटे संस्थिता गौरी नासावंशे च षण्मुखः ॥26॥
4.69.m:
In the middle is Śiva Mahādeva, the cause of all causes;
on the forehead Gaurī resides, and on the bridge of the nose the six-faced [Kārttikeya].

4.69.s:
kaṃbalāśvatarau nāgau nāsāpuṭasamāśritau..
karṇayoraśvinau devau cakṣurbhyāṃ śaśibhāskarau .. 27 ..
4.69.d:
कंबलाश्वतरौ नागौ नासापुटसमाश्रितौ॥
कर्णयोरश्विनौ देवौ चक्षुर्भ्यां शशिभास्करौ ॥ 27 ॥
4.69.m:
The two serpents Kambala and Aśvatara reside in the nostrils;
in the ears are the two Aśvin gods; in the two eyes, the moon and sun.

4.69.s:
daṃteṣu vasavaḥ sarve jihvāyāṃ varuṇaḥ sthitaḥ ..
sarasvatī ca kuhare yamayakṣau ca gaṇḍayoḥ .. 28 ..
4.69.d:
दंतेषु वसवः सर्वे जिह्वायां वरुणः स्थितः ॥
सरस्वती च कुहरे यमयक्षौ च गण्डयोः ॥ 28 ॥
4.69.m:
In the teeth are all the Vasus; on the tongue rests Varuṇa;
Sarasvatī is in the hollow [of the mouth], and Yama and the yakṣa are in the two cheeks.

4.69.s:
saṃdhyādvayaṃ tatheṣṭābhyāṃ grīvāyāṃ ca puraṃdaraḥ ..
rakṣāṃsi kakude dyauśca pārṣṇikāye vyavasthitā .. 29 ..
4.69.d:
संध्याद्वयं तथेष्टाभ्यां ग्रीवायां च पुरंदरः ॥
रक्षांसि ककुदे द्यौश्च पार्ष्णिकाये व्यवस्थिता ॥ 29 ॥
4.69.m:
The two twilights [dwell] in the two lips, and Purandara on the neck;
the demons are on the hump, and heaven is located on the quarters of the hindfeet.

4.69.s:
catuṣpātsakalo dharmo nityaṃ jaṃghāsu tiṣṭhati ..
khuramadhyeṣu gandharvāḥ khurāgreṣu ca pannagāḥ .. 4.69.30 ..
4.69.d:
चतुष्पात्सकलो धर्मो नित्यं जंघासु तिष्ठति ॥
खुरमध्येषु गन्धर्वाः खुराग्रेषु च पन्नगाः ॥ 4.69.30 ॥
4.69.m:
All four-footed Dharma constantly stands upon the shanks;
in the middles of the hooves are the gandharvas, and at the hoof tips are the serpents.

4.69.s:
khurāṇāṃ paścime bhāge rākṣasāḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
rudrā ekādaśa pṛṣṭhe varuṇaḥ sarvasandhiṣu .. 31 ..
4.69.d:
खुराणां पश्चिमे भागे राक्षसाः संप्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
रुद्रा एकादश पृष्ठे वरुणः सर्वसन्धिषु ॥ 31 ॥
4.69.m:
In the rear part of the hooves the rākṣasas are firmly established;
the eleven Rudras are on the back; Varuṇa is in all the joints.

4.69.s:
śroṇītaṭasthāḥ pitaraḥ kapoleṣu ca mānavāḥ ..
śrīrapāne gavāṃ nityaṃ svāhālaṃkāramāśritāḥ .. 32 ..
4.69.d:
श्रोणीतटस्थाः पितरः कपोलेषु च मानवाः ॥
श्रीरपाने गवां नित्यं स्वाहालंकारमाश्रिताः ॥ 32 ॥
4.69.m:
The ancestors abide on the slopes of the hips, and men on the cheeks;
Śrī constantly resides in the anus of cows, adorned with the svāhā [call].

4.69.s:
ādityā raśmayo vālāḥ piṇḍībhūtā vyavasthitāḥ..
sākṣādgaṃgā ca gomūtre gomaye yamunā sthitā .. 33 ..
4.69.d:
आदित्या रश्मयो वालाः पिण्डीभूता व्यवस्थिताः॥
साक्षाद्गंगा च गोमूत्रे गोमये यमुना स्थिता ॥ 33 ॥
4.69.m:
The rays of the sun stand massed together as the tail hairs;
the Gaṅgā herself resides in cow urine, and Yamunā in cow dung.

4.69.s:
trayastriṃśaddevakoṭyo romakūpe vyavasthitāḥ ..
udare pṛthivī sarvā saśailavanakānanā .. 34 ..
4.69.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवकोट्यो रोमकूपे व्यवस्थिताः ॥
उदरे पृथिवी सर्वा सशैलवनकानना ॥ 34 ॥
4.69.m:
Three hundred and thirty million gods are stationed in the hair follicles;
in the belly is the entire earth, along with mountains, forests, and groves.

4.69.s:
catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ proktā gavāṃ ye tu payodharāḥ ..
parjanyaḥ kṣīradhārāsu meghā biṃduvyavasthitāḥ ..35..
4.69.d:
चत्वारः सागराः प्रोक्ता गवां ये तु पयोधराः ॥
पर्जन्यः क्षीरधारासु मेघा बिंदुव्यवस्थिताः ॥35॥
4.69.m:
The four oceans are proclaimed to be the udders of cows;
Parjanya [resides] in the streams of milk, and the clouds are stationed as the drops.

4.69.s:
jaṭhare gārhapatyo'gnirdakṣiṇāgnirhṛdisthitaḥ ...
kaṇṭhe āhavanīyo'gniḥ sabhyo'gnistāluni sthitaḥ .. 36 ..
4.69.d:
जठरे गार्हपत्योऽग्निर्दक्षिणाग्निर्हृदिस्थितः ॥।
कण्ठे आहवनीयोऽग्निः सभ्योऽग्निस्तालुनि स्थितः ॥ 36 ॥
4.69.m:
The Gārhapatya fire is in the stomach; the Dakṣiṇāgni resides in the heart;
the Āhavanīya fire is in the throat; the Sabhya fire resides on the palate.

4.69.s:
asthivyavasthitāḥ śailā majjāsu kratavaḥ sthitāḥ ..
ṛgvedo'tharvavedaśca sāmavedo yaju stathā .. 37 ..
4.69.d:
अस्थिव्यवस्थिताः शैला मज्जासु क्रतवः स्थिताः ॥
ऋग्वेदोऽथर्ववेदश्च सामवेदो यजु स्तथा ॥ 37 ॥
4.69.m:
The mountains are stationed in the bones; the sacrifices reside in the marrow.
The Ṛgveda, the Atharvaveda, the Sāmaveda, and the Yajus,

4.69.s:
suraktapītakṛṣṇādau gavāṃ varṇe vyavasthitāḥ ..
tāsāṃ rūpamumā smṛtvā surabhīṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 38 ..
4.69.d:
सुरक्तपीतकृष्णादौ गवां वर्णे व्यवस्थिताः ॥
तासां रूपमुमा स्मृत्वा सुरभीणां युधिष्ठिर ॥ 38 ॥
4.69.m:
are stationed in the bright red, yellow, black, and other colors of cows.
Having recalled the form of those celestial cows, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

4.69.s:
saṃsmṛtya tatkṣaṇādgaurī iyeṣa sadṛśīṃ tanum ..
ātmānaṃ vidadhe devī dharmarāja śṛṇuṣva tām .. 39 ..
4.69.d:
संस्मृत्य तत्क्षणाद्गौरी इयेष सदृशीं तनुम् ॥
आत्मानं विदधे देवी धर्मराज शृणुष्व ताम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.69.m:
remembering it in that moment, Gaurī desired a similar form.
The goddess fashioned herself [as such]; hear of that, O king of righteousness:

4.69.s:
ṣaḍunnatāṃ pañcanimnāṃ maṃḍūkākṣīṃ suvāladhim ..
tāmrastanīṃ raupyakaṭiṃ sukhurīṃ sumukhī sitām .. 4.69.40 ..
4.69.d:
षडुन्नतां पञ्चनिम्नां मंडूकाक्षीं सुवालधिम् ॥
ताम्रस्तनीं रौप्यकटिं सुखुरीं सुमुखी सिताम् ॥ 4.69.40 ॥
4.69.m:
elevated in six parts, depressed in five, with frog-eyes and a lovely tail,
with coppery teats, silvery hips, fine hooves, a handsome face, white,

4.69.s:
suśīlāṃ ca sutasnehāṃ sukṣīrāṃ supayodharām ..
gorūpiṇīmumāṃ spṛṣṭvā svāminīṃ tāṃ savatsikām .. 41 ..
4.69.d:
सुशीलां च सुतस्नेहां सुक्षीरां सुपयोधराम् ॥
गोरूपिणीमुमां स्पृष्ट्वा स्वामिनीं तां सवत्सिकाम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.69.m:
gentle-natured, loving toward her calf, having good milk and fine udders.
Touching Umā in the form of a cow, that mistress along with her calf,

4.69.s:
caryayā prataranhṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ svacetasi ..
śanaiḥśanairyayau pārtha viprarūpī mahāśramam .. 42 ..
4.69.d:
चर्यया प्रतरन्हृष्टो महादेवः स्वचेतसि ॥
शनैःशनैर्ययौ पार्थ विप्ररूपी महाश्रमम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.69.m:
Mahādeva, joyful in his heart, moving in an outward course,
slowly approached the great hermitage in the form of a brāhmaṇa, O Pārtha.

4.69.s:
dattvā kulapateḥ pārśvaṃ bhṛgostāṃ gāṃ nyavedayat ..
tapasvināṃ mahātejāstāṃ ca sarveṣu pāṃḍava .. 43 ..
4.69.d:
दत्त्वा कुलपतेः पार्श्वं भृगोस्तां गां न्यवेदयत् ॥
तपस्विनां महातेजास्तां च सर्वेषु पांडव ॥ 43 ॥
4.69.m:
Having approached the head of the community, he presented that cow beside Bhṛgu,
and that cow to all the ascetics, O Pāṇḍava, he of great splendour,

4.69.s:
nyāsarūpāṃ dadau dhenuṃ rakṣitvā tāṃ dinadvayam ..
yāvatsnātvā itastīrtvā jaṃbūmārgaṃ viyāmyaham .. 44 ...
4.69.d:
न्यासरूपां ददौ धेनुं रक्षित्वा तां दिनद्वयम् ॥
यावत्स्नात्वा इतस्तीर्त्वा जंबूमार्गं वियाम्यहम् ॥ 44 ॥।
4.69.m:
gave as a deposit, [saying,] 'Having guarded her for two days,
while I, having bathed and crossed over from here, depart for Jambūmārga—'

4.69.s:
rakṣiṣyāmaḥ pratijñāte munibhiḥ surabhīmimām ..
antarddhimagamaddevaḥ punarvyāghro babhūva ha .. 45 ..
4.69.d:
रक्षिष्यामः प्रतिज्ञाते मुनिभिः सुरभीमिमाम् ॥
अन्तर्द्धिमगमद्देवः पुनर्व्याघ्रो बभूव ह ॥ 45 ॥
4.69.m:
When the sages had promised, 'We will protect this cow,'
the god disappeared, and then became a tiger.

4.69.s:
vajracakranakho devīṃ jvalatpiṃgalalocanaḥ ..
jihvā karālavadano jihvālāṃgūladāruṇaḥ .. 46 ..
4.69.d:
वज्रचक्रनखो देवीं ज्वलत्पिंगललोचनः ॥
जिह्वा करालवदनो जिह्वालांगूलदारुणः ॥ 46 ॥
4.69.m:
With nails like thunderbolts and discuses, flaming tawny eyes,
a dreadful mouth with a tongue, and terrifying with flicking tail,

4.69.s:
saṃprāyādāśramapadaṃ tāṃ ca dhenuṃ savatsikām ..
trāsayāmāsa tāṃ deva munīnāṃ dikṣvavasthitaḥ .. 47 ...
4.69.d:
संप्रायादाश्रमपदं तां च धेनुं सवत्सिकाम् ॥
त्रासयामास तां देव मुनीनां दिक्ष्ववस्थितः ॥ 47 ॥।
4.69.m:
he reached the hermitage grounds and that cow with her calf.
The god terrified her, standing in all directions of the sages.

4.69.s:
ṛṣayo'pi samākrāṃtā ārtanādaṃ pracakrire ..
hāhetyuccaiḥ kecidūcurhuṃhuṃkāraistathāpare .. 48 ..
4.69.d:
ऋषयोऽपि समाक्रांता आर्तनादं प्रचक्रिरे ॥
हाहेत्युच्चैः केचिदूचुर्हुंहुंकारैस्तथापरे ॥ 48 ॥
4.69.m:
Assailed, the ṛṣis also raised cries of distress;
some shouted loudly 'Alas, alas!', and others with roars of 'Hum, hum!'

4.69.s:
tālāsphoṭāndaduḥ kecidvyāghraṃ dṛṣṭvātibhairavam ..
sāpi haṃbhāravāṃścakre gaurutplutya savatsikā .. 49 ..
4.69.d:
तालास्फोटान्ददुः केचिद्व्याघ्रं दृष्ट्वातिभैरवम् ॥
सापि हंभारवांश्चक्रे गौरुत्प्लुत्य सवत्सिका ॥ 49 ॥
4.69.m: Some clapped their hands upon seeing the exceedingly terrible tiger; / and the cow, leaping up with her calf, made bellowing sounds.

4.69.s:
tasyā vyāghrabhayārtāyāḥ kapilāyā yudhiṣṭhira ..
palāyaṃtyā śilāmadhye kṣaṇaṃ khuracatuṣṭayam ..4.69.50..
4.69.d:
तस्या व्याघ्रभयार्तायाः कपिलाया युधिष्ठिर ॥
पलायंत्या शिलामध्ये क्षणं खुरचतुष्टयम् ॥4.69.50॥
4.69.m: Of that tawny cow fleeing in fear of the tiger, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / for a moment the set of four hooves [marked] within the rock;

4.69.s:
vyāghravatsakayostatra vaṃditaṃ surakinnaraiḥ ..
dṛśyate'tīva suvyaktaṃ tadadyāpi catuṣṭayam .. 51 ..
4.69.d:
व्याघ्रवत्सकयोस्तत्र वंदितं सुरकिन्नरैः ॥
दृश्यतेऽतीव सुव्यक्तं तदद्यापि चतुष्टयम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.69.m: and those of the tiger and calf there, praised by gods and kinnaras, / that set of four is seen very clearly even today.

4.69.s:
sajalaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca śambhostīrthaṃ taduttamam ..
yassaṃspṛśati rājendra sa govadhyāṃ vyapohati .. 52 ..
4.69.d:
सजलं शिवलिंगं च शम्भोस्तीर्थं तदुत्तमम् ॥
यस्संस्पृशति राजेन्द्र स गोवध्यां व्यपोहति ॥ 52 ॥
4.69.m: And there is a liṅga of Śiva with water, that excellent holy place of Śambhu. / Whoever touches it, O king of kings, removes [the sin of] cow-slaughter.

4.69.s:
tatra snātvā mahātīrthe jaṃbūmārge narādhipa ..
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. .. 53 ..
4.69.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महातीर्थे जंबूमार्गे नराधिप ॥
ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ ॥ 53 ॥
4.69.m: Bathing there in that great holy place at Jambūmārga, O lord of men, / one is freed from sins such as brahmin-slaughter; of this there is no doubt.

4.69.s:
tataste munayaḥ kruddhā brahmadattāṃ mahāsvanām ..
jaghnurghaṃṭāṃ surairdattāṃ girikandarapūraṇīm .. 54 ..
4.69.d:
ततस्ते मुनयः क्रुद्धा ब्रह्मदत्तां महास्वनाम् ॥
जघ्नुर्घंटां सुरैर्दत्तां गिरिकन्दरपूरणीम् ॥ 54 ॥
4.69.m: Then those enraged sages struck a bell given by Brahmā, of loud sound, / given by the gods, filling the mountain caverns.

4.69.s:
śabdena tena vyāghro'pi muktvā gāvaṃ sava tsikām ..
vipraistatra kṛtaṃ nāma ḍhuṇḍhāgiririti śrutiḥ ..
taṃ prapaśyaṃti ye pārtha te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 55 ..
4.69.d:
शब्देन तेन व्याघ्रोऽपि मुक्त्वा गावं सव त्सिकाम् ॥
विप्रैस्तत्र कृतं नाम ढुण्ढागिरिरिति श्रुतिः ॥
तं प्रपश्यंति ये पार्थ ते रुद्रा नात्र संशयः ॥ 55 ॥
4.69.m: At that sound, the tiger left the cow and her calf. / The sages named that place Ḍhuṇḍhāgiri, according to tradition; / those who behold it, O son of Pṛthā, become Rudras; of this there is no doubt.

4.69.s:
atha pratyakṣatāṃ śreṣṭhasteṣāṃ devo maheśvaraḥ ..
śūlapāṇistripurahā kāmaghno vṛṣabhe sthitaḥ .. 56 ..
4.69.d:
अथ प्रत्यक्षतां श्रेष्ठस्तेषां देवो महेश्वरः ॥
शूलपाणिस्त्रिपुरहा कामघ्नो वृषभे स्थितः ॥ 56 ॥
4.69.m: Then the highest god, Maheśvara, appeared visibly before them: / holding a trident in his hand, the destroyer of Tripura, the slayer of Kāma, mounted on a bull,

4.69.s:
umāsahāyo varadaḥ sasvāmī savināyakaḥ ..
sanaṃdiḥ samahākālaḥ saśṛṅgī samano haraḥ .. 57 ..
4.69.d:
उमासहायो वरदः सस्वामी सविनायकः ॥
सनंदिः समहाकालः सशृङ्गी समनो हरः ॥ 57 ॥
4.69.m: accompanied by Umā, the granter of boons, with Svāmin and with Vināyaka, / with Nandi, with Mahākāla, with Śṛṅgin, [and] with Manohara,

4.69.s:
vīrabhadrā ca cāmuṃḍā ghaṃṭākarṇādibhirvṛtā ..
mātṛbhirbhūtasaṃghātairyakṣarākṣasaguhyakaiḥ ..
devadānavagandharvamunividyādharoragaiḥ .. 58 ..
4.69.d:
वीरभद्रा च चामुंडा घंटाकर्णादिभिर्वृता ॥
मातृभिर्भूतसंघातैर्यक्षराक्षसगुह्यकैः ॥
देवदानवगन्धर्वमुनिविद्याधरोरगैः ॥ 58 ॥
4.69.m: and Vīrabhadra and Cāmuṇḍā surrounded by Ghaṇṭākarṇa and others, / with the Mothers, with the hosts of ghosts, with yakṣas, rākṣasas, and guhyakas, / and with gods, dānavas, gandharvas, sages, vidyādharas, and serpents.

4.69.s:
praṇamya devadevāya patnībhiḥ sahitairumā ..
gorūpiṇī savatsā ca pūjitā brahmacāribhiḥ ..59..
4.69.d:
प्रणम्य देवदेवाय पत्नीभिः सहितैरुमा ॥
गोरूपिणी सवत्सा च पूजिता ब्रह्मचारिभिः ॥59॥
4.69.m: Having bowed to the God of gods along with their wives, Umā / in the form of a cow with her calf was worshipped by the celibates.

4.69.s:
kārtike śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ naṃdinīvratam ..
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra avatīrṇaṃ mahītale .. 4.69.60 ..
4.69.d:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षे तु द्वादश्यां नंदिनीव्रतम् ॥
ततः प्रभृति राजेन्द्र अवतीर्णं महीतले ॥ 4.69.60 ॥
4.69.m: On the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight in Kārttika, the Nandinī-vrata / descended upon the earth from that time onward, O king of kings.

4.69.s:
uttānapādena tathā vrataṃ cīrṇamidaṃ śṛṇu ..
uttānapādanāmāsītkṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpate ..61..
4.69.d:
उत्तानपादेन तथा व्रतं चीर्णमिदं शृणु ॥
उत्तानपादनामासीत्क्षत्रियः पृथिवीपते ॥61॥
4.69.m: Hear how this vrata was performed by Uttānapāda. / There was a kṣatriya named Uttānapāda, O lord of the earth;

4.69.s:
tasya bhāryā dvayaṃ cāsīdruciśughnīti viśrutam ..
śughnījāto dhruvaḥ putro vāmapādadharo'lasaḥ .. 62 ..
4.69.d:
तस्य भार्या द्वयं चासीद्रुचिशुघ्नीति विश्रुतम् ॥
शुघ्नीजातो ध्रुवः पुत्रो वामपादधरोऽलसः ॥ 62 ॥
4.69.m: and he had two wives, renowned as Ruci and Śughnī. / Born of Śughnī was a son Dhruva, who walked on his left foot, lazy.

4.69.s:
rucyāḥ samarpitaḥ śughnyā dhruvo'yaṃ rakṣyatāṃ sakhi ..
ahaṃ kariṣye śuśrūṣāṃ bhartustāvatsadā svayam .. 63 ..
4.69.d:
रुच्याः समर्पितः शुघ्न्या ध्रुवोऽयं रक्ष्यतां सखि ॥
अहं करिष्ये शुश्रूषां भर्तुस्तावत्सदा स्वयम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.69.m: Dhruva was entrusted to Ruci by Śughnī: ‘Protect him, my friend; / meanwhile I shall constantly attend upon our husband myself.’

4.69.s:
rucī rasavatīṃ nityaṃ pratyahaṃ kurute gṛhe ..
akarodbhartṛśuśrūṣāṃ śughnī nityaṃ pativratā ..64..
4.69.d:
रुची रसवतीं नित्यं प्रत्यहं कुरुते गृहे ॥
अकरोद्भर्तृशुश्रूषां शुघ्नी नित्यं पतिव्रता ॥64॥
4.69.m: Ruci prepared tasty food every day in the house; / Śughnī, devoted to her husband, constantly served her lord.

4.69.s:
kadācitkrodhamātsaryātsāpatnyaṃ darśitaṃ tayā ..
svayaṃ rucyā nihatyāsau śiśuḥ khaṃḍalaśaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 65 ..
4.69.d:
कदाचित्क्रोधमात्सर्यात्सापत्न्यं दर्शितं तया ॥
स्वयं रुच्या निहत्यासौ शिशुः खंडलशः कृतः ॥ 65 ॥
4.69.m: Once, out of anger and jealousy, co-wife rivalry was displayed by her: / by Ruci herself that child was killed and cut into pieces;

4.69.s:
tāpikāyāṃ tathā sthālyāṃ pakvasiddhaḥ susaṃ skṛtaḥ ..
annabhojanavelāyāṃ dadāti nṛpabhājane .. 66 ..
4.69.d:
तापिकायां तथा स्थाल्यां पक्वसिद्धः सुसं स्कृतः ॥
अन्नभोजनवेलायां ददाति नृपभाजने ॥ 66 ॥
4.69.m: and cooked, boiled, and thoroughly prepared in a frying pan and a pot, / she placed him in the king's eating dish at mealtime,

4.69.s:
taṃ vai bhakṣayituṃ duṣṭā sāmiṣaṃ bhojanaṃ kila ..
atha bhojanavelāyāṃ vavre jīvitamāptavān .. 67 ..
4.69.d:
तं वै भक्षयितुं दुष्टा सामिषं भोजनं किल ॥
अथ भोजनवेलायां वव्रे जीवितमाप्तवान् ॥ 67 ॥
4.69.m: so that he might indeed eat it, the wicked woman [saying] it was food with meat. / Then at mealtime, having chosen [to live], he attained life;

4.69.s:
tathaiva prahasanbālo māturutsaṃgajo'bhavat ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rucī papraccha vismitā .. 68 ..
4.69.d:
तथैव प्रहसन्बालो मातुरुत्संगजोऽभवत् ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं रुची पप्रच्छ विस्मिता ॥ 68 ॥
4.69.m: laughing just so, the boy appeared upon his mother's lap. / Seeing that great wonder, Ruci asked in astonishment:

4.69.s:
kimetadbrūhi vṛttāṃtaṃ kasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiruttamā ..
kiṃ tvayācaritaṃ kiñcidvrataṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā .. 69 ..
4.69.d:
किमेतद्ब्रूहि वृत्तांतं कस्येयं व्युष्टिरुत्तमा ॥
किं त्वयाचरितं किञ्चिद्व्रतं दत्तं हुतं तथा ॥ 69 ॥
4.69.m: ‘Tell me, what is this occurrence? Whose excellent reward is this? / Was some vrata observed by you, [or] given, or offered into fire?

4.69.s:
satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ yena jīvati te sutaḥ..
mamāyaṃ sapta vārāṃstu viśalyaśakalī kṛtaḥ..4.69.70..
4.69.d:
सत्यंसत्यं पुनः सत्यं येन जीवति ते सुतः॥
ममायं सप्त वारांस्तु विशल्यशकली कृतः॥4.69.70॥
4.69.m: Truly, truly, again truly, by what does your son live? / Seven times was he cut into small pieces and shredded by me;

4.69.s:
pakvaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ sthālyāṃ vyañjanaiḥ saha bhojanaiḥ..
pariviṣyamāṇaḥ sa punaḥ kathaṃ jīvitamāptavān..71..
4.69.d:
पक्वः स्वयं कृतः स्थाल्यां व्यञ्जनैः सह भोजनैः॥
परिविष्यमाणः स पुनः कथं जीवितमाप्तवान्॥71॥
4.69.m: he was cooked by myself in a pot along with curries and dishes; / being served again, how did he regain life?

4.69.s:
kiṃ te siddhā mahāvidyā mṛtasañjīvanī śubhā..
ratnaṃ maṇirmahāratnaṃ yogāñjanamahauṣadham..72..
4.69.d:
किं ते सिद्धा महाविद्या मृतसञ्जीवनी शुभा॥
रत्नं मणिर्महारत्नं योगाञ्जनमहौषधम्॥72॥
4.69.m: Has an auspicious great vidyā, the revival of the dead, been mastered by you, / or a jewel, a gem, a great jewel, magic collyrium, or a great medicine?

4.69.s:
kathayasva mahābhāge satyaṃsatyaṃ bhaginyasi ..
evamukte rucistasyai vyācakhyau vatsagovratam .. 73 ..
4.69.d:
कथयस्व महाभागे सत्यंसत्यं भगिन्यसि ॥
एवमुक्ते रुचिस्तस्यै व्याचख्यौ वत्सगोव्रतम् ॥ 73 ॥
4.69.m: Tell me, O fortunate lady, truly, truly; you are my sister.’ / When she had spoken thus, [Śughnī] explained to her the Vatsago-vrata:

4.69.s:
kārttike caiva dvādaśyāṃ yathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ purā ..
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa punarjīvati me sutaḥ .. 74 .
4.69.d:
कार्त्तिके चैव द्वादश्यां यथा चानुष्ठितं पुरा ॥
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण पुनर्जीवति मे सुतः ॥ 74 ।
4.69.m: ‘And how it was performed in ancient times on the twelfth [lunar day] of Kārttika. / By the power of this vrata my son lives again.

4.69.s:
vatso me vatsavelāyāṃ mṛto'rthaṃ labhate punaḥ ..
samāgamaśca bhavati vrataiḥ pravasitairapi .. 75 ..
4.69.d:
वत्सो मे वत्सवेलायां मृतोऽर्थं लभते पुनः ॥
समागमश्च भवति व्रतैः प्रवसितैरपि ॥ 75 ॥
4.69.m: My calf, though dead at the time of the calf, obtains its purpose again; / and reunion occurs through the vratas even with those gone abroad.

4.69.s:
yathārthametadvyākhyātaṃ te ca godvādaśīvratam ..
tavāpi ruci tatsarvaṃ bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ priyam .. 76 ..
4.69.d:
यथार्थमेतद्व्याख्यातं ते च गोद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
तवापि रुचि तत्सर्वं भविष्यति शुभं प्रियम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.69.m: This Godvādaśī-vrata has been explained to you truthfully; / for you too, O Ruci, everything will be auspicious and pleasing.’

4.69.s:
evamuktaṃ vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ rucyā putrāḥ sukhaṃ dhanam ..
saṃprāptā jīvitāṃte ca dhruvasthāne niveśitāḥ .. 77 ..
4.69.d:
एवमुक्तं व्रतं चीर्णं रुच्या पुत्राः सुखं धनम् ॥
संप्राप्ता जीवितांते च ध्रुवस्थाने निवेशिताः ॥ 77 ॥
4.69.m: The vrata thus spoken of was performed by Ruci; sons, happiness, and wealth / were obtained [by her], and at the end of life they were placed in the abode of Dhruva.

4.69.s:
brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāreṇa rucirbhartrā sahāsitā ..
daśanakṣatrasaṃyukto dhruvaḥ sodyāpi dṛśyate ..
dhuvarkṣe ca yadā dṛṣṭe lokaḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 78 ..
4.69.d:
ब्रह्मणा सृष्टिकारेण रुचिर्भर्त्रा सहासिता ॥
दशनक्षत्रसंयुक्तो ध्रुवः सोद्यापि दृश्यते ॥
धुवर्क्षे च यदा दृष्टे लोकः पापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 78 ॥
4.69.m: Ruci was seated together with her husband by Brahmā, the creator; / joined with ten constellations, that Dhruva is seen even today, / and when the star of Dhruva is seen, people are freed from sins.’

4.69.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ tadvidhānaṃ ca tanme brūhi janārdana..
yatkṛtaṃ śughnivacanādrucyā yadukulodbhava .. 79 ..
4.69.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कीदृशं तद्विधानं च तन्मे ब्रूहि जनार्दन॥
यत्कृतं शुघ्निवचनाद्रुच्या यदुकुलोद्भव ॥ 79 ॥
4.69.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is its procedure? Tell me that, O Janārdana, / which was performed by Ruci according to Śughnī’s words, O descendant of the Yadu race.

4.69.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
saṃprāpte kārtike māsi śuklapakṣe kurūttama..
dvādaśyāṃ snātvā puṇye jalāśaye ..
naro vā yadi vā nārī ekabhaktaṃ prakalpayet ..4.69.80..
4.69.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
संप्राप्ते कार्तिके मासि शुक्लपक्षे कुरूत्तम॥
द्वादश्यां स्नात्वा पुण्ये जलाशये ॥
नरो वा यदि वा नारी एकभक्तं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥4.69.80॥
4.69.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When the month of Kārttika has arrived, in the bright fortnight, O best of the Kurus, / having bathed in a sacred body of water on the twelfth lunar day, / whether man or woman, one should take only a single meal.

4.69.s:
tato madhyāhnasamaye dṛṣṭvā dhenuṃ savatsikām..
suśīlāṃ vatsalāṃ śvetāṃ kapilāṃ raktarūpiṇīm ..81..
4.69.d:
ततो मध्याह्नसमये दृष्ट्वा धेनुं सवत्सिकाम्॥
सुशीलां वत्सलां श्वेतां कपिलां रक्तरूपिणीम् ॥81॥
4.69.m: Then, at midday, having seen a cow with her calf, / well-behaved, affectionate, white, tawny, or of red colour,

4.69.s:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ strījaneśvara ..
yathākrameṇa pūjyaināṃ gaṃdhapuppajalākṣataiḥ .. 82..
4.69.d:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां स्त्रीजनेश्वर ॥
यथाक्रमेण पूज्यैनां गंधपुप्पजलाक्षतैः ॥ 82॥
4.69.m: for brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, O lord of women, / worshipping her in due order with scents, flowers, water, and unbroken grains,

4.69.s:
kuṃkumālaktakairdīpairmāṣānnavaṭakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
kusumairvatsakaṃ cāpi maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava ..83..
4.69.d:
कुंकुमालक्तकैर्दीपैर्माषान्नवटकैः शुभैः ॥
कुसुमैर्वत्सकं चापि मंत्रेणानेन पांडव ॥83॥
4.69.m: with saffron, red lac, lamps, and auspicious māṣa patties, / and also [worshipping] the calf with flowers, with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

4.69.s:
oṃ mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ..
pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa namo namaḥ svāhā .. 84 ..
4.69.d:
ओं माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः ॥
प्रनुवोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट नमो नमः स्वाहा ॥ 84 ॥
4.69.m: ‘Om. Mother of the Rudras, daughter of the Vasus, sister of the Ādityas, navel of immortality; / I proclaim to the discerning person: do not kill the cow, the sinless Aditi! Salutation, salutation, svāhā!’

4.69.s:
itthaṃ saṃpūjya gāṃ pṛṣṭvā paścāttāṃ ca kṣamāpayet ..
oṃ sarvadevamaye devi lokānāṃ śubhanaṃdini ..
mātarmamābhilaṣitaṃ saphalaṃ kuru naṃdini .. 85 ..
4.69.d:
इत्थं संपूज्य गां पृष्ट्वा पश्चात्तां च क्षमापयेत् ॥
ओं सर्वदेवमये देवि लोकानां शुभनंदिनि ॥
मातर्ममाभिलषितं सफलं कुरु नंदिनि ॥ 85 ॥
4.69.m: Having thus worshipped the cow and touched her back, one should then ask her forgiveness: / ‘Om. O goddess consisting of all the gods, who brings auspicious joy to the worlds, / O mother Nandinī, bring my desire to fruition!’

4.69.s:
evamabhyarcayedekāṃ gāmetaddhi gavāhnikam ..
paryukṣya vāriṇā bhaktyā praṇamya surabhīṃ tataḥ .. 86 ..
4.69.d:
एवमभ्यर्चयेदेकां गामेतद्धि गवाह्निकम् ॥
पर्युक्ष्य वारिणा भक्त्या प्रणम्य सुरभीं ततः ॥ 86 ॥
4.69.m: One should thus worship a single cow; this indeed is the daily cow-rite. / Having sprinkled [her] with water with devotion and then bowed to the celestial cow,

4.69.s:
taddine tāpikāpakvaṃ sthālīpākaṃ ca varjayet ..
bhūmau svayaṃ brahmacārī śayīta phalamāpnuyāt.. 87 ..
4.69.d:
तद्दिने तापिकापक्वं स्थालीपाकं च वर्जयेत् ॥
भूमौ स्वयं ब्रह्मचारी शयीत फलमाप्नुयात्॥ 87 ॥
4.69.m: on that day one should avoid what is cooked in a frying pan and what is boiled in a pot. / Celibate oneself, one should sleep on the ground; one will obtain the fruit.

4.69.s:
yāvaṃti gātre romāṇi gavāṃ kauravanaṃdana ..
tāvatkālaṃ sa vasati goloke nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 88 ..
4.69.d:
यावंति गात्रे रोमाणि गवां कौरवनंदन ॥
तावत्कालं स वसति गोलोके नात्र संशयः ॥ 88 ॥
4.69.m: As many hairs as there are on the body of cows, O joy of the Kurus, / for so long a time does he dwell in Goloka; of this there is no doubt.

4.69.s:
meroḥ puryaṣṭakaṃ ramyamiṃdrāgniyamarakṣasām ..
varuṇānilayakṣāṇāṃ rudrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ..
tāsāmupari golokastatra yāti sa govratī .. 89 ..
4.69.d:
मेरोः पुर्यष्टकं रम्यमिंद्राग्नियमरक्षसाम् ॥
वरुणानिलयक्षाणां रुद्रस्य च युधिष्ठिर ॥
तासामुपरि गोलोकस्तत्र याति स गोव्रती ॥ 89 ॥
4.69.m: The eight delightful cities of Meru belong to Indra, Agni, Yama, and the Rakṣas, / to Varuṇa, Anila, the Yakṣas, and Rudra, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / Above them is Goloka; thither goes the observer of the cow-vow.

4.69.s:
ūrje site dvidaśame'hani gāṃ savatsāṃ yāḥ pūjayaṃti kusumairvaṭakaiśca hṛdyaiḥ ..
tāḥ sarvakāmasukhabhogavibhūtibhājo martye vasaṃti suciraṃ bahujīvavatsāḥ .. 4.69.90 .. ..
devaśayanotthāpanadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.69.d:
ऊर्जे सिते द्विदशमेऽहनि गां सवत्सां याः पूजयंति कुसुमैर्वटकैश्च हृद्यैः ॥
ताः सर्वकामसुखभोगविभूतिभाजो मर्त्ये वसंति सुचिरं बहुजीववत्साः ॥ 4.69.90 ॥ ॥
देवशयनोत्थापनद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.69.m:
Those women who, on the twelfth bright day in Ūrja, worship a cow along with her calf with flowers and delightful vadas, / share in all desires, pleasures, and opulence, and abide in the mortal world for a very long time, their calves and children living long.
Description of the Devaśayanotthāpanadvādaśī Votive Observance

4.70.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi govindaśayanaṃ vratam ..
kaṭadānaṃ samutthānaṃ cāturmāsyavratakramam .. 1 ..
4.70.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पार्थ प्रवक्ष्यामि गोविन्दशयनं व्रतम् ॥
कटदानं समुत्थानं चातुर्मास्यव्रतक्रमम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.70.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O Pārtha, I will declare the observance of Govinda’s sleeping, / the gifting of a mat, the awakening, and the course of the Cāturmāsya observance.

4.70.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kiṃ devaśayanaṃ nāma devassvapiti cāpyasau ..
devaḥ kimarthaṃ svapiti kiṃ vidhānaṃ sadā vada .. 2 ..
4.70.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
किं देवशयनं नाम देवस्स्वपिति चाप्यसौ ॥
देवः किमर्थं स्वपिति किं विधानं सदा वद ॥ 2 ॥
4.70.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is this called the sleep of the God? Does the God indeed sleep? / Why does the God sleep? Tell me always, what is the procedure?

4.70.s:
ke maṃtrāḥ ke ca niyamā vratānyatha kriyā ca kā ..
kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ supte deve janārdane .. 3 ..
4.70.d:
के मंत्राः के च नियमा व्रतान्यथ क्रिया च का ॥
किं ग्राह्यं किं च भोक्तव्यं सुप्ते देवे जनार्दने ॥ 3 ॥
4.70.m: What are the mantras, and what are the restrictions, the observances, and what is the ritual? / What is to be received, and what is to be eaten, while the God Janārdana sleeps?

4.70.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mithunasthe sahasrāṃśau sthāpayenmadhusūdanam ..
tulārāśigate tasminpunarutthāpayedvratam .. 4 ..
4.70.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
मिथुनस्थे सहस्रांशौ स्थापयेन्मधुसूदनम् ॥
तुलाराशिगते तस्मिन्पुनरुत्थापयेद्व्रतम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.70.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When the thousand-rayed Sun stands in Gemini, one should lay Madhusūdana to rest; / when he enters the sign of Libra, one should awaken the observance again.

4.70.s:
adhimāse ca patite eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ ..
nānyathā sthāpayeddevaṃ na caivotthāpayeddharim .. 5 ..
4.70.d:
अधिमासे च पतिते एष एव विधिक्रमः ॥
नान्यथा स्थापयेद्देवं न चैवोत्थापयेद्धरिम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.70.m: Even when an intercalary month occurs, this very sequence of rites applies; / one should not otherwise lay the God to rest, nor awaken Hari.

4.70.s:
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
sthāpayedbhaktimānviṣṇuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam .. 6 ..
4.70.d:
आषाढस्य सिते पक्षे एकादश्यामुपोषितः ॥
स्थापयेद्भक्तिमान्विष्णुं शंखचक्रगदाधरम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.70.m: Fasting on the eleventh lunar day of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha, / the devotee should lay down Viṣṇu, who bears the conch, discus, and mace,

4.70.s:
pītāṃbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ paryaṃke svāstṛte śubhe ..
śuklavastrasamācchanne sopadhāne yudhiṣṭhira .. 7 ..
4.70.d:
पीतांबरधरं सौम्यं पर्यंके स्वास्तृते शुभे ॥
शुक्लवस्त्रसमाच्छन्ने सोपधाने युधिष्ठिर ॥ 7 ॥
4.70.m: wearing yellow garments, gentle, upon an auspicious, well-strewn couch / covered with a white cloth and provided with a pillow, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.70.s:
itihāsapurāṇajño viṣṇubhaktopi yaḥ pumān ..
snāpayitvā dadhikṣīraghṛtakṣaudrajalaistathā .. 8 ..
4.70.d:
इतिहासपुराणज्ञो विष्णुभक्तोपि यः पुमान् ॥
स्नापयित्वा दधिक्षीरघृतक्षौद्रजलैस्तथा ॥ 8 ॥
4.70.m: Whatever person knows the Itihāsas and Purāṇas and is devoted to Viṣṇu, / having bathed [Him] with curd, milk, ghee, honey, and water,

4.70.s:
samālabhya śubhairgaṃdhairdhūpairva strairalaṃkṛtam ..
pūjayitvā kuṃkumādyairmaṃtreṇānena pāṇḍava .. 9 ..
4.70.d:
समालभ्य शुभैर्गंधैर्धूपैर्व स्त्रैरलंकृतम् ॥
पूजयित्वा कुंकुमाद्यैर्मंत्रेणानेन पाण्डव ॥ 9 ॥
4.70.m: anointing Him with auspicious perfumes, adorned with incenses and garments, / having worshipped Him with saffron and other [offerings], O Pāṇḍava, with this mantra:

4.70.s:
supte tvayi jagannātha jagatsuptaṃ bhavedidam ..
vibuddhe tvayi budhyeta jagatsarvaṃ carācaram .. 4.70.10 ..
4.70.d:
सुप्ते त्वयि जगन्नाथ जगत्सुप्तं भवेदिदम् ॥
विबुद्धे त्वयि बुध्येत जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् ॥ 4.70.10 ॥
4.70.m: "When you are asleep, O Lord of the world, this world is asleep; / when you awaken, the entire world of moving and unmoving beings awakens."

4.70.s:
evaṃ tāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ sthāpayitvā yudhiṣṭhira ..
tasyaivāgre svayaṃ vācaṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamāṃstataḥ .. 11 ..
4.70.d:
एवं तां प्रतिमां विष्णोः स्थापयित्वा युधिष्ठिर ॥
तस्यैवाग्रे स्वयं वाचं गृह्णीयान्नियमांस्ततः ॥ 11 ॥
4.70.m: Having thus laid that image of Viṣṇu to rest, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / in his very presence one should personally undertake the vow and then the restrictions,

4.70.s:
caturo vārṣikānmāsāndevasyotthāpanāvadhi ..
strī vā naro vā madbhakto dharmārthaṃ sudṛḍhavrataḥ ..12..
4.70.d:
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्देवस्योत्थापनावधि ॥
स्त्री वा नरो वा मद्भक्तो धर्मार्थं सुदृढव्रतः ॥12॥
4.70.m: for the four rainy months, up to the awakening of the God. / A woman or a man devoted to me, resolute in observance for the sake of dharma,

4.70.s:
gṛhṇīyānniyamānetāndaṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
teṣāṃ phalāni vakṣyāmi tatkartṝṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 13 ..
4.70.d:
गृह्णीयान्नियमानेतान्दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
तेषां फलानि वक्ष्यामि तत्कर्तॄणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 13 ॥
4.70.m: should undertake these restrictions, beginning with the cleaning of the teeth. / I will declare the various fruits for those who perform them.

4.70.s:
madhurasvaro bhavedrājā puruṣo guḍavarjanāt ..
tailasya varjanātpārtha sundarāṃgaḥ prajāyate .. 14 ..
4.70.d:
मधुरस्वरो भवेद्राजा पुरुषो गुडवर्जनात् ॥
तैलस्य वर्जनात्पार्थ सुन्दरांगः प्रजायते ॥ 14 ॥
4.70.m: By giving up molasses, a man becomes sweet-voiced and a king, O King; / by giving up oil, O Pārtha, he becomes handsome of limb.

4.70.s:
kaṭutailaparityāgācchatrukṣayamavāpnuyāt ..
madhūkatailatyāgena saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet .. 15 ..
4.70.d:
कटुतैलपरित्यागाच्छत्रुक्षयमवाप्नुयात् ॥
मधूकतैलत्यागेन सौभाग्यमतुलं भवेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.70.m: By abandoning pungent oil, he attains the destruction of enemies; / by giving up madhūka oil, incomparable good fortune ensues.

4.70.s:
puṣpādibhogatyāgena svarge vidyādharo bhavet ..
yogābhyāsī bhavedyastu sa brahmapadamāpnuyāt .. 16 ..
4.70.d:
पुष्पादिभोगत्यागेन स्वर्गे विद्याधरो भवेत् ॥
योगाभ्यासी भवेद्यस्तु स ब्रह्मपदमाप्नुयात् ॥ 16 ॥
4.70.m: By giving up the enjoyment of flowers and the like, he becomes a Vidyādhara in heaven; / but he who practices yoga attains the state of Brahman.

4.70.s:
kaṭukāmlatiktamadhurakṣārakāṣāyameva ca ..
yo varjayetsa vairūpyaṃ daurgatyaṃ nāpnuyātkvacit .. 17 ..
4.70.d:
कटुकाम्लतिक्तमधुरक्षारकाषायमेव च ॥
यो वर्जयेत्स वैरूप्यं दौर्गत्यं नाप्नुयात्क्वचित् ॥ 17 ॥
4.70.m: Pungent, sour, bitter, sweet, saline, and astringent— / he who avoids these never meets with deformity or misfortune.

4.70.s:
tāṃbūlavarjanādbhogī raktakaṇṭhaśca jāyate ..
ghṛtatyāgātsulāvaṇyaṃ sarvasiddhiḥ punarbhavet .. 18 ..
4.70.d:
तांबूलवर्जनाद्भोगी रक्तकण्ठश्च जायते ॥
घृतत्यागात्सुलावण्यं सर्वसिद्धिः पुनर्भवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.70.m: By abstaining from betel, he becomes a man of pleasure and sweet-voiced; / by giving up ghee, he gains great charm and, furthermore, all perfections.

4.70.s:
phalatyāgācca matimānbahuputraśca jāyate ..
śākapatrāśanādrogī apakvādo'malo bhavet .. 19 ..
4.70.d:
फलत्यागाच्च मतिमान्बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥
शाकपत्राशनाद्रोगी अपक्वादोऽमलो भवेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.70.m: By giving up fruit, he becomes wise and blessed with many sons; / eating leafy vegetables, he becomes free of disease; eating raw food, he becomes pure.

4.70.s:
pādābhyaṃgaparityāgācchirobhyaṃgācca pārthiva ..
dīptimān dīptakaraṇo yakṣo dravyapatirbhavet .. 4.70.20 ..
4.70.d:
पादाभ्यंगपरित्यागाच्छिरोभ्यंगाच्च पार्थिव ॥
दीप्तिमान् दीप्तकरणो यक्षो द्रव्यपतिर्भवेत् ॥ 4.70.20 ॥
4.70.m: By giving up foot-massage and head-massage, O King, / he becomes radiant, of sharp senses, and a Yakṣa, master of wealth.

4.70.s:
dadhidugdha takraniyamādgolokaṃ labhate naraḥ ..
indrātithitvamāpnoti sthālīpākavivarjitāt .. 21 ..
4.70.d:
दधिदुग्ध तक्रनियमाद्गोलोकं लभते नरः ॥
इन्द्रातिथित्वमाप्नोति स्थालीपाकविवर्जितात् ॥ 21 ॥
4.70.m: Through the restriction of curd, milk, and buttermilk, a man attains Goloka; / by abstaining from pot-cooked food, he attains guest-ship with Indra.

4.70.s:
labheta saṃtatiṃ dīrghāṃ tāpapakvasya bhakṣaṇāt ..
bhūmāvastaraśāyī ca viṣṇoranucaro bhavet .. 22 ..
4.70.d:
लभेत संततिं दीर्घां तापपक्वस्य भक्षणात् ॥
भूमावस्तरशायी च विष्णोरनुचरो भवेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.70.m: He obtains long lineage by eating food cooked in a frying pan; / and sleeping on a mat spread on the ground, he becomes an attendant of Viṣṇu.

4.70.s:
sadā muniḥ sadā yogī madhumāṃsasya varjanāt ..
nirvyādhirnīrujaujasvī surāmadyavivarjanāt .. .. 23 ..
4.70.d:
सदा मुनिः सदा योगी मधुमांसस्य वर्जनात् ॥
निर्व्याधिर्नीरुजौजस्वी सुरामद्यविवर्जनात् ॥ ॥ 23 ॥
4.70.m: By avoiding honey and meat, he is always a sage, always a yogi; / by abstaining from liquor and spirits, he is free of illness, healthy, and vigorous.

4.70.s:
evamādiparityāgāddharmaḥ syāddharmanandana ..
ekāṃtaropavāsena brahmaloke mahīyate .. 24 ..
4.70.d:
एवमादिपरित्यागाद्धर्मः स्याद्धर्मनन्दन ॥
एकांतरोपवासेन ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ॥ 24 ॥
4.70.m: Dharma arises from such renunciations, O son of Dharma; / by fasting on alternate days, one is exalted in the world of Brahmā.

4.70.s:
dhāraṇaṃ nakharomāṇāṃ gaṃgāsnānaṃ dinedine ..
maunavratī bhavedyastu tasyājñā'skhalitā bhavet .. 25 ..
4.70.d:
धारणं नखरोमाणां गंगास्नानं दिनेदिने ॥
मौनव्रती भवेद्यस्तु तस्याज्ञाऽस्खलिता भवेत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.70.m: Keeping untrimmed nails and hair brings the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā day by day; / he who observes the vow of silence has an unthwarted command.

4.70.s:
bhūmau bhuṃkte sadā yastu sa pṛthivyāḥ patirbhavet ..
namo nārāyaṇāyeti japatonaśanaṃ phalam .. 26 ..
4.70.d:
भूमौ भुंक्ते सदा यस्तु स पृथिव्याः पतिर्भवेत् ॥
नमो नारायणायेति जपतोनशनं फलम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.70.m: He who always eats on the ground becomes master of the earth; / for one murmuring "Homage to Nārāyaṇa," the fruit is that of total fasting.

4.70.s:
pādābhivaṃdanādviṣṇorlabhedgodānajaṃ phalam ..
viṣṇupādāṃbusaṃsparśātkṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ .. 27 ..
4.70.d:
पादाभिवंदनाद्विष्णोर्लभेद्गोदानजं फलम् ॥
विष्णुपादांबुसंस्पर्शात्कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः ॥ 27 ॥
4.70.m: From saluting the feet of Viṣṇu, one obtains the fruit born of gifting cows; / from touching the foot-water of Viṣṇu, a man has accomplished his duty.

4.70.s:
viṣṇudevakule kuryādupalepanamarcanam ..
kalpasthāyī bhavedrājā sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 28 ..
4.70.d:
विष्णुदेवकुले कुर्यादुपलेपनमर्चनम् ॥
कल्पस्थायी भवेद्राजा स नरो नात्र संशयः ॥ 28 ॥
4.70.m: He who smears and worships in the temple of Viṣṇu / becomes a king enduring for an eon, O King; there is no doubt about this.

4.70.s:
pradakṣiṇāśataṃ yastu karoti stutipāṭhakaḥ ..
haṃsayuktavimānena sa ca viṣṇu puraṃ vrajet .. 29 ..
4.70.d:
प्रदक्षिणाशतं यस्तु करोति स्तुतिपाठकः ॥
हंसयुक्तविमानेन स च विष्णु पुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.70.m: He who makes a hundred circumambulations, singing praises, / goes to the city of Viṣṇu in a celestial chariot drawn by swans.

4.70.s:
gītavādyakaro viṣṇorgāṃdharvaṃ lokamāpnuyāt ..
nityaṃ śāstravinodena lokānyastu prabodhati .. 4.70.30 ..
4.70.d:
गीतवाद्यकरो विष्णोर्गांधर्वं लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥
नित्यं शास्त्रविनोदेन लोकान्यस्तु प्रबोधति ॥ 4.70.30 ॥
4.70.m: He who makes vocal and instrumental music for Viṣṇu reaches the world of the Gandharvas; / he who continually enlightens people through the diversion of scriptures,

4.70.s:
sa vyāsarūpī bhagavānaṃte viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ..
puṣpamālādibhiḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet .. 31 ..
4.70.d:
स व्यासरूपी भगवानंते विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् ॥
पुष्पमालादिभिः पूजां कृत्वा विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.70.m: being a manifestation of Vyāsa, goes at the end to the city of Viṣṇu; / having performed worship with garlands of flowers and the like, he goes to the city of Viṣṇu.

4.70.s:
nityasnāyī naro yastu narakaṃ sa na paśyati ..
bhojanaṃ ca jayedyastu sa snānaṃ pauṣkaraṃ labhet .. 32 ..
4.70.d:
नित्यस्नायी नरो यस्तु नरकं स न पश्यति ॥
भोजनं च जयेद्यस्तु स स्नानं पौष्करं लभेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.70.m: A man who bathes daily does not see hell; / he who conquers his food obtains the fruit of bathing at Puṣkara.

4.70.s:
kṛtvā prekṣaṇakaṃ divyaṃ rājyaṃ so'psarasāṃ labhet ..
ayācitena prāpnoti vāpīkūpe yathā phalam .. 33 ..
4.70.d:
कृत्वा प्रेक्षणकं दिव्यं राज्यं सोऽप्सरसां लभेत् ॥
अयाचितेन प्राप्नोति वापीकूपे यथा फलम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.70.m: Having arranged a divine spectacle, he attains the realm of the apsarases; / through unasked food, he gains the same fruit as from tanks and wells.

4.70.s:
ṣaṣṭhakālennabhojyena sthāyī svarge naro bhavet ..
parṇeṣu yo naro bhuṃkte kurukṣetraphalaṃ labhet ..34..
4.70.d:
षष्ठकालेन्नभोज्येन स्थायी स्वर्गे नरो भवेत् ॥
पर्णेषु यो नरो भुंक्ते कुरुक्षेत्रफलं लभेत् ॥34॥
4.70.m: By eating food only at the sixth mealtime, a man becomes an enduring dweller in heaven; / that man who eats off leaves obtains the fruit of Kurukṣetra.

4.70.s:
śilāyāṃ bhojanānnityaṃ snānaṃ prayāgajaṃ bhavet ..
yāmadvaye jalatyāgānna rogaiḥ paribhūyate .. 35 ..
4.70.d:
शिलायां भोजनान्नित्यं स्नानं प्रयागजं भवेत् ॥
यामद्वये जलत्यागान्न रोगैः परिभूयते ॥ 35 ॥
4.70.m: From eating constantly off a stone slab, the fruit of bathing at Prayāga arises; / by abstaining from water for two watches, he is not overcome by diseases.

4.70.s:
evamādivrate pārtha tuṣṭimāyāti hetutaḥ ..
supte sati jagannāthe keśave garuḍadhvaje .. 36 ..
4.70.d:
एवमादिव्रते पार्थ तुष्टिमायाति हेतुतः ॥
सुप्ते सति जगन्नाथे केशवे गरुडध्वजे ॥ 36 ॥
4.70.m: In such observances, O Pārtha, He finds satisfaction accordingly; / while Keśava, whose banner is Garuḍa, the Lord of the world, is asleep,

4.70.s:
nivartate kriyāḥ sarvāścāturvaṇyasya bhārata ..
vivāhavratabaṃdhādibhūtasaṃskāradīkṣaṇam .. 37 ..
4.70.d:
निवर्तते क्रियाः सर्वाश्चातुर्वण्यस्य भारत ॥
विवाहव्रतबंधादिभूतसंस्कारदीक्षणम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.70.m: all rituals for the four castes cease, O Bhārata: / marriages, tonsure, thread ceremonies, initiation, and rites of passage for living beings,

4.70.s:
yajñāśca gṛhaveśādi godānācca pratiṣṭhitam ..
pūjyāni yāni karmāṇi tāni sarvāṇi varjayet .. 38 ..
4.70.d:
यज्ञाश्च गृहवेशादि गोदानाच्च प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
पूज्यानि यानि कर्माणि तानि सर्वाणि वर्जयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.70.m: sacrifices, house-entering and the like, and consecrations from cow-giving; / all those rites which are worthy of worship one should avoid.

4.70.s:
asaṃkrāṃtaṃ tu māsaṃ vai daive pitrye ca varjayet ..
malimlucamaśaucaṃ ca sūryasaṃkrāṃtivarjitam .. 39 ..
4.70.d:
असंक्रांतं तु मासं वै दैवे पित्र्ये च वर्जयेत् ॥
मलिम्लुचमशौचं च सूर्यसंक्रांतिवर्जितम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.70.m: One should indeed avoid a month without solar transit in rites for the gods and ancestors; / it is an intercalary month, impure, and devoid of the sun's transit.

4.70.s:
prāpte bhādrapade māsi ekādaśyāṃ dine hareḥ ..
kaṭadānaṃ bhavedviṣṇormahāpūjā pravartayet .. 4.70.40 ..
4.70.d:
प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे मासि एकादश्यां दिने हरेः ॥
कटदानं भवेद्विष्णोर्महापूजा प्रवर्तयेत् ॥ 4.70.40 ॥
4.70.m: When the month of Bhādrapada has arrived, on the ekādaśī, on the day of Hari, / there should be the gift of a mat to Viṣṇu, and one should perform a grand worship.

4.70.s:
ya etadeva śayanaṃ tatredaṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
purā tapaḥprabhāvena toṣayitvā hariṃ vibhum .. 41 ..
4.70.d:
य एतदेव शयनं तत्रेदं कारणं शृणु ॥
पुरा तपःप्रभावेन तोषयित्वा हरिं विभुम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.70.m: As for this very slumber, hear the reason for it: / long ago, having pleased the all-pervading lord Hari through the power of asceticism,

4.70.s:
mamāpi mānayatyaṅgaṃ prārthito yoganidrayā ..
nirīkṣya cātmano devā ruddhaṃ lakṣmyā uraḥsthalam .. 42 ..
4.70.d:
ममापि मानयत्यङ्गं प्रार्थितो योगनिद्रया ॥
निरीक्ष्य चात्मनो देवा रुद्धं लक्ष्म्या उरःस्थलम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.70.m: and being petitioned by Yoganidrā, saying, 'He should honour my limb as well'— / and seeing that the god's chest was covered by Lakṣmī,

4.70.s:
śaṃkhacakrāsimārgādyairbāhavopyatha vakṣasā ..
adho nābherviruddhaṃ me vainateyena pakṣiṇā .. 43 ..
4.70.d:
शंखचक्रासिमार्गाद्यैर्बाहवोप्यथ वक्षसा ॥
अधो नाभेर्विरुद्धं मे वैनतेयेन पक्षिणा ॥ 43 ॥
4.70.m: and the arms as well by the conch, discus, sword, club, and others, as also by the chest, / and [he thought,] 'Below my navel is blocked by the bird, the son of Vinatā;

4.70.s:
mukaṭena śiro ruddhaṃ kuṃḍalābhyāṃ ca karṇakau ..
tato dadāvahaṃ tuṣṭo netrayoḥ sthānamādarāt .. 44 ..
4.70.d:
मुकटेन शिरो रुद्धं कुंडलाभ्यां च कर्णकौ ॥
ततो ददावहं तुष्टो नेत्रयोः स्थानमादरात् ॥ 44 ॥
4.70.m: the head is covered by the crown, and the ears by the two earrings.' / Then, being pleased, I respectfully gave her a place in my eyes:

4.70.s:
caturo vārṣikānmāsānmā''śritā sā bhaviṣyati ..
yoganidrāpi māhātmyaṃ śrutvā paurātanaṃ śubham .. 45 ..
4.70.d:
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्मा'ऽश्रिता सा भविष्यति ॥
योगनिद्रापि माहात्म्यं श्रुत्वा पौरातनं शुभम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.70.m: 'For the four rainy months she shall have recourse to me.' / And Yoganidrā too, having heard the ancient, auspicious majesty,

4.70.s:
cakāra locanāvāsamato'rthaṃ me yudhiṣṭhira ..
ahaṃ ca tāṃ bhāvayitvā mānayāmi manasvinīm .. 46 ..
4.70.d:
चकार लोचनावासमतोऽर्थं मे युधिष्ठिर ॥
अहं च तां भावयित्वा मानयामि मनस्विनीम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.70.m: made her dwelling in my eyes for this purpose, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / And meditating upon that wise [goddess], I honour her.

4.70.s:
yoganidrā mahānidrā śeṣābhiśayane sthitaḥ ..
kṣīrodadhau ca viṃdhyagre dhautapādaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 47 ..
4.70.d:
योगनिद्रा महानिद्रा शेषाभिशयने स्थितः ॥
क्षीरोदधौ च विंध्यग्रे धौतपादः समाहितः ॥ 47 ॥
4.70.m: Yoganidrā is the great sleep. Resting on the couch of Śeṣa / in the ocean of milk and on the summit of the Vindhya, his feet washed, concentrated,

4.70.s:
lakṣmīkarāṃbujairacchairmṛdyamānapadadvayaḥ ..
tasminkāle'pi madbhaktau yo māsāṃścaturaḥ kṣipet .. 48 ..
4.70.d:
लक्ष्मीकरांबुजैरच्छैर्मृद्यमानपदद्वयः ॥
तस्मिन्कालेऽपि मद्भक्तौ यो मासांश्चतुरः क्षिपेत् ॥ 48 ॥
4.70.m: his two feet being rubbed by Lakṣmī's clear lotus-hands— / during that period as well, whoever spends the four months in devotion to me,

4.70.s:
vratairanekainiyamaiḥ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha mānavaḥ ..
kalpasthāyī viṣṇulokaṃ sa vrajennātra saṃśayaḥ .. 49 ..
4.70.d:
व्रतैरनेकैनियमैः पांडवश्रेष्ठ मानवः ॥
कल्पस्थायी विष्णुलोकं स व्रजेन्नात्र संशयः ॥ 49 ॥
4.70.m: with various votive observances and restrictions, O best of the Pāṇḍavas, that person / will go to the world of Viṣṇu, remaining there for a kalpa; of this there is no doubt.

4.70.s:
tato'vabudhyate devaḥ śrīmāñchaṅkhagadādharaḥ ..
kārtike śuklapakṣasya ekādaśyāṃ pṛthakchṛṇu .. 4.70.50 ..
4.70.d:
ततोऽवबुध्यते देवः श्रीमाञ्छङ्खगदाधरः ॥
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य एकादश्यां पृथक्छृणु ॥ 4.70.50 ॥
4.70.m: Then the glorious god, the bearer of the conch and mace, awakens. / On the ekādaśī of the bright fortnight of Kārtika, hear [about it] separately.

4.70.s:
mantreṇānena rājendra devamutthāpayeddvijaḥ ..
idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame svāsane ca tadā nṛpa .. 51 ..
4.70.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र देवमुत्थापयेद्द्विजः ॥
इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रमे स्वासने च तदा नृप ॥ 51 ॥
4.70.m: With this mantra, O ruler of kings, a twice-born should awaken the god: / 'Viṣṇu strode across this…', and then onto his throne, O king.

4.70.s:
samutthite tadā viṣṇo kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartayet ..
mahātūryarave rātrau bhrāmayetsyaṃdane sthitam ..52..
4.70.d:
समुत्थिते तदा विष्णो क्रियाः सर्वाः प्रवर्तयेत् ॥
महातूर्यरवे रात्रौ भ्रामयेत्स्यंदने स्थितम् ॥52॥
4.70.m: When Viṣṇu has arisen, one should then begin all sacred rites. / At night, amidst the great blare of musical instruments, one should take [the image] seated on a chariot in procession.

4.70.s:
utthite devadeveśe nagare pārthivaḥ svayam ..
dīpodrekakare mārge nṛtyagītajanākule .. 53 ..
4.70.d:
उत्थिते देवदेवेशे नगरे पार्थिवः स्वयम् ॥
दीपोद्रेककरे मार्गे नृत्यगीतजनाकुले ॥ 53 ॥
4.70.m: When the lord of the gods of gods has arisen, the king himself, in the city / along the roadway filled with an abundance of lamps and thronged with people singing and dancing,

4.70.s:
yaṃyaṃ dāmodaraḥ paśyedutthito dharaṇīdharaḥ ..
taṃtaṃ pradeyaṃ rājendra sarvaṃ svargāya kalpate .. 54 ..
4.70.d:
यंयं दामोदरः पश्येदुत्थितो धरणीधरः ॥
तंतं प्रदेयं राजेन्द्र सर्वं स्वर्गाय कल्पते ॥ 54 ॥
4.70.m: whatever Dāmodara, the bearer of the earth, beholds when he has arisen, / each of those things should be given away, O best of kings; everything leads to heaven.

4.70.s:
rātrau prajāgare devamekādaśyāṃ surālaye ..
prabhāte vimale snātvā dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumarcayet .. 55 ..
4.70.d:
रात्रौ प्रजागरे देवमेकादश्यां सुरालये ॥
प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा द्वादश्यां विष्णुमर्चयेत् ॥ 55 ॥
4.70.m: Observing a night-vigil for the god on the ekādaśī in the temple, / having bathed at pure daybreak, one should worship Viṣṇu on the dvādaśī.

4.70.s:
homayeddhavyavāhaṃ ca havyadravyairghṛtādibhiḥ ..
tato viprāñchubhānsnātvā bhojayedannavistaraiḥ .. 56 ..
4.70.d:
होमयेद्धव्यवाहं च हव्यद्रव्यैर्घृतादिभिः ॥
ततो विप्राञ्छुभान्स्नात्वा भोजयेदन्नविस्तरैः ॥ 56 ॥
4.70.m: And one should offer oblations into the bearer of offerings with oblation materials such as ghee and the like. / Then, having bathed, one should feed the auspicious brāhmaṇas with an abundance of foods,

4.70.s:
ghṛtadadhikṣaudrakādyairguḍadhūpaiḥ samodakaiḥ ..
yajamāno'pi saṃtuṣṭastvarā hāsyavivarjitaḥ .. 57 ..
4.70.d:
घृतदधिक्षौद्रकाद्यैर्गुडधूपैः समोदकैः ॥
यजमानोऽपि संतुष्टस्त्वरा हास्यविवर्जितः ॥ 57 ॥
4.70.m: with ghee, curds, honey, and the like, with jaggery, incense, and with modakas. / The sacrificer too, being contented, should be devoid of haste and laughter.

4.70.s:
ekādaśa daśāṣṭau vā paṃca dvau vā kurūttama ..
arcayeccandanairdhūpaiḥ puṣpairgandhairdvijottamān .. 58 ..
4.70.d:
एकादश दशाष्टौ वा पंच द्वौ वा कुरूत्तम ॥
अर्चयेच्चन्दनैर्धूपैः पुष्पैर्गन्धैर्द्विजोत्तमान् ॥ 58 ॥
4.70.m: Eleven, ten, or eight, five or two, O best of Kurus, / one should worship the best of the twice-born with sandalpastes, incenses, flowers, and perfumes.

4.70.s:
śraddhoktavidhinā pārtha bhojayedbhāgyavānyatīn ..
ācāṃtebhyastato dadyāttyāgaṃ yatkiñcideva hi .. 59 ..
4.70.d:
श्रद्धोक्तविधिना पार्थ भोजयेद्भाग्यवान्यतीन् ॥
