आचांतेभ्यस्ततो दद्यात्त्यागं यत्किञ्चिदेव हि ॥ 59 ॥
4.70.m: The fortunate person should feed ascetic mendicants according to the rule declared for faith, O son of Pṛthā. / Then, to those who have sipped water, he should give a gift, whatever he can afford,

4.70.s:
svavācā svamanobhīṣṭapatrapuṣpaphalādikam ..
caturo vārṣikānmāsānniyamo yasya yaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 4.70.60 ..
4.70.d:
स्ववाचा स्वमनोभीष्टपत्रपुष्पफलादिकम् ॥
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्नियमो यस्य यः कृतः ॥ 4.70.60 ॥
4.70.m: according to his word, whatever leaf, flower, fruit, and so forth is cherished by his own mind. / Whatever restriction was undertaken by someone for the four rainy months,

4.70.s:
kathayitvā dvijebhyastaṃ dadyādbhaktyā sadakṣiṇām ..
dattvā visarjayedviprāṃstato bhuñjīta ca svayam .. 61 ..
4.70.d:
कथयित्वा द्विजेभ्यस्तं दद्याद्भक्त्या सदक्षिणाम् ॥
दत्त्वा विसर्जयेद्विप्रांस्ततो भुञ्जीत च स्वयम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.70.m: having related it to the twice-born, he should offer it with devotion along with a sacrificial fee. / Having given it, he should dismiss the brāhmaṇas, and then he may eat himself.

4.70.s:
yattyaktaṃ caturo māsānpravṛttintasya cācaret ..
evaṃ ya ācaretpārtha so'nantaṃ dharmamāpnuyāt .. 62 ..
4.70.d:
यत्त्यक्तं चतुरो मासान्प्रवृत्तिन्तस्य चाचरेत् ॥
एवं य आचरेत्पार्थ सोऽनन्तं धर्ममाप्नुयात् ॥ 62 ॥
4.70.m: He should resume the practice of whatever had been given up for the four months. / Whoever acts in this way, O son of Pṛthā, will obtain endless merit,

4.70.s:
avasāne tu rājendra vāsudevapurīṃ vrajet ..
yasyāvighnaiḥ samāpyeta cāturmāsyavrataṃ nṛpa .. 63 ..
4.70.d:
अवसाने तु राजेन्द्र वासुदेवपुरीं व्रजेत् ॥
यस्याविघ्नैः समाप्येत चातुर्मास्यव्रतं नृप ॥ 63 ॥
4.70.m: and at the end [of life], O ruler of kings, he will go to the city of Vāsudeva. / He whose Cāturmāsya-vrata is completed without obstacles, O king,

4.70.s:
sa bhavetkṛtakṛtyastu na punarmātṛko bhavet ..
yo devaśayanaṃ pārtha māsaṃmāsaṃ samācareta .. 64 ..
4.70.d:
स भवेत्कृतकृत्यस्तु न पुनर्मातृको भवेत् ॥
यो देवशयनं पार्थ मासंमासं समाचरेत ॥ 64 ॥
4.70.m: becomes one who has accomplished his purpose and is not born of a mother again. / He who observes the slumber of the god month by month, O son of Pṛthā,

4.70.s:
utthānaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya sa harerlokamāpnuyāt ..
śṛṇoti dhyāyati stauti juhotyākhyāti yo naraḥ ..
viṣṇorbhaktiṃ parāṃ pārtha sa gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ padam .. 65 ..
4.70.d:
उत्थानं चापि कृष्णस्य स हरेर्लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥
शृणोति ध्यायति स्तौति जुहोत्याख्याति यो नरः ॥
विष्णोर्भक्तिं परां पार्थ स गच्छेद्वैष्णवं पदम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.70.m: and also the awakening of Kṛṣṇa, attains the world of Hari. / The mortal who hears, meditates, praises, offers oblations, or recounts / supreme devotion to Viṣṇu, O son of Pṛthā, goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.

4.70.s:
dugdhābdhibhogaśayane bhagavānananto yasmindine svapiti yatra vibudhyate vā ..
tasminnananyamanasāmupavāsabhājāṃ puṃsāṃ dadāti sugatiṃ garuḍāṃgasaṃgī .. 66 .. ..
nīrājanadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.70.d:
दुग्धाब्धिभोगशयने भगवाननन्तो यस्मिन्दिने स्वपिति यत्र विबुध्यते वा ॥
तस्मिन्ननन्यमनसामुपवासभाजां पुंसां ददाति सुगतिं गरुडांगसंगी ॥ 66 ॥ ॥
नीराजनद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.70.m:
On whichever day the infinite lord sleeps on the couch of coils in the ocean of milk, or on which he awakens, / on that day, to men who undertake fasting with single-minded intent, he who is in contact with Garuḍa's body grants a good destiny.
Description of the Nīrājanadvādaśī-vrata

4.71.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā babhūva rājarṣirajapāla iti śrutaḥ ..
prārthitaḥ sa prajābhistu sarvaduḥkhāpanuttaye .. 1 ..
4.71.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा बभूव राजर्षिरजपाल इति श्रुतः ॥
प्रार्थितः स प्रजाभिस्तु सर्वदुःखापनुत्तये ॥ 1 ॥
4.71.m: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, there was a royal sage renowned as Ajapāla. / He was petitioned by his subjects for the removal of all afflictions:

4.71.s:
duḥkhāpanodaṃ kuru bho vyādhitānāṃ nareśvara ..
evamuktaściraṃ dhyātvā kṛtvā vyādhīnprajāgaṇān .. 2 ..
4.71.d:
दुःखापनोदं कुरु भो व्याधितानां नरेश्वर ॥
एवमुक्तश्चिरं ध्यात्वा कृत्वा व्याधीन्प्रजागणान् ॥ 2 ॥
4.71.m: 'O lord of men, bring about the removal of suffering for those who are sick.' / Addressed thus, having meditated for a long time, and having healed the diseased multitude of his subjects,

4.71.s:
pālayāmāsa hṛṣṭo'sāvajapālastato'bhavat ..
tenaiṣā nirmitā śāṃtirnāmnā nīrājatā jane .. 3 ..
4.71.d:
पालयामास हृष्टोऽसावजपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
तेनैषा निर्मिता शांतिर्नाम्ना नीराजता जने ॥ 3 ॥
4.71.m: he, delighted, protected them; thus he became [known as] Ajapāla. / By him this propitiatory rite called Nīrājatā was instituted among the people.

4.71.s:
tasyāstu pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha lakṣaṇaṃ vacmi te śṛṇu ..
rājñā purohitaiḥ sārddhamanuṣṭheyā vidhānataḥ .. 4 ..
4.71.d:
तस्यास्तु पांडवश्रेष्ठ लक्षणं वच्मि ते शृणु ॥
राज्ञा पुरोहितैः सार्द्धमनुष्ठेया विधानतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.71.m: I shall tell you its characteristics, O best of the Pāṇḍavas; listen to me. / It is to be performed according to the rules by the king together with his family priests.

4.71.s:
tasminkāle vabhūvātha rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ..
laṃkāsthitaḥ suragaṇānniyunakti svakarmasu .. 5 ..
4.71.d:
तस्मिन्काले वभूवाथ रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥
लंकास्थितः सुरगणान्नियुनक्ति स्वकर्मसु ॥ 5 ॥
4.71.m: At that time there lived Rāvaṇa, the lord of the rākṣasas. / Residing in Laṅkā, he appointed the hosts of the gods to their respective duties.

4.71.s:
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ candramātapatraṃ cakāra ha ..
indraṃ senāpatiṃ cakre vāyuṃ pāṃsupramārjakam .. 6 ..
4.71.d:
अखण्डमण्डलं चन्द्रमातपत्रं चकार ह ॥
इन्द्रं सेनापतिं चक्रे वायुं पांसुप्रमार्जकम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.71.m: He made the unbroken disc of the moon his parasol; / he made Indra the commander of his army, and Vāyu the sweeper of dust.

4.71.s:
varuṇaṃ baddhakarmasthaṃ dhanadaṃ dhanarakṣakam ..
yamaṃ saṃyamane'rīṇāṃ yuyuje maṃtraṇe manum .. 7 ..
4.71.d:
वरुणं बद्धकर्मस्थं धनदं धनरक्षकम् ॥
यमं संयमनेऽरीणां युयुजे मंत्रणे मनुम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.71.m: Varuṇa was stationed in custodial service, Dhanada was the keeper of wealth, / he appointed Yama for restraining his enemies, and Manu for counsel.

4.71.s:
meghāśchādanti nṛpatiṃ drumapuṣpādipaṃktiṣu ..
saptarṣayaḥ śāṃtiparā brahmaṇā saha saṃsthitāḥ .. 8 ..
4.71.d:
मेघाश्छादन्ति नृपतिं द्रुमपुष्पादिपंक्तिषु ॥
सप्तर्षयः शांतिपरा ब्रह्मणा सह संस्थिताः ॥ 8 ॥
4.71.m: The clouds shaded the king amidst the rows of trees and flowers; / the Seven Sages, devoted to peaceful rites, stood along with Brahmā.

4.71.s:
yāmikā madhyakakṣāyāṃ gandharvā gītatatparāḥ ..
prekṣaṇīye'psarovṛṃdaṃ bāhye vidyādharā vṛtāḥ .. 9 ..
4.71.d:
यामिका मध्यकक्षायां गन्धर्वा गीततत्पराः ॥
प्रेक्षणीयेऽप्सरोवृंदं बाह्ये विद्याधरा वृताः ॥ 9 ॥
4.71.m: The Gandharvas were the watchmen in the middle courtyard, intent on song; / the troop of Apsarases was in the audience hall, and the Vidyādharas were arranged outside.

4.71.s:
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ pāne gārhapatye hutāśanaḥ ..
viśvakarmānnasaṃskāre yamaḥ śilpiprayojane..4.71.1 0..
4.71.d:
गंगाद्याः सरितः पाने गार्हपत्ये हुताशनः ॥
विश्वकर्मान्नसंस्कारे यमः शिल्पिप्रयोजने॥4.71.1 0॥
4.71.m: The Gaṅgā and other rivers were for drinking, the Fire-god was at the Gārhapatya hearth, / Viśvakarman was for the preparation of food, and Yama was for the employment of artisans.

4.71.s:
tiṣṭhaṃti pārthivāḥ sarve puraḥsevāvidhāyinaḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte bhāsurai ratnaiḥ prabhāvaṃto vibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.71.d:
तिष्ठंति पार्थिवाः सर्वे पुरःसेवाविधायिनः ॥
दृश्यंते भासुरै रत्नैः प्रभावंतो विभूषणैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.71.m: All the kings stood in front, performing service, / seen radiant with glittering jewels and ornaments.

4.71.s:
saṃdṛśya rāvaṇaḥ prāha praśastaṃ pratihārakam ..
sevāṃ kartuṃ mama sthāne brūhi ko'tra samāgataḥ .. 12 ..
4.71.d:
संदृश्य रावणः प्राह प्रशस्तं प्रतिहारकम् ॥
सेवां कर्तुं मम स्थाने ब्रूहि कोऽत्र समागतः ॥ 12 ॥
4.71.m: Observing [them], Rāvaṇa spoke to the distinguished door-keeper: / 'Tell me, who has arrived here to pay homage in my presence?'

4.71.s:
sa uvāca praṇamyāgre daṃḍapāṇirniśācaraḥ ..
eṣa kakutstho māṃdhātā dhuṃdhumāro nalorjunaḥ .. 13 ..
4.71.d:
स उवाच प्रणम्याग्रे दंडपाणिर्निशाचरः ॥
एष ककुत्स्थो मांधाता धुंधुमारो नलोर्जुनः ॥ 13 ॥
4.71.m: Bowing before him, that night-roamer with a staff in hand said: / 'This is Kakutstha, Māndhātṛ, Dhundhumāra, Nala, Arjuna,

4.71.s:
yayātirnahuṣo bhīmo rāghavoyaṃ vidūrathaḥ ..
ete cānye ca bahavo rājāna iti āsate .. 14 ..
4.71.d:
ययातिर्नहुषो भीमो राघवोयं विदूरथः ॥
एते चान्ये च बहवो राजान इति आसते ॥ 14 ॥
4.71.m: Yayāti, Nahuṣa, Bhīma, this descendant of Raghu, and Vidūratha. / These and many other kings sit here.'

4.71.s:
meghākārāstava sthāne nājapāla ihāgataḥ ..
rāvaṇaḥ kupitaḥ prāha śīghraṃ dūtaṃ vyasarjayat..15..
4.71.d:
मेघाकारास्तव स्थाने नाजपाल इहागतः ॥
रावणः कुपितः प्राह शीघ्रं दूतं व्यसर्जयत्॥15॥
4.71.m:
[The messengers who have] the form of clouds [stand] in your place, [yet] Ajapāla has not come here."
Enraged, Rāvaṇa spoke [and] quickly dispatched a messenger: 15

4.71.s:
ityukte prahito dūto dhūmrākṣo nāma rākṣasaḥ ..
dhūmrākṣa gaccha brūhi tvamajapālaṃ mamājñayā .. 16 ..
4.71.d:
इत्युक्ते प्रहितो दूतो धूम्राक्षो नाम राक्षसः ॥
धूम्राक्ष गच्छ ब्रूहि त्वमजपालं ममाज्ञया ॥ 16 ॥
4.71.m:
When this was spoken, a messenger was sent, a rākṣasa named Dhūmrākṣa:
"Dhūmrākṣa, go [and] speak to Ajapāla by my command: 16

4.71.s:
sevāṃ kuru samāgaccha kabandho yasya pārthivaḥ ..
anyathā candrahāsena tvāṃ kariṣye vikaṃdharam .. 77 ..
4.71.d:
सेवां कुरु समागच्छ कबन्धो यस्य पार्थिवः ॥
अन्यथा चन्द्रहासेन त्वां करिष्ये विकंधरम् ॥ 77 ॥
4.71.m:
'Perform service, come forward, [O you] whose king is a headless trunk!
Otherwise, with my Candrahāsa [sword] I shall make you headless!'" 77

4.71.s:
rāvaṇenaivamuktastu dhūmrākṣo garuḍo yathā ..
saṃprāpya tāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ tacca rājakulaṃ gataḥ .. .. 18 ..
4.71.d:
रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो गरुडो यथा ॥
संप्राप्य तां पुरीं रम्यां तच्च राजकुलं गतः ॥ ॥ 18 ॥
4.71.m:
Thus addressed by Rāvaṇa, Dhūmrākṣa, like Garuḍa,
reached that lovely city and went to that royal palace. 18

4.71.s:
dadarśa yaṃ tamekaṃ sa ajapālamajāvṛtam ..
muktakeśaṃ muktakakṣaṃ naikamuktakramadvayam .. 19 ..
4.71.d:
ददर्श यं तमेकं स अजपालमजावृतम् ॥
मुक्तकेशं मुक्तकक्षं नैकमुक्तक्रमद्वयम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.71.m:
He saw that solitary Ajapāla surrounded by goats,
with dishevelled hair, loose loincloth, his two feet not stepping evenly, 19

4.71.s:
yaṣṭiskandhaṃ reṇubhṛtaṃ vyādhibhiḥ parivāritam ..
nihatāmitraśārdūlaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam .. 4.71.20 ..
4.71.d:
यष्टिस्कन्धं रेणुभृतं व्याधिभिः परिवारितम् ॥
निहतामित्रशार्दूलं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् ॥ 4.71.20 ॥
4.71.m:
his staff on his shoulder, covered in dust, surrounded by ailments,
having slain the tiger of his enemies, destroying all afflictions, 20

4.71.s:
mahyāmālikhya nāmāni vinighnitaṃ dviṣāṃ gaṇam ..
snātaṃ bhuktaṃ śubhe sthāne kṛtakṛtyaṃ muniṃ yathā .. 21 ..
4.71.d:
मह्यामालिख्य नामानि विनिघ्नितं द्विषां गणम् ॥
स्नातं भुक्तं शुभे स्थाने कृतकृत्यं मुनिं यथा ॥ 21 ॥
4.71.m:
writing the names of the host of his foes on the earth and striking them down,
bathed and fed in an auspicious place, having accomplished his task like an ascetic. 21

4.71.s:
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanāḥ prāha dhūmrākṣo rāvaṇoditam ..
sākṣepamajapālo'pi pratyuktvā kāraṇāṃtaram .. 22 ..
4.71.d:
दृष्ट्वा हृष्टमनाः प्राह धूम्राक्षो रावणोदितम् ॥
साक्षेपमजपालोऽपि प्रत्युक्त्वा कारणांतरम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.71.m:
Seeing [him], with a glad mind Dhūmrākṣa delivered what was said by Rāvaṇa.
Ajapāla, having replied reproachfully with another reason, 22

4.71.s:
preṣayāmāsa dhūmrākṣaṃ tataḥ kṛtyaṃ samādadhe ..
jvaramākārayitvā tu provācedaṃ mahīpatiḥ .. 23 ..
4.71.d:
प्रेषयामास धूम्राक्षं ततः कृत्यं समादधे ॥
ज्वरमाकारयित्वा तु प्रोवाचेदं महीपतिः ॥ 23 ॥
4.71.m:
sent Dhūmrākṣa away, and then undertook a magical rite.
Having summoned the Fever, the ruler of the earth spoke these words: 23

4.71.s:
gaccha laṃkādhipasthānamācarasva yathocitam ..
niyuktastvajapālena jvaro rājañjagāma ha .. 24 ..
4.71.d:
गच्छ लंकाधिपस्थानमाचरस्व यथोचितम् ॥
नियुक्तस्त्वजपालेन ज्वरो राजञ्जगाम ह ॥ 24 ॥
4.71.m:
"Go to the dwelling of the lord of Laṅkā [and] act as is proper."
Thus directed by Ajapāla, O king, the Fever indeed departed. 24

4.71.s:
gatvā ca kaṃpayāmāsa sagaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram ..
rāvaṇastaṃ viditvā tu jvaraṃ paramadāruṇam .. 25 ..
4.71.d:
गत्वा च कंपयामास सगणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ॥
रावणस्तं विदित्वा तु ज्वरं परमदारुणम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.71.m:
Having arrived, he caused the lord of the rākṣasas along with his retinue to tremble.
Recognizing that [to be] an exceedingly terrible fever, Rāvaṇa 25

4.71.s:
provāca tiṣṭhatu nṛpastena me na prayojanam ..
tataḥ savijvaro rājā babhūva dhanadānujaḥ .. 26 ..
4.71.d:
प्रोवाच तिष्ठतु नृपस्तेन मे न प्रयोजनम् ॥
ततः सविज्वरो राजा बभूव धनदानुजः ॥ 26 ॥
4.71.m:
said, "Let the king remain [there]; I have no business with him."
Then the king, the younger brother of Dhanada, became free from fever. 26

4.71.s:
tenaiṣā nirmitā śāṃtirajapālena dhīmatā ..
sarvarogapraśamanī sarvopadravanāśinī .. 27 ..
4.71.d:
तेनैषा निर्मिता शांतिरजपालेन धीमता ॥
सर्वरोगप्रशमनी सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनी ॥ 27 ॥
4.71.m:
By that wise Ajapāla was this pacification rite devised,
which allays all diseases and destroys all afflictions. 27

4.71.s:
kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe ..
samutthite vinidre tu deve dāmodare tadā .. 28 ..
4.71.d:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य द्वादश्यां रजनीमुखे ॥
समुत्थिते विनिद्रे तु देवे दामोदरे तदा ॥ 28 ॥
4.71.m:
On the twelfth [lunar day] of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, at nightfall,
when the god Dāmodara has arisen and is awake, then, 28

4.71.s:
vedyaṃte ratnamālābhī ramye mālānuraṃjite ..
janayitvā navaṃ viṣṇuṃ hutvā maṃtrairdvijottamaiḥ .. 29 ..
4.71.d:
वेद्यंते रत्नमालाभी रम्ये मालानुरंजिते ॥
जनयित्वा नवं विष्णुं हुत्वा मंत्रैर्द्विजोत्तमैः ॥ 29 ॥
4.71.m:
at the edge of the sacrificial altar [adorned] with strings of jewels, lovely and embellished with garlands,
having brought forth the new [image of] Viṣṇu and offered oblations with mantras by the best of Brahmins, 29

4.71.s:
varddhamānatarūtthābhirdīpikābhirhutāśanam ..
kṛtvā mahājanaḥ sarvairhariṃ nīrājayecchanaiḥ .. 4.71.30 ..
4.71.d:
वर्द्धमानतरूत्थाभिर्दीपिकाभिर्हुताशनम् ॥
कृत्वा महाजनः सर्वैर्हरिं नीराजयेच्छनैः ॥ 4.71.30 ॥
4.71.m:
and having made a fire with lamps arising from the castor-oil plant,
the great assembly of all [the people] should gently wave lights before Hari. 30

4.71.s:
puṣpairabhyarcitaṃ devaṃ samālabdhaṃ ca candanaiḥ ..
badaraiḥ karburaiścaiva trapusairikṣubhistathā .. 31 ..
4.71.d:
पुष्पैरभ्यर्चितं देवं समालब्धं च चन्दनैः ॥
बदरैः कर्बुरैश्चैव त्रपुसैरिक्षुभिस्तथा ॥ 31 ॥
4.71.m:
Before the god who is worshipped with flowers and anointed with sandalpastes,
and [offered] jujube fruits, striped cucumbers, cucumbers, and sugarcanes, 31

4.71.s:
gandhaiḥ puṣpairaṃlakārairvastrai ratnaiśca pūjitaiḥ ..
tasyaivānumatā lakṣmīṃ brahmāṇaṃ caṃḍikāṃ tathā.. 32 ..
4.71.d:
गन्धैः पुष्पैरंलकारैर्वस्त्रै रत्नैश्च पूजितैः ॥
तस्यैवानुमता लक्ष्मीं ब्रह्माणं चंडिकां तथा॥ 32 ॥
4.71.m:
worshipped with perfumes, flowers, ornaments, garments, and gems,
[as well as before] Lakṣmī, Brahmā, and Caṇḍikā approved by him, 32

4.71.s:
ādityaṃ śaṃkaraṃ gaurīṃ yakṣaṃ gaṇapatiṃ grahān ..
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ nāgānsarvānnīrājayettataḥ .. 33 ..
4.71.d:
आदित्यं शंकरं गौरीं यक्षं गणपतिं ग्रहान् ॥
मातरं पितरं नागान्सर्वान्नीराजयेत्ततः ॥ 33 ॥
4.71.m:
Āditya, Śaṅkara, Gaurī, the yakṣa, Gaṇapati, the planets,
the mother, the father, and the nāgas—before all of them one should then wave lights. 33

4.71.s:
gavāṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryānmahiṣyādeśca maṃḍalam ..
bhrāmayettrāsayecchardighaṃṭāvādanachādanaiḥ .. 34 ..
4.71.d:
गवां नीराजनं कुर्यान्महिष्यादेश्च मंडलम् ॥
भ्रामयेत्त्रासयेच्छर्दिघंटावादनछादनैः ॥ 34 ॥
4.71.m:
One should perform the waving of lights for the cows, and cause the herd of female buffaloes and other [animals]
to circle around, and frighten them with shoutings, the ringing of bells, and umbrellas. 34

4.71.s:
tā gāvaḥ prasutā yāṃti svāpīḍāstabakāṃgadāḥ ..
sindūrakṛtaśṛṃgāgrāḥ saṃbhāravaśavatsakāḥ .. 35 ..
4.71.d:
ता गावः प्रसुता यांति स्वापीडास्तबकांगदाः ॥
सिन्दूरकृतशृंगाग्राः संभारवशवत्सकाः ॥ 35 ॥
4.71.m:
Those cows go forth rushing, adorned with chaplets, clusters [of flowers], and bracelets,
the tips of their horns daubed with vermilion, their calves subdued by abundance. 35

4.71.s:
anuyāṃti sagopālāḥ kālayaṃto dhanāni te ..
chedānuliptaraktāṅgā raktapītasitāṃbarāḥ .. 36 ..
4.71.d:
अनुयांति सगोपालाः कालयंतो धनानि ते ॥
छेदानुलिप्तरक्ताङ्गा रक्तपीतसितांबराः ॥ 36 ॥
4.71.m:
Accompanied by cowherds, they follow, driving those herds—
their limbs smeared with red from cuts, clad in red, yellow, and white garments. 36

4.71.s:
evaṃ kolāhale vṛtte gavāṃ nīrājanotsave ..
turagām̐llakṣaṇairyuktāndviradāṃśca supūjitān .. 37 ..
4.71.d:
एवं कोलाहले वृत्ते गवां नीराजनोत्सवे ॥
तुरगाम्̐ल्लक्षणैर्युक्तान्द्विरदांश्च सुपूजितान् ॥ 37 ॥
4.71.m:
While such a tumult is taking place during the festival of waving lights before the cows,
[the king should take] horses endowed with auspicious marks and well-worshipped elephants, 37

4.71.s:
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi uddhṛtya svagṛhāṃgaṇe ..
rājā purohitaiḥ sārddhaṃ maṃtribhṛtyapuraḥsaraḥ .. 38 ..
4.71.d:
राजचिह्नानि सर्वाणि उद्धृत्य स्वगृहांगणे ॥
राजा पुरोहितैः सार्द्धं मंत्रिभृत्यपुरःसरः ॥ 38 ॥
4.71.m:
and raising all the insignia of royalty in the courtyard of his own palace,
the king, together with the family priests, preceded by ministers and servants, 38

4.71.s:
siṃhāsanopaviṣṭaśca śaṃkhatūryādinisvanaiḥ ..
pūjayedgandhakusumairvastradīpavilepanaiḥ .. 39 ..
4.71.d:
सिंहासनोपविष्टश्च शंखतूर्यादिनिस्वनैः ॥
पूजयेद्गन्धकुसुमैर्वस्त्रदीपविलेपनैः ॥ 39 ॥
4.71.m:
seated upon the throne to the sounds of conches, musical instruments, and the like,
should worship with perfumes, flowers, garments, lamps, and ointments. 39

4.71.s:
tataḥ strīlakṣaṇairyuktā veśyā vātha kulāṅganā ..
śīrṣopari narendrasya bhrābhayeddārupātrikām .. 4.71.40 ..
4.71.d:
ततः स्त्रीलक्षणैर्युक्ता वेश्या वाथ कुलाङ्गना ॥
शीर्षोपरि नरेन्द्रस्य भ्राभयेद्दारुपात्रिकाम् ॥ 4.71.40 ॥
4.71.m:
Then a courtesan endowed with the auspicious marks of women, or a woman of good family,
should wave a wooden vessel over the head of the ruler of men. 40

4.71.s:
śāṃtirastu samṛddhiśca dvijaiśca svajanena ca ..
tato nīrājayetsaumyaṃ hastyaśvarathasaṃkulam .. 41 ..
4.71.d:
शांतिरस्तु समृद्धिश्च द्विजैश्च स्वजनेन च ॥
ततो नीराजयेत्सौम्यं हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुलम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.71.m:
[Saying,] "May there be peace and prosperity!" with Brahmins and with his own kin,
he should then wave lights before the gentle [throng] crowded with elephants, horses, and chariots. 41

4.71.s:
evameṣā mahāśāṃtiḥ khyātā nīrājane jane ..
yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pure grāme kriyate pāṃḍunandana .. 42 ..
4.71.d:
एवमेषा महाशांतिः ख्याता नीराजने जने ॥
येषां राष्ट्रे पुरे ग्रामे क्रियते पांडुनन्दन ॥ 42 ॥
4.71.m:
In this way, this Great Pacification rite is celebrated among the people as the waving of lights.
In whichever realm, city, or village it is performed, O son of Pāṇḍu, 42

4.71.s:
teṣāṃ rogāḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti subhikṣaṃ varddhate tadā ..
śāṃtinīrājanālloke sarvānrogānvyapohati .. 43 ..
4.71.d:
तेषां रोगाः क्षयं यांति सुभिक्षं वर्द्धते तदा ॥
शांतिनीराजनाल्लोके सर्वान्रोगान्व्यपोहति ॥ 43 ॥
4.71.m:
their diseases come to an end, and abundance of food increases then.
By the pacifying waving of lights, one removes all diseases in the world. 43

4.71.s:
lokānāvarddhayitvā tu ajapālavaro yathā ..
eṣāṃ rogādipīḍāsu jaṃtūnāṃ hitamicchatā .. 44 ..
4.71.d:
लोकानावर्द्धयित्वा तु अजपालवरो यथा ॥
एषां रोगादिपीडासु जंतूनां हितमिच्छता ॥ 44 ॥
4.71.m:
Having caused the worlds to prosper, just as the excellent Ajapāla did,
by one who desires the welfare of these creatures in afflictions such as disease, 44

4.71.s: varṣevarṣe prayoktavyā śāṃtirnīrājanā iti .. 45 ..
4.71.d: वर्षेवर्षे प्रयोक्तव्या शांतिर्नीराजना इति ॥ 45 ॥
4.71.m: the pacification rite called the waving of lights should be performed year after year. 45

4.71.s:
nīrājayaṃti navameghanibhaṃ hariṃ ye gobrāhmaṇānrathagajāṃśca nareśacihnān..
te sarvarogarahitāśca nutā narendrairiṃdraprabhā bhuvi bhavaṃtyajapālavākyāt .. 46 ..
bhīṣmapañcakavratavarṇanam
4.71.d:
नीराजयंति नवमेघनिभं हरिं ये गोब्राह्मणान्रथगजांश्च नरेशचिह्नान्॥
ते सर्वरोगरहिताश्च नुता नरेन्द्रैरिंद्रप्रभा भुवि भवंत्यजपालवाक्यात् ॥ 46 ॥
भीष्मपञ्चकव्रतवर्णनम्
4.71.m:
Those who wave lights before Hari, who resembles a fresh cloud, before cows and Brahmins, and before chariots, elephants, and the insignia of kings—
they become free from all diseases, praised by kings, and radiant as Indra on earth, according to the word of Ajapāla. 46
Description of the Votive Observance of the Bhīṣmapañcaka

4.72.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yadetadatulaṃ puṇyaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
kartavyaṃ kārttike māsi prayatnādbhīṣmapañcakam .. 1 ..
4.72.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यदेतदतुलं पुण्यं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥
कर्तव्यं कार्त्तिके मासि प्रयत्नाद्भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.72.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
"This incomparable merit, the supreme votive observance among votive observances,
the Bhīṣmapañcaka, is to be performed with diligence in the month of Kārttika. 1

4.72.s:
vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasya phalaṃ ca yadusattama ..
kathayasva prasādānme munīnāṃ hitamicchatām .. 2 ..
4.72.d:
विधानं कीदृशं तस्य फलं च यदुसत्तम ॥
कथयस्व प्रसादान्मे मुनीनां हितमिच्छताम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.72.m:
What is its procedure, and what is its fruit, O best of the Yadus?
Tell [it] out of grace to me and to the sages desiring welfare. 2

4.72.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ puṇyaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
yathāvidhi ca kartavyaṃ phalaṃ cāsya yathoditam .. 3 ..
4.72.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रवक्ष्यामि व्रतं पुण्यं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥
यथाविधि च कर्तव्यं फलं चास्य यथोदितम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.72.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
"I shall proclaim the meritorious votive observance, the supreme votive observance among votive observances,
how it is to be performed according to rule, and its fruit as declared. 3

4.72.s:
mayāpi bhṛgave proktaṃ bhṛguścośanase dadau ..
uśanāpi hi viprebhyaḥ prahlādāya ca dhīmate .. 4 ..
4.72.d:
मयापि भृगवे प्रोक्तं भृगुश्चोशनसे ददौ ॥
उशनापि हि विप्रेभ्यः प्रह्लादाय च धीमते ॥ 4 ॥
4.72.m:
It was spoken by me to Bhṛgu, and Bhṛgu gave it to Uśanas;
Uśanas gave it to the Brahmins and to the wise Prahlāda. 4

4.72.s:
tejasvināṃ yathā vahniḥ pavanaḥ śīghragāminām ..
vipro yathā ca pūjyānāṃ dānānāṃ kāñcanaṃ yathā .. 5 ..
4.72.d:
तेजस्विनां यथा वह्निः पवनः शीघ्रगामिनाम् ॥
विप्रो यथा च पूज्यानां दानानां काञ्चनं यथा ॥ 5 ॥
4.72.m:
As fire is [supreme] among luminous things, and the wind among swift-goers,
as a Brahmin is among the venerable, and gold among gifts, 5

4.72.s:
bhūlokaḥ sarvalokānāṃ tīrthānāṃ jāhnavī yathā ..
yathāśvamedho yajñānāṃ mathurā muktikāṃkṣiṇām.. 6 ..
4.72.d:
भूलोकः सर्वलोकानां तीर्थानां जाह्नवी यथा ॥
यथाश्वमेधो यज्ञानां मथुरा मुक्तिकांक्षिणाम्॥ 6 ॥
4.72.m:
as the realm of the earth is among all worlds, and the Jāhnavī among sacred places,
as the horse sacrifice is among sacrifices, and Mathurā for those desiring liberation, 6

4.72.s:
vedo yathaiva śāstrāṇāṃ devānāmacyuto yathā ..
tathā sarvavratānāṃ tu varoktaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam .. 7 ..
4.72.d:
वेदो यथैव शास्त्राणां देवानामच्युतो यथा ॥
तथा सर्वव्रतानां तु वरोक्तं भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.72.m:
just as the Veda is [supreme] among scriptures, and Acyuta among gods,
so among all votive observances the Bhīṣmapañcaka is proclaimed the best. 7

4.72.s:
duṣkaraṃ bhīṣmamityāhurna śakyaṃ tadihocyate ..
yastatkaroti rājendra tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
4.72.d:
दुष्करं भीष्ममित्याहुर्न शक्यं तदिहोच्यते ॥
यस्तत्करोति राजेन्द्र तेन सर्वं कृतं भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.72.m:
They call it 'Bhīṣma' [formidable] because it is difficult to perform; that it is impossible is said here.
Whoever performs it, O lord of kings, by him everything has been accomplished. 8

4.72.s:
vaśiṣṭhabhṛgubhargādyaiścīrṇaṃ kṛtayugādiṣu ..
nābhāgāṃgāṃbarīṣādyaiścīrṇaṃ tretāyugādiṣu .. 9 ..
4.72.d:
वशिष्ठभृगुभर्गाद्यैश्चीर्णं कृतयुगादिषु ॥
नाभागांगांबरीषाद्यैश्चीर्णं त्रेतायुगादिषु ॥ 9 ॥
4.72.m:
It was observed by Vasiṣṭha, Bhṛgu, Bharga, and others in the Kṛta Yuga and other [ages];
it was observed by Nābhāga, Aṅga, Ambarīṣa, and others in the Tretā Yuga and other [ages]. 9

4.72.s:
sīrabhadrādibhirvaiśyaiḥ śūdrairanyaiḥ kalau yuge ..
dināni paṃca pūjyāni cīrṇametanmahāvratam .. 4.72.10 ..
4.72.d:
सीरभद्रादिभिर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैरन्यैः कलौ युगे ॥
दिनानि पंच पूज्यानि चीर्णमेतन्महाव्रतम् ॥ 4.72.10 ॥
4.72.m:
By Sīrabhadra and other vaiśyas, and by other śūdras in the Kali Yuga,
this great votive observance has been observed for five days worthy of worship. 10

4.72.s:
brāhmaṇairbrahmacaryeṇa japahomakriyādibhiḥ ..
kṣatriyaiśca tathā śaktyā śaucavrataparāyaṇaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.72.d:
ब्राह्मणैर्ब्रह्मचर्येण जपहोमक्रियादिभिः ॥
क्षत्रियैश्च तथा शक्त्या शौचव्रतपरायणैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.72.m: By Brahmins with celibacy, through acts of recitation, fire offerings, and the like; / and by Kṣatriyas according to their ability, devoted to purity and the votive observance;

4.72.s:
parādhiḥ parihartavyo brahmacaryeṇa niṣṭhayā ..
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ parityajya maithunaṃ pāpabhāṣaṇam .. 12 ..
4.72.d:
पराधिः परिहर्तव्यो ब्रह्मचर्येण निष्ठया ॥
मद्यं मांसं परित्यज्य मैथुनं पापभाषणम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.72.m: mental anguish caused by others must be avoided, through celibacy and steadfastness, / abandoning liquor, meat, sexual intercourse, and sinful speech;

4.72.s:
śākāhāraparaiścaiva kṛṣṇārcanaparairnaraiḥ ..
strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena kartavyaṃ sukhavarddhanam .. 13 ..
4.72.d:
शाकाहारपरैश्चैव कृष्णार्चनपरैर्नरैः ॥
स्त्रीभिर्वा भर्तृवाक्येन कर्तव्यं सुखवर्द्धनम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.72.m: and by men devoted to eating vegetables and devoted to worshipping Kṛṣṇa; / or by women, at the instruction of their husbands, it should be observed to increase happiness.

4.72.s:
vidhavābhiśca kartavyaṃ putrapautrādibruddhaye ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ mokṣārthamapi pāṃḍava .. 14 ..
4.72.d:
विधवाभिश्च कर्तव्यं पुत्रपौत्रादिब्रुद्धये ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं मोक्षार्थमपि पांडव ॥ 14 ॥
4.72.m: And it should be observed by widows for the increase of sons, grandsons, and descendants, / for the fulfillment of all desires, and also for liberation, O Pāṇḍava.

4.72.s:
nityaṃ snānena dānena kārttikī yāvadeva tu ..
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena madhyāhne ca tathā vratī .. 15 ..
4.72.d:
नित्यं स्नानेन दानेन कार्त्तिकी यावदेव तु ॥
प्रातः स्नात्वा विधानेन मध्याह्ने च तथा व्रती ॥ 15 ॥
4.72.m: Always with bathing and giving gifts right up until the Kārttikī day; / having bathed at dawn according to the rules, and likewise at midday, the observer of the votive observance,

4.72.s:
nadya nirjharagarte vā samālabhya ca gomayam ..
yavavrīhitilaiḥ samyaktarpayecca prayatnataḥ .. 16 ..
4.72.d:
नद्य निर्झरगर्ते वा समालभ्य च गोमयम् ॥
यवव्रीहितिलैः सम्यक्तर्पयेच्च प्रयत्नतः ॥ 16 ॥
4.72.m: in a river or a mountain torrent's hollow, having smeared cow dung, / should carefully and properly offer libations with barley, rice, and sesame seeds,

4.72.s:
devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva tatonyānkāmacāriṇaḥ ..
snānaṃ maunaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā dhautavāsā dṛḍhavrataḥ .. 17 ..
4.72.d:
देवानृषीन्पितॄंश्चैव ततोन्यान्कामचारिणः ॥
स्नानं मौनं नरः कृत्वा धौतवासा दृढव्रतः ॥ 17 ॥
4.72.m: to the gods, the ṛṣis, and the ancestors, and after that to the other beings who roam at will. / Having bathed and observed silence, wearing washed clothes, firm in his votive observance,

4.72.s:
tato'nupūjayeddevaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim ..
snāpayeccācyutaṃ bhaktyā madhukṣīraghṛtena ca .. 18 ..
4.72.d:
ततोऽनुपूजयेद्देवं सर्वपापहरं हरिम् ॥
स्नापयेच्चाच्युतं भक्त्या मधुक्षीरघृतेन च ॥ 18 ॥
4.72.m: he should then worship the god Hari, who takes away all sins. / And he should bathe Acyuta with devotion, using honey, milk, and clarified butter,

4.72.s:
tatraiva pañcagavyena gaṃdhacaṃdanavāriṇā ..
candanena sugaṃdhena kuṃkumenātha keśavam .. 19 ..
4.72.d:
तत्रैव पञ्चगव्येन गंधचंदनवारिणा ॥
चन्दनेन सुगंधेन कुंकुमेनाथ केशवम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.72.m: and right there with the five products of the cow, and with perfumed sandalwood water; / then [he should smear] Keśava with fragrant sandalwood and saffron,

4.72.s:
karpūrośīra miśreṇa lepayedgaruḍadhvajam ..
arcayedruciraiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhadhūpasamanvitaiḥ .. 4.72.20 ..
4.72.d:
कर्पूरोशीर मिश्रेण लेपयेद्गरुडध्वजम् ॥
अर्चयेद्रुचिरैः पुष्पैर्गंधधूपसमन्वितैः ॥ 4.72.20 ॥
4.72.m: and smear him whose banner is Garuḍa with [paste] mixed with camphor and uśīra. / He should worship him with lovely flowers accompanied by perfume and incense.

4.72.s:
gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dahetkṛṣṇāya bhaktitaḥ ..
dīpakaṃ ca divā rātrau dadyātpaṃcadināni tu .. 21 ..
4.72.d:
गुग्गुलुं घृतसंयुक्तं दहेत्कृष्णाय भक्तितः ॥
दीपकं च दिवा रात्रौ दद्यात्पंचदिनानि तु ॥ 21 ॥
4.72.m: He should burn guggulu combined with clarified butter for Kṛṣṇa with devotion, / and he should present a lamp day and night for five days.

4.72.s:
naivedyaṃ devadevasya paramānnaṃ nivedayet ..
oṃ namo vāsudevāyeti japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam .. 22 ..
4.72.d:
नैवेद्यं देवदेवस्य परमान्नं निवेदयेत् ॥
ओं नमो वासुदेवायेति जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.72.m: As a food offering to the god of gods, he should offer supreme rice milk. / He should recite 'Oṃ namo vāsudevāya' one hundred and eight times.

4.72.s:
juhuyācca ghṛtāktāṃśca tilavrīhīṃstato vratī ..
ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa svāhākārānvitena ca .. 23 ..
4.72.d:
जुहुयाच्च घृताक्तांश्च तिलव्रीहींस्ततो व्रती ॥
षडक्षरेण मंत्रेण स्वाहाकारान्वितेन च ॥ 23 ॥
4.72.m: Then the observer of the votive observance should offer sesame and rice anointed with clarified butter into the fire, / with the six-syllable mantra accompanied by the utterance 'svāhā'.

4.72.s:
upāsya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam ..
japitvā pūrvavanmaṃtraṃ kṣitiśāyī bhavennaraḥ .. 24 ..
4.72.d:
उपास्य पश्चिमां संध्यां प्रणम्य गरुडध्वजम् ॥
जपित्वा पूर्ववन्मंत्रं क्षितिशायी भवेन्नरः ॥ 24 ॥
4.72.m: Having attended to the evening twilight devotion and bowed to him whose banner is Garuḍa, / having recited the mantra as before, a person should sleep on the bare ground.

4.72.s:
sarvametadvidhānaṃ ca kāryaṃ paṃcadineṣu hi ..
saṃviśetkaṃbale cāsminpadapūrvaṃ śṛṇuṣva me .. 25 ..
4.72.d:
सर्वमेतद्विधानं च कार्यं पंचदिनेषु हि ॥
संविशेत्कंबले चास्मिन्पदपूर्वं शृणुष्व मे ॥ 25 ॥
4.72.m: All this procedure is to be performed during the five days. / And on this blanket he should lie down; listen to me regarding the sequence of limbs:

4.72.s:
prathame'hni hareḥ pādau pūjayetkamalairnaraḥ ..
dvitīye bilvapatreṇa jānudeśaṃ samarcayet .. 26 ..
4.72.d:
प्रथमेऽह्नि हरेः पादौ पूजयेत्कमलैर्नरः ॥
द्वितीये बिल्वपत्रेण जानुदेशं समर्चयेत् ॥ 26 ॥
4.72.m: On the first day, a man should worship the feet of Hari with lotuses. / On the second, he should worship the region of the knees with a bilva leaf.

4.72.s:
pūjayecca tṛtīye'hni nābhiṃ bhṛṅgarasena ca ..
madhye bilvajayābhiśca tataḥ skaṃdhau prapūjayet .. 27 ..
4.72.d:
पूजयेच्च तृतीयेऽह्नि नाभिं भृङ्गरसेन च ॥
मध्ये बिल्वजयाभिश्च ततः स्कंधौ प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.72.m: And on the third day, he should worship the navel with the juice of bhṛṅga; / and then, in the middle, he should worship the shoulders with bilva and jayā.

4.72.s:
tato'nupūjayecchīrṣaṃ mālatyāḥ kusumairnavaiḥ ..
kārttikyāṃ devadevasya bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ .. 28 ..
4.72.d:
ततोऽनुपूजयेच्छीर्षं मालत्याः कुसुमैर्नवैः ॥
कार्त्तिक्यां देवदेवस्य भक्त्या तद्गतमानसः ॥ 28 ॥
4.72.m: After that, he should worship the head of the god of gods with fresh mālatī flowers / on the Kārttikī day with devotion, his mind fixed upon him.

4.72.s:
arcayitvā hṛṣīkeśamekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
saṃprāśya gomayaṃ samyaṅ maṃtravatsamupāvaset .. 29 ..
4.72.d:
अर्चयित्वा हृषीकेशमेकादश्यां समाहितः ॥
संप्राश्य गोमयं सम्यङ् मंत्रवत्समुपावसेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.72.m: Having worshipped Hṛṣīkeśa on the eleventh day with composed mind, / and having properly consumed cow dung with mantras, he should fast.

4.72.s:
gomūtraṃ maṃtravatkṛtvā dvādaśyāṃ prāśayedvratī ..
kṣīraṃ tatra trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathā dadhi .. 4.72.30 ..
4.72.d:
गोमूत्रं मंत्रवत्कृत्वा द्वादश्यां प्राशयेद्व्रती ॥
क्षीरं तत्र त्रयोदश्यां चतुर्दश्यां तथा दधि ॥ 4.72.30 ॥
4.72.m: Having consecrated cow urine with mantras, the observer of the votive observance should consume it on the twelfth day; / milk on the thirteenth, and curd likewise on the fourteenth.

4.72.s:
saṃprāśya kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ laṃghayeta caturdinam ..
paṃcame tu dine snātvā vidhivatpūjya keśavam .. 31 ..
4.72.d:
संप्राश्य कायशुद्ध्यर्थं लंघयेत चतुर्दिनम् ॥
पंचमे तु दिने स्नात्वा विधिवत्पूज्य केशवम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.72.m: Having consumed these for the purification of the body, he should fast for four days. / But on the fifth day, having bathed and properly worshipped Keśava,

4.72.s:
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām ..
tathopadeṣṭāramapi pūjayedvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 32 ..
4.72.d:
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या तेभ्यो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
तथोपदेष्टारमपि पूजयेद्वस्त्रभूषणैः ॥ 32 ॥
4.72.m: he should feed Brahmins with devotion and give them a priestly gift; / likewise he should worship the preceptor as well with garments and ornaments.

4.72.s:
tato naktaṃ samaśnīyātpañcagavyapuraḥsaram ..
evaṃ samāpayetsamyagyathoktaṃ vratamuttamam .. 33 ..
4.72.d:
ततो नक्तं समश्नीयात्पञ्चगव्यपुरःसरम् ॥
एवं समापयेत्सम्यग्यथोक्तं व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.72.m: Then he should eat a nocturnal meal preceded by the five products of the cow. / In this manner he should properly conclude the excellent votive observance as described,

4.72.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ prakhyātaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ..
madyapo yastyajenmadyaṃ janmano maraṇāṃtikam .. 34 ..
4.72.d:
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं प्रख्यातं भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥
मद्यपो यस्त्यजेन्मद्यं जन्मनो मरणांतिकम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.72.m: which removes all sins, is meritorious, and is renowned as the Bhīṣmapañcaka. / If a drinker of liquor abandons liquor from birth until the end of life,

4.72.s:
tadbhīṣmapañcakaṃ tyaktvā prāpnotbhyayadhikaṃ phalam ..
brahmacaryaṃ naraścīrtvā sughoraṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ vratam ..35..
4.72.d:
तद्भीष्मपञ्चकं त्यक्त्वा प्राप्नोत्भ्ययधिकं फलम् ॥
ब्रह्मचर्यं नरश्चीर्त्वा सुघोरं नैष्ठिकं व्रतम् ॥35॥
4.72.m: he obtains even greater fruit by observing this Bhīṣmapañcaka. / A man having observed celibacy, a very severe, lifelong votive observance,

4.72.s:
yatprāpnoti mahatpuṇyaṃ tatkṛtvā bhīṣmapaṃcakam ..
gātrā bhyaṃgaṃ śiro'bhyaṃgaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca maithunam .. 36 ..
4.72.d:
यत्प्राप्नोति महत्पुण्यं तत्कृत्वा भीष्मपंचकम् ॥
गात्रा भ्यंगं शिरोऽभ्यंगं मधु मांसं च मैथुनम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.72.m: the great merit that he obtains, he obtains that having performed the Bhīṣmapañcaka. / [Renouncing] anointing the body, anointing the head, honey, meat, and sexual intercourse,

4.72.s:
brahmalokamavāpnoti tyaktvaikaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ..
saṃvatsareṇa yatpuṇyaṃ kārttikena ca yadbhavet ..37..
4.72.d:
ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति त्यक्त्वैकं भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥
संवत्सरेण यत्पुण्यं कार्त्तिकेन च यद्भवेत् ॥37॥
4.72.m: he attains the world of Brahmā by observing this single Bhīṣmapañcaka. / Whatever merit [is gained] through a whole year, and whatever arises through the month of Kārttika,

4.72.s:
yatphalaṃ kārttikenoktaṃ bhavettadbhīṣmapañcake ..
vratametatsuraiḥ siddhaiḥ kinnarairnāgaguhyakaiḥ ..38..
4.72.d:
यत्फलं कार्त्तिकेनोक्तं भवेत्तद्भीष्मपञ्चके ॥
व्रतमेतत्सुरैः सिद्धैः किन्नरैर्नागगुह्यकैः ॥38॥
4.72.m: whatever fruit is declared from Kārttika, that is gained in the Bhīṣmapañcaka. / This votive observance [was observed] by gods, siddhas, kinnaras, nāgas, and guhyakas.

4.72.s:
phalaṃ samīhitaṃ prāpya kṛtvābhyarcya janārdanam ..
pāpasya pratimā kāryā raudravaktrātibhīṣaṇā .. 39 ..
4.72.d:
फलं समीहितं प्राप्य कृत्वाभ्यर्च्य जनार्दनम् ॥
पापस्य प्रतिमा कार्या रौद्रवक्त्रातिभीषणा ॥ 39 ॥
4.72.m: Having obtained the desired fruit after performing it and worshipping Janārdana, / an effigy of sin should be made, with a terrible face and extremely dreadful,

4.72.s:
khaḍgahastātivikṛtā sarvalokamayī nṛpa ..
tilaprasthopari sthāpyā kṛṣṇavastrābhiveṣṭitā .. 4.72.40 ...
4.72.d:
खड्गहस्तातिविकृता सर्वलोकमयी नृप ॥
तिलप्रस्थोपरि स्थाप्या कृष्णवस्त्राभिवेष्टिता ॥ 4.72.40 ॥।
4.72.m: holding a sword in hand, utterly deformed, embodying all the worlds, O king. / It should be placed upon a prastha measure of sesame, wrapped in black cloth,

4.72.s:
karavīrakusumāpīḍā calatkāñcanakuṃḍalā ..
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 41 ..
4.72.d:
करवीरकुसुमापीडा चलत्काञ्चनकुंडला ॥
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्या कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 41 ॥
4.72.m: wearing a garland of oleander flowers, with trembling gold earrings. / It should be given to a Brahmin with the words: 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.'

4.72.s:
anyeṣāmapi dātavyaṃ yatkṛtvā vasu vāṃchitam ..
kṛtakṛtyaḥ sthiro bhūtvā viraktaḥ saṃyato bhavet .. 42 ..
4.72.d:
अन्येषामपि दातव्यं यत्कृत्वा वसु वांछितम् ॥
कृतकृत्यः स्थिरो भूत्वा विरक्तः संयतो भवेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.72.m: Having performed it, whatever desired wealth is there should also be given to others. / Having accomplished his purpose, becoming steady, detached, and self-restrained,

4.72.s:
śāṃtacetā nirābādhaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt ..
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ .. 43 ..'
4.72.d:
शांतचेता निराबाधः परं पदमवाप्नुयात् ॥
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामश्चतुर्दंष्ट्रश्चतुर्भुजः ॥ 43 ॥'
4.72.m: with a tranquil mind and free from affliction, he attains the supreme state. / Dark as the petal of a blue lotus, four-fanged, four-armed,

4.72.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭhaikanayanaḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahāsvanaḥ..
jaṭī dvijihvastāmasyo mṛgarājatanucchadaḥ .. 44 ..
4.72.d:
अष्टषष्ठैकनयनः शंकुकर्णो महास्वनः॥
जटी द्विजिह्वस्तामस्यो मृगराजतनुच्छदः ॥ 44 ॥
4.72.m: having sixty-eight and one eyes, peg-eared, of great roar, / matted-haired, two-tongued, of dark essence, clad in a lion's skin,

4.72.s:
ciṃtanīyo mahādevo yasya rūpaṃ na vidyate ..
idaṃ bhīṣmeṇa kathitaṃ śaratalpagatena me .. 45 ..
4.72.d:
चिंतनीयो महादेवो यस्य रूपं न विद्यते ॥
इदं भीष्मेण कथितं शरतल्पगतेन मे ॥ 45 ॥
4.72.m: the Great God is to be meditated upon, he whose form does not exist. / This was told to me by Bhīṣma while lying on the bed of arrows;

4.72.s:
tadeva te samākhyātaṃ duṣkaraṃ bhīṣmapaṃcakam ..
vrataṃ ca rājaśārdūla pravaraṃ bhīṣmapañcakam .. 46 ..
4.72.d:
तदेव ते समाख्यातं दुष्करं भीष्मपंचकम् ॥
व्रतं च राजशार्दूल प्रवरं भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.72.m: that very Bhīṣmapañcaka, difficult to perform, has been fully described to you, / a supreme votive observance, O tiger among kings: the Bhīṣmapañcaka.

4.72.s:
yastasmiṃstoṣayedbhaktyā tasmai muktiprado'cyutaḥ ..
brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho'thavā yatiḥ .. 47 ..
4.72.d:
यस्तस्मिंस्तोषयेद्भक्त्या तस्मै मुक्तिप्रदोऽच्युतः ॥
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थो वा वानप्रस्थोऽथवा यतिः ॥ 47 ॥
4.72.m: Acyuta grants liberation to him who pleases him during it with devotion. / A celibate student, a householder, a forest hermit, or an ascetic,

4.72.s:
prāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ satkṛtvā bhīṣmapañcakam ..
brahmahā madyapaḥ steyī gurugāmī sadākṛtī .. 48 ..
4.72.d:
प्राप्नोति वैष्णवं स्थानं सत्कृत्वा भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥
ब्रह्महा मद्यपः स्तेयी गुरुगामी सदाकृती ॥ 48 ॥
4.72.m: attains the abode of Viṣṇu having duly observed the Bhīṣmapañcaka. / A slayer of a Brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, a violator of the guru's bed, an habitual wrongdoer,

4.72.s:
mucyate pātakātsamyakkṛtvaikaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ..
nāsmādvratātpuṇyatamaṃ vaiṣṇavebhyo yato vratam .. 49 ..
4.72.d:
मुच्यते पातकात्सम्यक्कृत्वैकं भीष्मपञ्चकम् ॥
नास्माद्व्रतात्पुण्यतमं वैष्णवेभ्यो यतो व्रतम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.72.m: is completely freed from sin having performed this single Bhīṣmapañcaka; / for to Vaiṣṇavas there is no votive observance more meritorious than this votive observance.

4.72.s:
athāsmiṃstoṣito viṣṇurnṛṇāṃ muktiprado bhavet ..
śrutvaitatpaṭhyamānaṃ tu pavitraṃ bhīṣmapaṃcakam .. 4.72.50 ..
4.72.d:
अथास्मिंस्तोषितो विष्णुर्नृणां मुक्तिप्रदो भवेत् ॥
श्रुत्वैतत्पठ्यमानं तु पवित्रं भीष्मपंचकम् ॥ 4.72.50 ॥
4.72.m: Moreover, when pleased in this, Viṣṇu becomes the giver of liberation to men. / Having heard this holy Bhīṣmapañcaka being recited,

4.72.s:
mucyate pātakebhyo vā pāṭhako viṣṇulokabhāk ..
dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ yudhiṣṭhira mahāvratam .. 51 ..
4.72.d:
मुच्यते पातकेभ्यो वा पाठको विष्णुलोकभाक् ॥
धन्यं पुण्यं पापहरं युधिष्ठिर महाव्रतम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.72.m: he is freed from sins, or the reciter shares in the world of Viṣṇu. / Auspicious, meritorious, and sin-removing, O Yudhiṣṭhira, is this great votive observance,

4.72.s:
yadbhīṣmapañcakamiti prathitaṃ pṛthivyāmekādaśīprabhṛtipañcadaśīniruddham ..
annasya bhojananivṛttivaśādamuṣminniṣṭaṃ phalaṃ diśati pāṃḍava śārṅgadhanvā .. 52 ..
malladvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.72.d:
यद्भीष्मपञ्चकमिति प्रथितं पृथिव्यामेकादशीप्रभृतिपञ्चदशीनिरुद्धम् ॥
अन्नस्य भोजननिवृत्तिवशादमुष्मिन्निष्टं फलं दिशति पांडव शार्ङ्गधन्वा ॥ 52 ॥
मल्लद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.72.m:
which is renowned on earth as the Bhīṣmapañcaka, contained from the eleventh to the fifteenth day; / through abstention from eating food in this, O Pāṇḍava, the wielder of the Śārṅga bow grants the desired fruit.
Description of the Malladvādaśī Votive Observance

4.73.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇe śrīvatsa garuḍāsana ..
brūhi me malladvādaśyā vidhānaṃ devakīsuta .. 1 ..
4.73.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
शङ्खचक्रगदापाणे श्रीवत्स गरुडासन ॥
ब्रूहि मे मल्लद्वादश्या विधानं देवकीसुत ॥ 1 ॥
4.73.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O bearer of the conch, discus, and mace, bearing the Śrīvatsa mark, whose seat is Garuḍa, / tell me, O son of Devakī, the rules of Malladvādaśī.

4.73.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yadā bhāṃḍīranyagrodhe vasāmi yamunātaṭe ..
gopālamadhye govatsairaṣṭavarṣosmi līlayā .. .. 2 ..
4.73.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
यदा भांडीरन्यग्रोधे वसामि यमुनातटे ॥
गोपालमध्ये गोवत्सैरष्टवर्षोस्मि लीलया ॥ ॥ 2 ॥
4.73.m:
The holy Kṛṣṇa said:
When I was residing at the Bhāṇḍīra banyan tree on the bank of the Yamunā, / eight years old, among the cowherd boys with their calves in play,

4.73.s:
kaṃsāsuravadhārthāya mathuropavane tadā ..
ābālo bālarūpeṇa gopamallairbalotkaṭaiḥ .. 3 ..
4.73.d:
कंसासुरवधार्थाय मथुरोपवने तदा ॥
आबालो बालरूपेण गोपमल्लैर्बलोत्कटैः ॥ 3 ॥
4.73.m: for the sake of slaying the demon Kaṃsa, then in the grove near Mathurā, / from my childhood, in the form of a boy, with cowherd wrestlers of supreme might,

4.73.s:
sametya mallagopasya balena saha kānane ..
āsphoṭayaṃti nṛtyaṃti tridaśe tridaśā iva .. 4 ..
4.73.d:
समेत्य मल्लगोपस्य बलेन सह कानने ॥
आस्फोटयंति नृत्यंति त्रिदशे त्रिदशा इव ॥ 4 ॥
4.73.m: joining together with the force of cowherd wrestlers in the forest, / they slapped their arms and danced like gods in heaven.

4.73.s:
surabhadro maṃḍalīkayogavarddhanayogadāḥ..
yakṣeṃdrabhadra ityādi teṣāṃ nāmāni gokule .. 5 ..
4.73.d:
सुरभद्रो मंडलीकयोगवर्द्धनयोगदाः॥
यक्षेंद्रभद्र इत्यादि तेषां नामानि गोकुले ॥ 5 ॥
4.73.m: Surabhadra, Maṇḍalīka, Yogavardhana, Yogada, / Yakṣendrabhadra, and so forth were their names in Gokula.

4.73.s:
gopīnāmapi nāmāni prādhānyena nibodha me ..
gopālī pālikā dhanyā viśākhā dhyānaniṣṭhikā.. 6 ..
4.73.d:
गोपीनामपि नामानि प्राधान्येन निबोध मे ॥
गोपाली पालिका धन्या विशाखा ध्याननिष्ठिका॥ 6 ॥
4.73.m: Hear from me also the names of the cowherd women according to prominence: / Gopālī, Pālikā, Dhanyā, Viśākhā, Dhyānaniṣṭhikā,

4.73.s:
ilvānugandhā subhagā tārakā daśamī tathā ..
ityevamādibhirahaṃ sūpaviṣṭo varāsane .. 7 ..
4.73.d:
इल्वानुगन्धा सुभगा तारका दशमी तथा ॥
इत्येवमादिभिरहं सूपविष्टो वरासने ॥ 7 ॥
4.73.m: Ilvā, Anugandhā, Subhagā, Tārakā, and Daśamī. / Seated comfortably upon an excellent seat by these and others,

4.73.s:
pūjito'smi suraiḥ puṣpairdadhidugdhākṣataistathā ..
śatāni trīṇi ṣaṣṭiśca mallānāṃ pūjayaṃti mām .. 8 ..
4.73.d:
पूजितोऽस्मि सुरैः पुष्पैर्दधिदुग्धाक्षतैस्तथा ॥
शतानि त्रीणि षष्टिश्च मल्लानां पूजयंति माम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.73.m: I was worshipped with fragrant flowers, curd, milk, and unbroken grains. / Three hundred and sixty wrestlers worshipped me,

4.73.s:
mallinyaśca surāmāṃsairaṃgajāgaranarttanaiḥ ..
mallayuddhairbahuvidhairbāhyairmallabhaṭaiḥ sphuṭaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.73.d:
मल्लिन्यश्च सुरामांसैरंगजागरनर्त्तनैः ॥
मल्लयुद्धैर्बहुविधैर्बाह्यैर्मल्लभटैः स्फुटैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.73.m: and the wrestling women worshipped with spirituous liquor, meat, physical vigils, and dances, / with diverse wrestling matches by distinguished outer wrestler-warriors,

4.73.s:
bhakṣyairbhojyaistathā pānairdadhidugdhaghṛtāsavaiḥ ..
godānairvṛṣadānaiśca śraddhayā viprapūjanaiḥ .. 4.73.10 ..
4.73.d:
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैस्तथा पानैर्दधिदुग्धघृतासवैः ॥
गोदानैर्वृषदानैश्च श्रद्धया विप्रपूजनैः ॥ 4.73.10 ॥
4.73.m: with foodstuffs, cooked dishes, drinks, curd, milk, ghee, and liquors, / with gifts of cows and bulls, and with worship of Brahmins in faith,

4.73.s:
goṣṭhīprabhūtairvadhūnāṃ snehasaṃbhāṣaṇairmithaḥ ..
evaṃ dvādaśa dvādaśyo grahītavyā yathecchayā .. 11 ..
4.73.d:
गोष्ठीप्रभूतैर्वधूनां स्नेहसंभाषणैर्मिथः ॥
एवं द्वादश द्वादश्यो ग्रहीतव्या यथेच्छया ॥ 11 ॥
4.73.m: with numerous assemblies of young women conversing affectionately with one another. / Thus, twelve twelfth lunar days are to be undertaken at will.

4.73.s:
saṃbaṃdhibhiḥ krameṇaiva mallānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak ..
pūjayaṃti krameṇaiva māsimāsi tanuṃ mama .. 12 ..
4.73.d:
संबंधिभिः क्रमेणैव मल्लानां च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
पूजयंति क्रमेणैव मासिमासि तनुं मम ॥ 12 ॥
4.73.m: By relatives, in sequence, for the wrestlers individually, / month by month, they worship my body in succession.

4.73.s:
māsādikārtikāṃtaṃ ca bhaktyā dvādaśanāmabhiḥ ..
pāraṇepāraṇe dadyānmallakāni dvijātaye .. 13 ..
4.73.d:
मासादिकार्तिकांतं च भक्त्या द्वादशनामभिः ॥
पारणेपारणे दद्यान्मल्लकानि द्विजातये ॥ 13 ॥
4.73.m: From the first month up to Kārtika, with devotion, through the twelve names, / at every breaking of the fast, one should give small vessels to a Brahmin:

4.73.s: keśavanārāyaṇamādhavagovindaviṣṇumadhusūdanatrivikramavāmanaśrīdharahṛṣīkeśapadmanābhadāmodarāṇāṃ namonama iti .. .. 14 ..
4.73.d: केशवनारायणमाधवगोविन्दविष्णुमधुसूदनत्रिविक्रमवामनश्रीधरहृषीकेशपद्मनाभदामोदराणां नमोनम इति ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
4.73.m: Saying: "Homage, homage to Keśava, Nārāyaṇa, Mādhava, Govinda, Viṣṇu, Madhusūdana, Trivikrama, Vāmana, Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa, Padmanābha, and Dāmodara."

4.73.s:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairjāgaraṇairniśi ..
gītavādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca mallakṣveḍāṃgayuddhakaiḥ . 15 ..
4.73.d:
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपैर्जागरणैर्निशि ॥
गीतवाद्यैश्च नृत्यैश्च मल्लक्ष्वेडांगयुद्धकैः । 15 ॥
4.73.m: With perfumes, flowers, and incense, with lamps, with vigils at night, / with songs, musical instruments, dances, and wrestling cries and bodily bouts,

4.73.s:
ghṛtadānaiḥ kṣīradānaiḥ kṛṣṇo me prīyatā miti ..
evameṣa vidhiḥ prokto māsairdvādaśabhirnṛpa .. 16 ..
4.73.d:
घृतदानैः क्षीरदानैः कृष्णो मे प्रीयता मिति ॥
एवमेष विधिः प्रोक्तो मासैर्द्वादशभिर्नृप ॥ 16 ॥
4.73.m: and with gifts of ghee and milk, saying, "May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me." / Thus this rite has been declared across the twelve months, O king.

4.73.s:
dvādaśī yā mamādyāpi manasaḥ prītivarddhanī ..
mallaiḥ pravartitā yasmādato'rthaṃ malladvādaśī .. 17 ..
4.73.d:
द्वादशी या ममाद्यापि मनसः प्रीतिवर्द्धनी ॥
मल्लैः प्रवर्तिता यस्मादतोऽर्थं मल्लद्वादशी ॥ 17 ॥
4.73.m: That twelfth lunar day, which even today increases the joy of my mind, / because it was instituted by the wrestlers, is therefore called Malladvādaśī.

4.73.s:
teṣāṃ paramamallānāṃ teṣāṃ jñāna yudhiṣṭhira ..
goṣṭhe babhūva suprājyaṃ gomahiṣyādyajāvikam .. 16 ..
4.73.d:
तेषां परममल्लानां तेषां ज्ञान युधिष्ठिर ॥
गोष्ठे बभूव सुप्राज्यं गोमहिष्याद्यजाविकम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.73.m: For those supreme wrestlers, O Yudhiṣṭhira, their knowledge, / and in their cow-pen there was abundant cattle, buffaloes, goats, and sheep,

4.73.s:
matprasādāddharmaputra balaṃ kīrtiryaśo dhanam ..
evamanye'pi puruṣā hyabalā malladvādaśīm .. 19 ..
4.73.d:
मत्प्रसादाद्धर्मपुत्र बलं कीर्तिर्यशो धनम् ॥
एवमन्येऽपि पुरुषा ह्यबला मल्लद्वादशीम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.73.m: strength, fame, renown, and wealth, by my grace, O son of Dharma. / Likewise, other men and women who observe Malladvādaśī,

4.73.s:
ye kariṣyaṃti madbhaktāsteṣāṃ dāsyāmi hṛdgatam ..
ārogyaṃ balamaiśvarya viṣṇulokaṃ ca śāśvatam .. 4.73.20 ..
4.73.d:
ये करिष्यंति मद्भक्तास्तेषां दास्यामि हृद्गतम् ॥
आरोग्यं बलमैश्वर्य विष्णुलोकं च शाश्वतम् ॥ 4.73.20 ॥
4.73.m: my devotees who perform it—I shall grant the desire of their hearts: / health, strength, sovereignty, and the eternal world of Viṣṇu.

4.73.s:
bhāṃḍīrapādapatale militairmahadbhirmallairanākulitabāhubalairbaliṣṭhaiḥ ..
saṃpūjitaḥ sapadi yatra tithau tataśca sā dvādaśī suviditā vrata malla saṃjñā .. 21 ..
bhīmadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.73.d:
भांडीरपादपतले मिलितैर्महद्भिर्मल्लैरनाकुलितबाहुबलैर्बलिष्ठैः ॥
संपूजितः सपदि यत्र तिथौ ततश्च सा द्वादशी सुविदिता व्रत मल्ल संज्ञा ॥ 21 ॥
भीमद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.73.m:
Because on that lunar day he was worshipped beneath the Bhāṇḍīra tree by the gathered great and powerful wrestlers with unstirred arm-strength, / that twelfth lunar day has become well known as the votive observance named Malladvādaśī.
Description of the Bhīmadvādaśī Votive Observance

4.74.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vidarbhādhipatiḥ śrīmānāsītpūrvaṃ sudhārmikaḥ ..
damayaṃtyāḥ pitā pūrvaṃ nalasya śvaśuro bhuvi .. 1 ..
4.74.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
विदर्भाधिपतिः श्रीमानासीत्पूर्वं सुधार्मिकः ॥
दमयंत्याः पिता पूर्वं नलस्य श्वशुरो भुवि ॥ 1 ॥
4.74.m:
The holy Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, there was a glorious and most righteous king of Vidarbha, / the father of Damayantī and father-in-law of Nala upon the earth,

4.74.s:
satyavādanaśīlaśca prajāpālanatatparaḥ ..
kṣatradharmarataḥ śrīmānsaṃgrāmeṣvaparājitaḥ .. 2 ..
4.74.d:
सत्यवादनशीलश्च प्रजापालनतत्परः ॥
क्षत्रधर्मरतः श्रीमान्संग्रामेष्वपराजितः ॥ 2 ॥
4.74.m: habitually truthful, dedicated to protecting his subjects, / devoted to the duty of the warrior class, illustrious, and undefeated in battles.

4.74.s:
tasyāpi kurvato rājyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ..
ājagāma mahābhāgaḥ pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ .. 3 ..
4.74.d:
तस्यापि कुर्वतो राज्यं शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥
आजगाम महाभागः पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः सुतः ॥ 3 ॥
4.74.m: While he was ruling the kingdom according to the action ordained by the scriptures, / the illustrious Pulastya, the son of Brahmā, arrived,

4.74.s:
sarvajñānanidhiḥ śrīmāṃstīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ..
tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā brahmayonimakalmaṣam .. 4 ..
4.74.d:
सर्वज्ञाननिधिः श्रीमांस्तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगतः ॥
तमागतमथो दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मयोनिमकल्मषम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.74.m: a treasury of all knowledge, glorious, in the course of a pilgrimage to sacred places. / Then, seeing that sinless one born from Brahmā who had arrived,

4.74.s:
utthāya pradadau rājā svamāsanamabhīpsitam ..
arghaṃ pādyaṃ ca yatkiñcittattasmai pradadau svayam .. 5 ..
4.74.d:
उत्थाय प्रददौ राजा स्वमासनमभीप्सितम् ॥
अर्घं पाद्यं च यत्किञ्चित्तत्तस्मै प्रददौ स्वयम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.74.m: the king stood up and offered his own desired seat; / water for guest-offering, water for the feet, whatever was required, he gave him personally.

4.74.s:
rājyaṃ caivātmanā sārddhaṃ nivedya sa kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
tena caivābhyanujñāto niṣasāda varāsane .. 6 ..
4.74.d:
राज्यं चैवात्मना सार्द्धं निवेद्य स कृतांजलिः ॥
तेन चैवाभ्यनुज्ञातो निषसाद वरासने ॥ 6 ॥
4.74.m: Offering the kingdom together with himself, with folded hands, / and permitted by him, he sat down upon an excellent seat.

4.74.s:
papraccha kuśalapraśnaṃ tapasyadhyayane tathā ..
tatheti coktvā sa munistaṃ rājānamabhāṣata .. 7 ..
4.74.d:
पप्रच्छ कुशलप्रश्नं तपस्यध्ययने तथा ॥
तथेति चोक्त्वा स मुनिस्तं राजानमभाषत ॥ 7 ॥
4.74.m: He asked after his welfare regarding austerities and sacred study. / Saying "So be it," that sage addressed the king:

4.74.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
kaccitte kuśalaṃ rājankośe janapade pure ..
dharme ca te matirnityaṃ kaccitpārthiva vartate .. 8 ..
4.74.d:
॥ पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥ ॥
कच्चित्ते कुशलं राजन्कोशे जनपदे पुरे ॥
धर्मे च ते मतिर्नित्यं कच्चित्पार्थिव वर्तते ॥ 8 ॥
4.74.m:
Pulastya said:
Is all well with you, O king, in your treasury, country, and capital? / And is your mind ever fixed upon righteousness, O ruler of the earth?

4.74.s:
.. bhīma uvāca .. ..
sarvatra kuśalaṃ brahmanyeṣāṃ kuśalamicchasi ..
tava cāgamanenāhaṃ pāvitaḥ saṃgavāriṇā .. 9 ..
4.74.d:
॥ भीम उवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वत्र कुशलं ब्रह्मन्येषां कुशलमिच्छसि ॥
तव चागमनेनाहं पावितः संगवारिणा ॥ 9 ॥
4.74.m:
Bhīma said:
All is well everywhere, O Brahmin, for those whose welfare you desire; / and by your arrival, I have been purified by the water of your company.

4.74.s:
evaṃ tau saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā saṃbhāṣyātha parasparam ..
remāte pūrvavṛttāṃtaiḥ kathābhiritaretaram .. 4.74.10 ..
4.74.d:
एवं तौ संविदं कृत्वा संभाष्याथ परस्परम् ॥
रेमाते पूर्ववृत्तांतैः कथाभिरितरेतरम् ॥ 4.74.10 ॥
4.74.m: Having thus conversed and spoken with each other, / they took delight mutually in accounts of ancient events.

4.74.s:
tataḥ kathāṃte rājendra pulastyaṃ jātavismayaḥ ..
papraccha sarvalokasya hitāya jagataḥ patiḥ .. 11 ..
4.74.d:
ततः कथांते राजेन्द्र पुलस्त्यं जातविस्मयः ॥
पप्रच्छ सर्वलोकस्य हिताय जगतः पतिः ॥ 11 ॥
4.74.m: Then, at the end of the narrative, O king of kings, the lord of the world, filled with wonder, / questioned Pulastya for the benefit of the whole world:

4.74.s:
bhagavanprāṇinaḥ sarve saṃsārārṇavamadhyagāḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte vividhairduḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānā divāniśam .. 12 ..
4.74.d:
भगवन्प्राणिनः सर्वे संसारार्णवमध्यगाः ॥
दृश्यंते विविधैर्दुःखैः पीड्यमाना दिवानिशम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.74.m: "Revered sir, all living beings immersed in the ocean of worldly existence / are seen afflicted day and night by manifold sorrows:

4.74.s:
narake garbhavāse ca vyādhibhirjanmanā tathā ..
tathā kaṣṭaviyogā diduḥkhairdaurgatyasaṃbhavaiḥ ..13..
4.74.d:
नरके गर्भवासे च व्याधिभिर्जन्मना तथा ॥
तथा कष्टवियोगा दिदुःखैर्दौर्गत्यसंभवैः ॥13॥
4.74.m: in hell, in dwelling in the womb, by diseases, by birth, / and likewise by painful separations and other miseries arising from misfortune.

4.74.s:
lālapyamānā bahavaḥ parapīḍopajīvinaḥ ..
evaṃ vidhānyanekāni duḥkhāni munipuṅgava ..14..
4.74.d:
लालप्यमाना बहवः परपीडोपजीविनः ॥
एवं विधान्यनेकानि दुःखानि मुनिपुङ्गव ॥14॥
4.74.m: Lamenting greatly, living by tormenting others— / such are the manifold sorrows, O foremost among sages!

4.74.s:
dṛṣṭvaiva tāni tānyeva bhṛśaṃ me vyādhitaṃ manaḥ ..
teṣāṃ duḥkhāni bhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi mānada .. 15 ..
4.74.d:
दृष्ट्वैव तानि तान्येव भृशं मे व्याधितं मनः ॥
तेषां दुःखानि भूतानां प्राणिनां भुवि मानद ॥ 15 ॥
4.74.m: Merely seeing them over and over, my mind is deeply pained. / For the sorrows of these beings, living creatures on the earth, O bestower of honor,

4.74.s:
upakārakaraṃ brūhi mamānugrahakāmyayā ..
svalpāyāsena bhagavañjāyate sumahatphalam .. 16 ..
4.74.d:
उपकारकरं ब्रूहि ममानुग्रहकाम्यया ॥
स्वल्पायासेन भगवञ्जायते सुमहत्फलम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.74.m: tell me what brings benefit, out of a desire to show grace to me, / through which, with slight effort, O venerable one, a very great fruit is produced."

4.74.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
yadupoṣya na duḥkhānāṃ bhājano jāyate janaḥ .. 17 ..
4.74.d:
॥ पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥
यदुपोष्य न दुःखानां भाजनो जायते जनः ॥ 17 ॥
4.74.m:
Pulastya said:
Listen, O king, I shall declare the best observance among votive observances, / fasting upon which a person does not become a vessel of sorrows.

4.74.s:
māghamāse site pakṣe dvādaśī pāvanī smṛtā ..
tasyāṃ jalārdravasana upoṣya sukhabhāgbhavet .. 18 ..
4.74.d:
माघमासे सिते पक्षे द्वादशी पावनी स्मृता ॥
तस्यां जलार्द्रवसन उपोष्य सुखभाग्भवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.74.m: In the month of Māgha, in the bright fortnight, the twelfth lunar day is remembered as purifying. / Fasting on that day with garments wet with water, one becomes a sharer of happiness.

4.74.s:
.. bhīma uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ sā muniśārdūla upoṣyā dvādaśī bhavet ..
vidhinā kena viprendra tanme brūhi yathākramam .. 19 ..
4.74.d:
॥ भीम उवाच ॥ ॥
कथं सा मुनिशार्दूल उपोष्या द्वादशी भवेत् ॥
विधिना केन विप्रेन्द्र तन्मे ब्रूहि यथाक्रमम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.74.m:
Bhīma said:
How should that twelfth lunar day be observed by fasting, O tiger among sages? / According to what rule, O foremost among Brahmins? Tell me that in due order.

4.74.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājannavahito vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
tava śuśrūṣaṇādvācyaṃ mamāpyetanna saṃśayaḥ .. 4.74.20 ..
4.74.d:
॥ पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्नवहितो व्रतं पापप्रणाशनम् ॥
तव शुश्रूषणाद्वाच्यं ममाप्येतन्न संशयः ॥ 4.74.20 ॥
4.74.m:
Pulastya said:
Listen attentively, O king, to the votive observance that destroys sins.
Because of your desire to hear, it must be told by me; of this there is no doubt.

4.74.s:
adīkṣitāya no deyā nāśiṣyāya kadācana ..
viṣṇubhaktāya śāṃtāya dharmaniṣṭhāya caiva hi .. 21 ..
4.74.d:
अदीक्षिताय नो देया नाशिष्याय कदाचन ॥
विष्णुभक्ताय शांताय धर्मनिष्ठाय चैव हि ॥ 21 ॥
4.74.m:
It should not be given to one uninitiated, nor ever to one who is not a disciple;
[it may be given] only to one devoted to Viṣṇu, tranquil, and intent on righteousness.

4.74.s:
vācyametanmahārāja bhavatānyasya na kvacit ..
brahmahā gurughātī ca bālastrīghātakastathā .. 22 ..
4.74.d:
वाच्यमेतन्महाराज भवतान्यस्य न क्वचित् ॥
ब्रह्महा गुरुघाती च बालस्त्रीघातकस्तथा ॥ 22 ॥
4.74.m:
This must not be told by you, O great king, to anyone else anywhere.
A slayer of a Brahmin, a slayer of a guru, and likewise a slayer of children or women,

4.74.s:
kṛtaghno mitradhrukcauraḥ kṣudro bhagnavratastathā ..
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairvratenānena bhūpate .. 23 ..
4.74.d:
कृतघ्नो मित्रध्रुक्चौरः क्षुद्रो भग्नव्रतस्तथा ॥
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर्व्रतेनानेन भूपते ॥ 23 ॥
4.74.m:
an ungrateful person, a betrayer of friends, a thief, a vile person, and likewise one who has broken a vow—
[all] are freed from all sins by this votive observance, O ruler of the earth.

4.74.s:
śuddhe tithau muhūrte ca maṃḍapaṃ kārayettataḥ ..
daśahastapramāṇena daśapūrvottare plave .. 24 ..
4.74.d:
शुद्धे तिथौ मुहूर्ते च मंडपं कारयेत्ततः ॥
दशहस्तप्रमाणेन दशपूर्वोत्तरे प्लवे ॥ 24 ॥
4.74.m:
Then, on an auspicious lunar day and at an auspicious hour, one should have a pavilion constructed,
measuring ten cubits by ten, sloping towards the north-east.

4.74.s:
tanmadhye pañcahastāṃ tu vedikāṃ parikalpayet ..
śuklāṃ sukuṭṭimāṃ bhūmiṃ vedyāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ .. 25 ..
4.74.d:
तन्मध्ये पञ्चहस्तां तु वेदिकां परिकल्पयेत् ॥
शुक्लां सुकुट्टिमां भूमिं वेद्यां कृत्वा प्रयत्नतः ॥ 25 ॥
4.74.m:
In its middle one should arrange an altar of five cubits,
having with care made the ground upon the altar white and well-paved.

4.74.s:
vilikhenmaṃḍalaṃ tatra paṃcavarṇairvidhānataḥ ..
brāhmaṇo vedasaṃpanno viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ .. 26 ..
4.74.d:
विलिखेन्मंडलं तत्र पंचवर्णैर्विधानतः ॥
ब्राह्मणो वेदसंपन्नो विष्णुभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 26 ॥
4.74.m:
A Brahmin learned in the Vedas, devoted to Viṣṇu, who has conquered his senses,
should draw a mandala there with five colours according to rule.

4.74.s:
pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ svācārābhiratastathā ..
kuṃḍāni kalpayettatra aṣṭau catvāri vā punaḥ ..27..
4.74.d:
पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वज्ञः स्वाचाराभिरतस्तथा ॥
कुंडानि कल्पयेत्तत्र अष्टौ चत्वारि वा पुनः ॥27॥
4.74.m:
Knowing the twenty-five principles and delighting in proper conduct,
he should construct there eight or four sacrificial pits.

4.74.s:
brāhmaṇāṃsteṣu yuṃjīta cātuścaraṇikāñchubhān ..
madhye ca maṃḍalasyātha karṇikāyāṃ janārdanam ..28 ..
4.74.d:
ब्राह्मणांस्तेषु युंजीत चातुश्चरणिकाञ्छुभान् ॥
मध्ये च मंडलस्याथ कर्णिकायां जनार्दनम् ॥28 ॥
4.74.m:
At these he should engage auspicious Brahmins who have four feet [of the Veda].
And in the middle of the mandala, on the pericarp, [he should place] Janārdana.

4.74.s:
pratyaṅmukhaṃ nyaseddevaṃ caturbāhumariṃdama ..
pūjayettaṃ vidhānena śāstroktena vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 29 ..
4.74.d:
प्रत्यङ्मुखं न्यसेद्देवं चतुर्बाहुमरिंदम ॥
पूजयेत्तं विधानेन शास्त्रोक्तेन विचक्षणः ॥ 29 ॥
4.74.m:
One should install the four-armed god facing west, O subduer of enemies;
the wise man should worship him according to the rule prescribed in the scriptures,

4.74.s:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairnaivedyairvividhairapi ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha deśikaḥ .. 4.74.30 ..
4.74.d:
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ॥
एवं संपूज्य देवेशं ब्राह्मणैः सह देशिकः ॥ 4.74.30 ॥
4.74.m:
with perfumes, flowers, incenses, and various food-offerings.
Having thus worshipped the lord of gods, the preceptor together with the Brahmins,

4.74.s:
nyasetstaṃbhadvayaṃ paścāttiṣṭhankāṣṭhasamanvitam ..
devasyābhimukhaṃ tatra pīṭhaṃ tu parikalpayet .. 31 ..
4.74.d:
न्यसेत्स्तंभद्वयं पश्चात्तिष्ठन्काष्ठसमन्वितम् ॥
देवस्याभिमुखं तत्र पीठं तु परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.74.m:
standing behind, should set up two posts furnished with wood.
Facing the god, one should construct a seat there,

4.74.s:
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
tatra śikyaṃ samālaṃbya suvṛttaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam .. 32 ..
4.74.d:
षट्त्रिंशदंगुलं श्रेष्ठं चतुरस्रं समंततः ॥
तत्र शिक्यं समालंब्य सुवृत्तं सुदृढं नवम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.74.m:
thirty-six finger-breadths [wide], excellent, square on all sides.
Having suspended there a well-rounded, very firm, new hanging hoop,

4.74.s:
āropayeddhaṭaṃ tatra yādṛśaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me ..
kaladhautaṃ tathā raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vāpyatha mṛnmayam .. 33 ..
4.74.d:
आरोपयेद्धटं तत्र यादृशं तच्छृणुष्व मे ॥
कलधौतं तथा रौप्यं ताम्रं वाप्यथ मृन्मयम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.74.m:
he should place a pot there—hear from me what kind it should be:
made of gold, silver, copper, or earthenware,

4.74.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vyaṃgavivarjitam ..
tatsahasraṃ śataṃ kuryādekacchidramathāpi vā .. 34 ..
4.74.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं दृढं व्यंगविवर्जितम् ॥
तत्सहस्रं शतं कुर्यादेकच्छिद्रमथापि वा ॥ 34 ॥
4.74.m:
endowed with all marks, sturdy, free from defects;
he should make it with a thousand, a hundred, or even a single perforation,

4.74.s:
kuśalatvānurūpeṇa pāśaikacchidrameva vā ..
sannidhāne tataḥ kuryātsalilaṃ vastrapāvanam .. 35 ..
4.74.d:
कुशलत्वानुरूपेण पाशैकच्छिद्रमेव वा ॥
सन्निधाने ततः कुर्यात्सलिलं वस्त्रपावनम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.74.m:
or with a single side perforation, according to skill.
Then nearby he should place water purified with a cloth.

4.74.s:
homārthaṃ kalpayeccāpi pālāśyaḥ samidhaḥ śubhāḥ ..
tilā ghṛtaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ śamīpatrāṇi caiva hi .. 36 ..
4.74.d:
होमार्थं कल्पयेच्चापि पालाश्यः समिधः शुभाः ॥
तिला घृतं तथा क्षीरं शमीपत्राणि चैव हि ॥ 36 ॥
4.74.m:
And for the sake of the oblation, he should arrange auspicious palāśa firewood,
sesame seeds, ghee, milk, and śamī leaves.

4.74.s:
vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge grahapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet ..
tatra pūjyā grahāḥ sarve graha yajñavidhānataḥ .. 37 ..
4.74.d:
वेद्याः पूर्वोत्तरे भागे ग्रहपीठं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
तत्र पूज्या ग्रहाः सर्वे ग्रह यज्ञविधानतः ॥ 37 ॥
4.74.m:
In the north-eastern part of the altar, he should arrange a seat for the planets;
all the planets are to be worshipped there according to the rite of planetary sacrifice.

4.74.s:
pūrvasyāṃ diśi śakrasya pūjāṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ ..
dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamasyātha pratīcyāṃ varuṇasya ca .. 38
4.74.d:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि शक्रस्य पूजां कुर्वीत यत्नतः ॥
दक्षिणस्यां यमस्याथ प्रतीच्यां वरुणस्य च ॥ 38
4.74.m:
In the eastern direction he should carefully perform worship to Śakra;
in the south to Yama, and in the west to Varuṇa;

4.74.s:
kuberasya tathodīcyāṃ baliṃ kuryātphalākṣataiḥ ..
evaṃ saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ śuklāṃbaradharastathā .. 39 ..
4.74.d:
कुबेरस्य तथोदीच्यां बलिं कुर्यात्फलाक्षतैः ॥
एवं संभृत्य संभारं शुक्लांबरधरस्तथा ॥ 39 ॥
4.74.m:
and in the north he should make an offering to Kubera with fruits and unbroken grains.
Having thus gathered the provisions, wearing white garments,

4.74.s:
samālabhya śubhairgaṃdhairddarbhapāṇirataṃdritaḥ ..
pīṭhamāropayeyuste yajamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..4.74.40 ..
4.74.d:
समालभ्य शुभैर्गंधैर्द्दर्भपाणिरतंद्रितः ॥
पीठमारोपयेयुस्ते यजमानं द्विजोत्तमाः ॥4.74.40 ॥
4.74.m:
anointed with auspicious perfumes, holding darbha grass in hand, vigilant,
those best of Brahmins should seat the patron of the sacrifice upon the seat.

4.74.s:
yajamāno'pi devasya saṃmukhaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ ..
upaviśya paṭhenmaṃtraṃ purāṇoktamidaṃ śṛṇu .. 41 ..
4.74.d:
यजमानोऽपि देवस्य संमुखः प्रयतः शुचिः ॥
उपविश्य पठेन्मंत्रं पुराणोक्तमिदं शृणु ॥ 41 ॥
4.74.m:
The patron of the sacrifice, facing the god, restrained and pure,
having sat down, should recite this mantra spoken in the Purāṇas; hear it:

4.74.s:
namaste devadeveśa namaste bhuvane śvara ..
vratenānena māṃ pāhi paramātmannamostu te .. 42 ..
4.74.d:
नमस्ते देवदेवेश नमस्ते भुवने श्वर ॥
व्रतेनानेन मां पाहि परमात्मन्नमोस्तु ते ॥ 42 ॥
4.74.m:
‘Homage to you, O lord of the gods! Homage to you, O lord of the universe!
Protect me through this votive observance, O supreme Self! Homage to you!’

4.74.s:
tatodakasya dhārāstāḥ pratyaṃgaṣu samanvitāḥ ..
śirasā dhārayettūṣṇīṃ tadgatenāṃtarātmanā .. .. 43 ..
4.74.d:
ततोदकस्य धारास्ताः प्रत्यंगषु समन्विताः ॥
शिरसा धारयेत्तूष्णीं तद्गतेनांतरात्मना ॥ ॥ 43 ॥
4.74.m:
Then, with his inner self fixed on him, he should silently receive upon his head
those streams of water falling upon every limb.

4.74.s:
homaṃ kuryustato viprā dikṣu sarvāsu tatparāḥ ..
paṭheyuḥ śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñāni yāni vai .. 44 ..
4.74.d:
होमं कुर्युस्ततो विप्रा दिक्षु सर्वासु तत्पराः ॥
पठेयुः शांतिकाध्यायं विष्णुसंज्ञानि यानि वै ॥ 44 ॥
4.74.m:
Then the Brahmins, devoted [to the rite], should perform the fire oblations in all directions;
they should recite the propitiatory chapter and whichever [hymns] bear the name of Viṣṇu.

4.74.s:
vāditraistāḍyamānaiśca śaṃkhageya svanaistathā ..
puṇyāhajayaśabdaiśca vedasvanavimiśritaiḥ .. 45 ..
4.74.d:
वादित्रैस्ताड्यमानैश्च शंखगेय स्वनैस्तथा ॥
पुण्याहजयशब्दैश्च वेदस्वनविमिश्रितैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.74.m:
With musical instruments being sounded, and with sounds of conches and singing,
and with cries of ‘auspicious day’ and ‘victory’ mingled with the sound of the Vedas,

4.74.s:
maṃgalaiḥ stutisaṃyuktaiḥ kārayettanmahotsavam ..
devadevasya caritaṃ keśavasya mahācmanaḥ..46..
4.74.d:
मंगलैः स्तुतिसंयुक्तैः कारयेत्तन्महोत्सवम् ॥
देवदेवस्य चरितं केशवस्य महाच्मनः॥46॥
4.74.m:
accompanied by auspicious praises, he should cause that great festival to be celebrated.
A choice Brahmin should recite the deeds of Keśava, the god of gods,

4.74.s:
harivaṃśādikaṃ sarvaṃ śrāvayedbrāhmaṇo varaḥ ..
soparṇikamathākhyānaṃ bhāratākhyānameva ca .. 47 ..
4.74.d:
हरिवंशादिकं सर्वं श्रावयेद्ब्राह्मणो वरः ॥
सोपर्णिकमथाख्यानं भारताख्यानमेव च ॥ 47 ॥
4.74.m:
the great-souled one—the entire Harivaṃśa and other texts—
or the Suparṇa narrative, or the Mahābhārata narrative.

4.74.s:
vyākhyānakuśalāḥ kecicchrāvayeyurataṃdritāḥ ..
anena vidhinā sarvāṃ tāṃ rātriṃ prītivarddhinīm .. 48 ..
4.74.d:
व्याख्यानकुशलाः केचिच्छ्रावयेयुरतंद्रिताः ॥
अनेन विधिना सर्वां तां रात्रिं प्रीतिवर्द्धिनीम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.74.m:
Some who are skilled in exposition should recite without sluggishness.
Following this procedure, the wise patron of the sacrifice should spend

4.74.s:
yajamāno nayeddhīmānyāvatsūryodayo bhavet ..
brāhmaṇāścāpi tāṃ rātrīṃ juhvato jātavedasam .. 49 ..
4.74.d:
यजमानो नयेद्धीमान्यावत्सूर्योदयो भवेत् ॥
ब्राह्मणाश्चापि तां रात्रीं जुह्वतो जातवेदसम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.74.m:
that entire night, which increases joy, until sunrise;
and the Brahmins, offering into the sacred fire throughout that night,

4.74.s:
maṃtraistu vaiṣṇavairdivyaiḥ kṣapayeyurmahīpate ..
vāsudevasya śirasi vasorddhārāṃ prapātayet .. 4.74.50 ..
4.74.d:
मंत्रैस्तु वैष्णवैर्दिव्यैः क्षपयेयुर्महीपते ॥
वासुदेवस्य शिरसि वसोर्द्धारां प्रपातयेत् ॥ 4.74.50 ॥
4.74.m:
should pass [it] with divine Vaiṣṇava mantras, O ruler of the earth.
He should cause a continuous stream of wealth to pour down upon the head of Vāsudeva,

4.74.s:
kṣīreṇājyena vā rājansarvasiddhi pradāyinīm ..
tataḥ prabhātasamaye yajamāno dvijaiḥ saha ..51..
4.74.d:
क्षीरेणाज्येन वा राजन्सर्वसिद्धि प्रदायिनीम् ॥
ततः प्रभातसमये यजमानो द्विजैः सह ॥51॥
4.74.m:
with milk or with ghee, O king, which bestows all accomplishments.
Then at daybreak, the patron of the sacrifice, together with the twice-born,

4.74.s:
snānaṃ kuryānnṛpaśreṣṭha nadyāṃ sarasi vā punaḥ ..
atha vā śaktihīnastu yajamānoṣṇa vāriṇā .. 52 ..
4.74.d:
स्नानं कुर्यान्नृपश्रेष्ठ नद्यां सरसि वा पुनः ॥
अथ वा शक्तिहीनस्तु यजमानोष्ण वारिणा ॥ 52 ॥
4.74.m:
should bathe in a river or a lake, O best of kings;
or if weak, the patron of the sacrifice [may bathe] with warm water.

4.74.s:
tataḥ śuklāni vastrāṇi paridhāya yatavrataḥ ..
arghyaṃ dattvā bhāskarāya savidhānaṃ prasannadhīḥ .. 53 ..
4.74.d:
ततः शुक्लानि वस्त्राणि परिधाय यतव्रतः ॥
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा भास्कराय सविधानं प्रसन्नधीः ॥ 53 ॥
4.74.m:
Then, having put on white garments, firm in his vow,
having offered water to the sun according to rule with a clear mind,

4.74.s:
puṣpairdhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayetpu ruṣottamam ..
hutvā hutāśanaṃ bhaktyā dattvā pūrṇahutiṃ tataḥ .. 54 ..
4.74.d:
पुष्पैर्धूपैः सनैवेद्यैः पूजयेत्पु रुषोत्तमम् ॥
हुत्वा हुताशनं भक्त्या दत्त्वा पूर्णहुतिं ततः ॥ 54 ॥
4.74.m:
he should worship Puruṣottama with flowers, incense, and food-offerings.
Having made oblations into the fire with devotion and then offered the final oblation,

4.74.s:
pūjayedbrāhmaṇānsarvānhotāro yajñakalpitāḥ ..
śayyābhojanagodānairvastrairābharaṇaistathā .. 55 ..
4.74.d:
पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्सर्वान्होतारो यज्ञकल्पिताः ॥
शय्याभोजनगोदानैर्वस्त्रैराभरणैस्तथा ॥ 55 ॥
4.74.m:
he should worship all the Brahmins who were appointed as hotṛs for the sacrifice,
with beds, meals, gifts of cows, garments, and ornaments.

4.74.s:
ācāryaḥ pūjanīyo'tra sarvasvenāpi bhārata ..
yena vā tasya saṃtuṣṭirdevatulyo gururyataḥ .. 56 ..
4.74.d:
आचार्यः पूजनीयोऽत्र सर्वस्वेनापि भारत ॥
येन वा तस्य संतुष्टिर्देवतुल्यो गुरुर्यतः ॥ 56 ॥
4.74.m:
The preceptor is to be worshipped here even with all one's possessions, O descendant of Bharata,
or with whatever brings him satisfaction, since the guru is equal to God.

4.74.s:
vittaśāṭhyavihīnastu bhaktiśaktisamanvitaḥ ..
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭāśca baṃdinaśca samāgatāḥ .. 57 ..
4.74.d:
वित्तशाठ्यविहीनस्तु भक्तिशक्तिसमन्वितः ॥
दीनानाथविशिष्टाश्च बंदिनश्च समागताः ॥ 57 ॥
4.74.m:
Free from deceit in expenditure, endowed with devotion and capability—
and to the destitute, helpless, distinguished, and bards who have arrived,

4.74.s:
teṣāmannaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dadyācchuddhena cetasā ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya viprāya bhojayitvā yathepsitam .. 58 ..
4.74.d:
तेषामन्नं हिरण्यं च दद्याच्छुद्धेन चेतसा ॥
एवं संपूज्य विप्राय भोजयित्वा यथेप्सितम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.74.m:
he should give food and gold with a pure heart.
Having thus worshipped the Brahmins and fed them according to their desire,

4.74.s:
yathāvibhavasāreṇa paścādbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ ..
haviṣyamannaṃ yajñena haviṣyā satilāstathā .. 59 ..
4.74.d:
यथाविभवसारेण पश्चाद्भुंजीत वाग्यतः ॥
हविष्यमन्नं यज्ञेन हविष्या सतिलास्तथा ॥ 59 ॥
4.74.m:
according to the extent of his wealth, he should afterwards eat in silence
sacrificial food prepared through the sacrifice, sacrificial food with sesame.

4.74.s:
evaṃ yajño mahārājaścoktaste saṃprakīrtitaḥ ..
pāpiṣṭhāḥ sarvapāpebhyo mucyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4.74.60 ..
4.74.d:
एवं यज्ञो महाराजश्चोक्तस्ते संप्रकीर्तितः ॥
पापिष्ठाः सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यंते नात्र संशयः ॥ 4.74.60 ॥
4.74.m:
Thus, O great king, this sacrifice has been proclaimed to you;
the most sinful are freed from all sins, of this there is no doubt.

4.74.s:
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ ye yajaṃti śataṃ samāḥ ..
sarve te viṣṇuyāgasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm .. 61 ..
4.74.d:
वाजपेयातिरात्राभ्यां ये यजंति शतं समाः ॥
सर्वे ते विष्णुयागस्य कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.74.m:
Those who sacrifice with the Vājapeya and Atirātra rites for a hundred years
do not equal a sixteenth part of a sacrifice to Viṣṇu.

4.74.s:
sapta janmāni saubhāgyamāyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ ..
prāpnoti dvādaśīmetāṃ tāmupoṣya vidhānataḥ .. 62 ..
4.74.d:
सप्त जन्मानि सौभाग्यमायुरारोग्यसंपदः ॥
प्राप्नोति द्वादशीमेतां तामुपोष्य विधानतः ॥ 62 ॥
4.74.m:
For seven births he obtains good fortune, long life, health, and prosperity,
having fasted on this dvādaśī according to rule.

4.74.s:
mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti viṣṇunā saha modate ..
caturyugāni dvātriṃśadviṣṇurūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ ..63..
4.74.d:
मृतो विष्णुपुरं याति विष्णुना सह मोदते ॥
चतुर्युगानि द्वात्रिंशद्विष्णुरूपधरः स्थितः ॥63॥
4.74.m:
When dead, he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu and rejoices with Viṣṇu;
assuming the form of Viṣṇu, he remains for thirty-two four-age cycles.

4.74.s:
rudraloke tathā rājanyugāni dvādaśaiva tu ..
brahmaloke tathā trīṇi sūryaloke yugāni ca .. 64 ..
4.74.d:
रुद्रलोके तथा राजन्युगानि द्वादशैव तु ॥
ब्रह्मलोके तथा त्रीणि सूर्यलोके युगानि च ॥ 64 ॥
4.74.m: And likewise in Rudra’s world for twelve ages, O king, / and in Brahmā’s world for three ages, and in Sūrya’s world for ages.

4.74.s:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
pṛthivyadhipatiḥ śrīmānvijitāriḥ pratāpavān .. 65 ..
4.74.d:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
पृथिव्यधिपतिः श्रीमान्विजितारिः प्रतापवान् ॥ 65 ॥
4.74.m: Returning here when his merit is exhausted, he becomes a righteous king, / lord of the earth, prosperous, his enemies conquered, and full of splendour.

4.74.s:
vratametatpurā cīrṇaṃ sagareṇa mahātmanā ..
ajena dhuṃdhumāreṇa dilīpena yayātinā .. 66 ..
4.74.d:
व्रतमेतत्पुरा चीर्णं सगरेण महात्मना ॥
अजेन धुंधुमारेण दिलीपेन ययातिना ॥ 66 ॥
4.74.m: This votive observance was formerly performed by the great-souled Sagara, / by Aja, by Dhuṃdhumāra, Dilīpa, and Yayāti,

4.74.s:
anyaiśca pṛthivīpālaiḥ pālitāśeṣabhūtalaiḥ..
strībhirvaiśyaistathā śūdrairdharmakāmaiḥ sadā nṛpa .. 67 ..
4.74.d:
अन्यैश्च पृथिवीपालैः पालिताशेषभूतलैः॥
स्त्रीभिर्वैश्यैस्तथा शूद्रैर्धर्मकामैः सदा नृप ॥ 67 ॥
4.74.m: and by other protectors of the earth who ruled the entire world, / by women, vaiśyas, and śūdras, ever desiring righteousness, O king,

4.74.s:
bhṛgvādyairmunibhiḥ sarvairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ ..
tvayā ca pṛṣṭena mayā kathitaṃ te narādhipa .. 68 ..
4.74.d:
भृग्वाद्यैर्मुनिभिः सर्वैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः ॥
त्वया च पृष्टेन मया कथितं ते नराधिप ॥ 68 ॥
4.74.m: and by all sages beginning with Bhṛgu, by brāhmaṇas who had mastered the Vedas. / And being questioned by you, O ruler of men, I have explained it to you.

4.74.s:
adyaprabhṛti caiveyaṃ khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale ..
bhīmākhyā dvādaśī ceti kṛtakṛtyā ca bhārata .. 69 ..
4.74.d:
अद्यप्रभृति चैवेयं ख्यातिं यास्यति भूतले ॥
भीमाख्या द्वादशी चेति कृतकृत्या च भारत ॥ 69 ॥
4.74.m: From this day forth, it will attain renown upon the earth / as the Bhīmā-named dvādaśī, accomplishing all desires, O Bhārata.

4.74.s:
eṣā pulastyamuninā kathitā kurunaṃdana ..
yaścaināṃ kathitāṃ dhyātvā kuryādvā bhaktibhāvataḥ .. 4.74.70 ..
4.74.d:
एषा पुलस्त्यमुनिना कथिता कुरुनंदन ॥
यश्चैनां कथितां ध्यात्वा कुर्याद्वा भक्तिभावतः ॥ 4.74.70 ॥
4.74.m: This was recounted by the sage Pulastya, O joy of the Kurus; / and whoever, contemplating what has been told, performs it with devotion

4.74.s:
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ..
daridraścāpi bhoḥ pārtha vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ..
viṣṇubhaktena kartavyā saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā .. 71 ..
4.74.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥
दरिद्रश्चापि भोः पार्थ वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् ॥
विष्णुभक्तेन कर्तव्या संसारभयभीरुणा ॥ 71 ॥
4.74.m: is freed from all sins and exalted in the world of Viṣṇu. / Even if poor, O Pārtha, one should avoid stinginess with wealth; / it should be performed by a devotee of Viṣṇu who fears the perils of saṃsāra.

4.74.s:
bhīmena yā kila purā samupoṣitā ca rātrau ghaṭasthirasuśatilavāridhārā ..
tāṃ dvādaśī daśamu khārimukhācchrutāṃ ca samyagvratī carati yāti sa viṣṇuloke .. 72 ..
śravaṇadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.74.d:
भीमेन या किल पुरा समुपोषिता च रात्रौ घटस्थिरसुशतिलवारिधारा ॥
तां द्वादशी दशमु खारिमुखाच्छ्रुतां च सम्यग्व्रती चरति याति स विष्णुलोके ॥ 72 ॥
श्रवणद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.74.m:
That [dvādaśī] on which Bhīma indeed formerly fasted, having a steady, continuous stream of water [and sesamum] in a pot at night— / having heard of that dvādaśī from the mouth of the enemy of the ten-headed one, he who faithfully undertakes the votive observance goes to the world of Viṣṇu.
Description of the Śravaṇadvādaśī Votive Observance
